filters.name: Brightness
filters.note: offset
passes: return vec4(c.rgb+u_p0,1.);

filters.name: Contrast
filters.note: pivot 0.5
passes: return vec4((c.rgb-.5)*u_p0+.5,1.);

filters.name: Exposure
filters.note: linear stops
passes: return vec4(c.rgb*exp2(u_p0),1.);

filters.name: Gamma
filters.note: power curve
passes: return vec4(pow(max(c.rgb,0.),vec3(1./u_p0)),1.);

filters.name: Levels
filters.note: in/out levels
passes: vec3 x=clamp((c.rgb-u_p0)/max(u_p1-u_p0,.001),0.,1.);return vec4(pow(x,vec3(1./u_p2)),1.);

filters.name: Shadows / Highlights
filters.note: tonal recovery
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);vec3 r=c.rgb+u_p0*.6*(1.-smoothstep(0.,.55,l))*(1.-c.rgb)+u_p1*.6*smoothstep(.45,1.,l)*c.rgb;return vec4(r,1.);

filters.name: S-Curve
filters.note: smoothstep curve
passes: vec3 s=c.rgb*c.rgb*(3.-2.*c.rgb);vec3 s2=s*s*(3.-2.*s);return vec4(mix(c.rgb,mix(s,s2,max(u_p0-1.,0.)),min(u_p0,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Invert
filters.note: negative
passes: return vec4(1.-c.rgb,1.);

filters.name: Grayscale
filters.note: 5 methods
passes: int m=int(u_p0+.5);float mx=max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b)),mn=min(c.r,min(c.g,c.b));float g=m==0?luma(c.rgb):m==1?(c.r+c.g+c.b)/3.:m==2?(mx+mn)*.5:m==3?mx:mn;return vec4(vec3(g),1.);

filters.name: Threshold
filters.note: 1-bit
passes: return vec4(vec3(step(u_p0,luma(c.rgb))),1.);

filters.name: Posterize
filters.note: per channel
passes: return vec4(clamp(floor(c.rgb*(u_p0-.001))/(u_p0-1.),0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Solarize
filters.note: Sabattier
passes: return vec4(mix(c.rgb,1.-c.rgb,step(u_p0,c.rgb)),1.);

filters.name: Matte Fade
filters.note: lifted blacks
passes: vec3 r=c.rgb*(1.-u_p0)+u_p0;return vec4(r*vec3(1.,.985,.96),1.);

filters.name: Noir
filters.note: hard B&W
passes: float l=(luma(c.rgb)-.5)*u_p0+.5;l=clamp(l,0.,1.);l=l*l*(3.-2.*l);return vec4(vec3(l),1.);

filters.name: Saturation
filters.note: luma-preserving
passes: return vec4(sat(c.rgb,u_p0),1.);

filters.name: Vibrance
filters.note: protects saturated
passes: float mx=max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b)),mn=min(c.r,min(c.g,c.b));return vec4(sat(c.rgb,1.+u_p0*(1.-(mx-mn))),1.);

filters.name: Hue Rotate
filters.note: HSV
passes: vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);h.x=fract(h.x+u_p0/360.);return vec4(hsv2rgb(h),1.);

filters.name: White Balance
filters.note: temp + tint
passes: return vec4(c.rgb+vec3(u_p0*.12,-u_p1*.1,-u_p0*.12),1.);

filters.name: Channel Swap
filters.note: RGB permute
passes: int m=int(u_p0+.5);vec3 r=m==0?c.brg:m==1?c.gbr:m==2?c.rbg:m==3?c.bgr:c.grb;return vec4(r,1.);

filters.name: Color Isolate
filters.note: keep one hue
passes: vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);float d=abs(fract(h.x-u_p0/360.+.5)-.5)*360.;float m=(1.-smoothstep(u_p1*.6,u_p1,d))*smoothstep(.1,.25,h.y);return vec4(mix(vec3(luma(c.rgb)),c.rgb,m),1.);

filters.name: Duotone
filters.note: 2-ink
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);vec3 a=hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p0/360.,.85,.3));vec3 b=hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p1/360.,.4,1.));return vec4(mix(a,b,smoothstep(0.,1.,l)),1.);

filters.name: Split Toning
filters.note: grade
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);float w=smoothstep(0.,1.,l+u_p2*.3);vec3 t=mix(hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p0/360.,1.,1.)),hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p1/360.,1.,1.)),w);return vec4(mix(c.rgb,overlay(c.rgb,t),.5),1.);

filters.name: Gradient Map
filters.note: luma → palette
passes: return vec4(ramp(int(u_p0+.5),luma(c.rgb)),1.);

filters.name: Sepia
filters.note: classic matrix

filters.name: Cyanotype
filters.note: Prussian blue
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);return vec4(mix(vec3(.03,.12,.33),vec3(.88,.95,1.),pow(l,.9)),1.);

filters.name: Teal & Orange
filters.note: blockbuster
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);vec3 t=mix(vec3(0.,.35,.45),vec3(1.,.6,.3),smoothstep(.1,.9,l));return vec4(sat(mix(c.rgb,overlay(c.rgb,t),u_p0),1.1),1.);

filters.name: Bleach Bypass
filters.note: skip-bleach
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);vec3 b=overlay(vec3(l),c.rgb);vec3 r=mix(c.rgb,mix(b,vec3(l),.3),u_p0);return vec4((r-.5)*1.15+.5,1.);

filters.name: Cross Process
filters.note: E-6 in C-41
passes: vec3 r=c.rgb;r.r=smoothstep(.05,.95,r.r);r.g=pow(r.g,.85);r.b=r.b*.7+.12;return vec4(sat(r,1.25),1.);

filters.name: Technicolor 2-Strip
filters.note: red / cyan
passes: float gb=(c.g+c.b)*.5;return vec4(c.r,gb*1.05,gb*.95,1.);

filters.name: Infrared
filters.note: Aerochrome-style

filters.name: X-Ray
filters.note: inverted density
passes: float l=pow(1.-luma(c.rgb),1.4);return vec4(l*.8,l*.95,l*1.1,1.);

filters.name: Pastel
filters.note: soft
passes: return vec4(sat(mix(c.rgb,vec3(1.),.25),.75),1.);

filters.name: Kodachrome
filters.note: color matrix

filters.name: Polaroid
filters.note: color matrix

filters.name: Vintage
filters.note: faded stock

filters.name: Brownie
filters.note: warm print

filters.name: Lomo
filters.note: LC-A
passes: vec2 d=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);float v=1.-u_p0*smoothstep(.2,.9,length(d));vec3 r=sat(c.rgb,1.4);r=r*r*(3.-2.*r);return vec4(r*v,1.);

filters.name: Film Grain
filters.note: midtone-weighted
passes: vec2 p=floor(PX(uv)/u_p0);float n=hash(p)-.5;float l=luma(c.rgb);float w=1.-abs(l-.5)*1.2;return vec4(c.rgb+n*.45*w,1.);

filters.name: Vignette
filters.note: radial falloff
passes: vec2 d=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);float r=length(d)/length(vec2(asp(),1.)*.5);return vec4(c.rgb*(1.-smoothstep(u_p0,u_p0+u_p1,r)),1.);

filters.name: Light Leak
filters.note: edge flare
passes: float a=smoothstep(.9,0.,length((uv-vec2(u_p1,1.))*vec2(1.,1.4)));float b=smoothstep(.6,0.,length(uv-vec2(1.,.2+u_p1*.3)));vec3 c1=hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p0/360.,.8,1.));vec3 c2=hsv2rgb(vec3(fract(u_p0/360.+.08),.9,1.));return vec4(screen(c.rgb,c1*a*.9+c2*b*.6),1.);

filters.name: Old Film
filters.note: scratches + dust

filters.name: Night Vision
filters.note: Gen-2 tube
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb)*2.2;float n=hash(PX(uv))*.25;vec2 d=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);float v=smoothstep(.75,.3,length(d));float sl=.85+.15*sin(PX(uv).y*1.5);return vec4(vec3(.1,1.,.2)*(l+n)*v*sl,1.);

filters.name: Thermal Camera
filters.note: FLIR palette
passes: vec3 r=ramp(0,luma(c.rgb));return vec4(r,1.);

filters.name: Gaussian Blur
filters.note: 2-pass separable
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0));

filters.name: Box Blur
filters.note: 2-pass mean
passes: return box1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
return box1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0));

filters.name: Motion Blur
filters.note: 48 taps
passes: vec2 d=vec2(cos(radians(u_p1)),sin(radians(u_p1)))*R(u_p0)*u_px;vec4 a=vec4(0.);for(int i=0;i<48;i++){a+=T(uv+d*(float(i)/47.-.5));}return a/48.;

filters.name: Zoom Blur
filters.note: radial
passes: vec2 ctr=vec2(u_p1,1.-u_p2);vec4 a=vec4(0.);for(int i=0;i<40;i++){a+=T(mix(uv,ctr,float(i)/39.*u_p0));}return a/40.;

filters.name: Spin Blur
filters.note: rotational
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);vec4 a=vec4(0.);for(int i=0;i<40;i++){float t=(float(i)/39.-.5)*radians(u_p0);a+=T(rot(p,t)/vec2(asp(),1.)+.5);}return a/40.;

filters.name: Tilt-Shift
filters.note: miniature
passes: float m=smoothstep(u_p1,u_p1+.25,abs(1.-uv.y-u_p0));return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p2)*m);
float m=smoothstep(u_p1,u_p1+.25,abs(1.-uv.y-u_p0));vec4 b=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p2)*m);return vec4(sat(b.rgb,1.2),1.);

filters.name: Lens Blur
filters.note: bokeh disc, 80 taps
passes: vec3 acc=vec3(0.);float ws=0.;float r=R(u_p0);for(int i=0;i<80;i++){float fi=float(i);float rr=sqrt((fi+.5)/80.)*r;float a=fi*2.39996;vec3 s=T(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*rr*u_px).rgb;float w=1.+pow(luma(s),4.)*12.;acc+=s*w;ws+=w;}return vec4(acc/ws,1.);

filters.name: Surface Blur
filters.note: bilateral 13×13
passes: vec3 acc=vec3(0.);float ws=0.;float r=R(u_p0);for(int j=-6;j<=6;j++)for(int i=-6;i<=6;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j))*r/6.;vec3 s=T(uv+o*u_px).rgb;vec3 d=s-c.rgb;float w=exp(-dot(o,o)/(r*r*.5+.01))*exp(-dot(d,d)/(2.*u_p1*u_p1));acc+=s*w;ws+=w;}return vec4(acc/ws,1.);

filters.name: Bloom
filters.note: 3-pass
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);return vec4(c.rgb*smoothstep(u_p0,u_p0+.15,l),1.);
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p1));
vec4 b=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p1));vec3 o=O(uv).rgb;return vec4(screen(o,b.rgb*u_p2),1.);

filters.name: Orton Glow
filters.note: dreamy sandwich
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
vec3 b=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0)).rgb;vec3 o=O(uv).rgb;vec3 r=screen(o,o)*screen(b,b);return vec4(sat(r,1.15),1.);

filters.name: Soft Focus
filters.note: diffusion
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
vec3 b=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0)).rgb;vec3 o=O(uv).rgb;return vec4(mix(o,max(o,b),.7),1.);

filters.name: Sharpen
filters.note: 3×3 kernel
passes: vec2 p=u_px;vec3 s=c.rgb*5.-T(uv+vec2(p.x,0.)).rgb-T(uv-vec2(p.x,0.)).rgb-T(uv+vec2(0.,p.y)).rgb-T(uv-vec2(0.,p.y)).rgb;return vec4(mix(c.rgb,s,u_p0),1.);

filters.name: Unsharp Mask
filters.note: 2-pass
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p1));
vec3 b=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p1)).rgb;vec3 o=O(uv).rgb;return vec4(o+(o-b)*u_p0,1.);

filters.name: High Pass
filters.note: detail layer
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
vec3 b=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0)).rgb;return vec4(.5+(O(uv).rgb-b),1.);

filters.name: Clarity
filters.note: midtone local contrast
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p1));
vec3 b=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p1)).rgb;vec3 o=O(uv).rgb;float l=luma(o);return vec4(o+(o-b)*u_p0*4.*l*(1.-l),1.);

filters.name: Sobel
filters.note: 3×3 gradient
passes: float m=clamp(length(sobel(uv))*u_p0,0.,1.);return vec4(vec3(u_p1>.5?1.-m:m),1.);

filters.name: Prewitt
filters.note: 3×3 uniform
passes: float r[8];ring8(uv,r);float gx=(r[2]+r[3]+r[4])-(r[0]+r[7]+r[6]);float gy=(r[0]+r[1]+r[2])-(r[6]+r[5]+r[4]);return vec4(vec3(clamp(length(vec2(gx,gy))*u_p0,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Scharr
filters.note: rotation-accurate

filters.name: Roberts Cross
filters.note: 2×2 diagonal
passes: vec2 p=u_px;float a=L(uv)-L(uv+vec2(p.x,-p.y));float b=L(uv+vec2(p.x,0.))-L(uv-vec2(0.,p.y));return vec4(vec3(clamp(length(vec2(a,b))*u_p0,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Laplacian
filters.note: 2nd derivative
passes: vec2 p=u_px;float l=4.*L(uv)-L(uv+vec2(p.x,0.))-L(uv-vec2(p.x,0.))-L(uv+vec2(0.,p.y))-L(uv-vec2(0.,p.y));return vec4(vec3(clamp(abs(l)*u_p0,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Laplacian of Gaussian
filters.note: Marr–Hildreth
passes: return vec4(vec3(luma(blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0)*2.).rgb)),1.);
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0)*2.);
vec2 p=u_px;float l=4.*T(uv).r-T(uv+vec2(p.x,0.)).r-T(uv-vec2(p.x,0.)).r-T(uv+vec2(0.,p.y)).r-T(uv-vec2(0.,p.y)).r;return vec4(vec3(clamp(abs(l)*u_p1*10.,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Difference of Gaussians
filters.note: band-pass
passes: float a=luma(blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0)).rgb);float b=luma(blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0*1.6)).rgb);return vec4(a,b,0.,1.);
float a=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0)).r;float b=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0*1.6)).g;return vec4(a,b,0.,1.);
float d=(T(uv).r-T(uv).g)*u_p1;return vec4(vec3(u_p2>.5?1.-clamp(-d*2.,0.,1.):clamp(abs(d),0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: XDoG Ink
filters.note: Winnemöller 2012
passes: float a=luma(blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0)).rgb);float b=luma(blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0*1.6)).rgb);return vec4(a,b,0.,1.);
float a=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0)).r;float b=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0*1.6)).g;return vec4(a,b,0.,1.);
float a=T(uv).r,b=T(uv).g;float d=(1.+u_p1)*a-u_p1*b;float e=d>=u_p2?1.:1.+tanh(u_p3*(d-u_p2));return vec4(vec3(clamp(e,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Canny (1-pass)
filters.note: NMS + double threshold
passes: vec2 g=sobel(uv);float m=length(g)/4.;float a=atan(g.y,g.x);float q=mod(floor((a+PI/8.)/(PI/4.)),4.);vec2 d=q<.5?vec2(1.,0.):q<1.5?vec2(1.,1.):q<2.5?vec2(0.,1.):vec2(-1.,1.);d*=u_px;float m1=length(sobel(uv+d))/4.,m2=length(sobel(uv-d))/4.;float e=(m>=m1&&m>=m2)?(m>u_p1?1.:(m>u_p0?.45:0.)):0.;return vec4(vec3(e),1.);

filters.name: Kirsch Compass
filters.note: 8 directions
passes: float r[8];ring8(uv,r);float tot=0.;for(int i=0;i<8;i++)tot+=r[i];float mx=0.;for(int k=0;k<8;k++){float s3=r[k]+r[(k+1)%8]+r[(k+2)%8];mx=max(mx,8.*s3-3.*tot);}return vec4(vec3(clamp(mx/15.*u_p0,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Robinson Compass
filters.note: 8 directions
passes: float r[8];ring8(uv,r);float w[8]=float[8](1.,2.,1.,0.,-1.,-2.,-1.,0.);float mx=0.;for(int k=0;k<8;k++){float s=0.;for(int i=0;i<8;i++)s+=r[(i+k)%8]*w[i];mx=max(mx,abs(s));}return vec4(vec3(clamp(mx*u_p0*.5,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Frei-Chen
filters.note: edge subspace

filters.name: Edge Direction
filters.note: angle → hue
passes: vec2 g=sobel(uv);float m=clamp(length(g)*u_p0,0.,1.);return vec4(hsv2rgb(vec3(atan(g.y,g.x)/(2.*PI)+.5,1.,m)),1.);

filters.name: Color Edges
filters.note: per-channel Sobel
passes:
vec2 p=u_px;vec3 tl=T(uv+vec2(-p.x,p.y)).rgb,t=T(uv+vec2(0.,p.y)).rgb,tr=T(uv+p).rgb,l=T(uv-vec2(p.x,0.)).rgb,r=T(uv+vec2(p.x,0.)).rgb,bl=T(uv-p).rgb,b=T(uv-vec2(0.,p.y)).rgb,br=T(uv+vec2(p.x,-p.y)).rgb;
  vec3 gx=(tr+2.*r+br)-(tl+2.*l+bl);vec3 gy=(tl+2.*t+tr)-(bl+2.*b+br);return vec4(clamp(sqrt(gx*gx+gy*gy)*u_p0,0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Neon Edges
filters.note: glowing outlines
passes: float m=clamp(length(sobel(uv))*u_p0,0.,1.);float gl=0.;for(int i=0;i<8;i++){vec2 o=vec2(cos(float(i)*.785),sin(float(i)*.785))*R(3.)*u_px;gl+=length(sobel(uv+o));}gl=gl/8.*u_p0;return vec4(sat(c.rgb,2.5)*1.4*(m+gl*u_p1),1.);

filters.name: Line Art
filters.note: clean outlines
passes: float m=smoothstep(u_p1,u_p1+.25,length(sobel(uv))*u_p0);return vec4(vec3(1.-m),1.);

filters.name: Pencil Sketch
filters.note: color dodge
passes: return vec4(vec3(1.-luma(blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0)).rgb)),1.);

float b=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0)).r;vec3 o=O(uv).rgb;float d=clamp(luma(o)/max(1.-b,.001),0.,1.);d=pow(d,u_p1*2.);return vec4(u_p2>.5?mix(vec3(1.),sat(o,1.3),1.-d*.85)*d+(1.-d)*o*.2:vec3(d),1.);

filters.name: Cross Hatching
filters.note: 4 tonal layers
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);float l=luma(c.rgb);float s=u_p0,w=u_p1;float r=1.;if(l<.8&&mod(p.x+p.y,s)<w)r=0.;if(l<.6&&mod(p.x-p.y,s)<w)r=0.;if(l<.4&&mod(p.x+p.y-s*.5,s)<w)r=0.;if(l<.2&&mod(p.x-p.y-s*.5,s)<w)r=0.;return vec4(vec3(r),1.);

filters.name: Contour Lines
filters.note: isolines of luma
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb)*u_p0;float d=min(fract(l),1.-fract(l));float ln=1.-smoothstep(0.,max(fwidth(l),.001)*(u_p1*10.+.5),d);vec3 base=u_p2>.5?c.rgb:vec3(1.);return vec4(mix(base,vec3(0.),ln),1.);

filters.name: Emboss
filters.note: directional relief
passes: vec2 d=vec2(cos(radians(u_p0)),sin(radians(u_p0)))*u_px*max(1.,u_k);float e=(L(uv+d)-L(uv-d))*u_p1;return vec4(u_p2>.5?c.rgb+e:vec3(.5+e),1.);

filters.name: Dilate
filters.note: morphological max
passes: vec3 m=vec3(0.);for(int j=-8;j<=8;j++)for(int i=-8;i<=8;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));if(length(o)>u_p0+.5)continue;m=max(m,T(uv+o*u_k*u_px).rgb);}return vec4(m,1.);

filters.name: Erode
filters.note: morphological min
passes: vec3 m=vec3(1.);for(int j=-8;j<=8;j++)for(int i=-8;i<=8;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));if(length(o)>u_p0+.5)continue;m=min(m,T(uv+o*u_k*u_px).rgb);}return vec4(m,1.);

filters.name: Morphological Gradient
filters.note: dilate − erode
passes: float mx=0.,mn=1.;for(int j=-6;j<=6;j++)for(int i=-6;i<=6;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));if(length(o)>u_p0+.5)continue;float l=L(uv+o*u_k*u_px);mx=max(mx,l);mn=min(mn,l);}return vec4(vec3(clamp((mx-mn)*u_p1,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Height Map
filters.note: luma height
passes: float h=(luma(c.rgb)-.5)*u_p0+.5;if(u_p1>.5)h=1.-h;return vec4(vec3(clamp(h,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Normal Map
filters.note: tangent space
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p1));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p1));
vec2 g=sobel(uv)*u_p0;vec3 n=normalize(vec3(-g.x,-g.y,1.));if(u_p2>.5)n.y=-n.y;return vec4(n*.5+.5,1.);

filters.name: Ambient Occlusion
filters.note: height-based
passes: float h=L(uv);float occ=0.;for(int i=0;i<24;i++){float fi=float(i);float a=fi*2.39996;float rr=R(u_p0)*sqrt((fi+.5)/24.);occ+=max(0.,L(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*rr*u_px)-h);}return vec4(vec3(clamp(1.-occ/24.*u_p1*4.,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Curvature
filters.note: convex / concave
passes: vec2 p=u_px*R(u_p0);float lap=L(uv+vec2(p.x,0.))+L(uv-vec2(p.x,0.))+L(uv+vec2(0.,p.y))+L(uv-vec2(0.,p.y))-4.*L(uv);return vec4(vec3(clamp(.5-lap*u_p1,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Cavity
filters.note: crevice mask
passes: vec2 p=u_px*R(u_p0);float lap=L(uv+vec2(p.x,0.))+L(uv-vec2(p.x,0.))+L(uv+vec2(0.,p.y))+L(uv-vec2(0.,p.y))-4.*L(uv);return vec4(vec3(clamp(1.-max(0.,lap)*u_p1,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Roughness
filters.note: inverse gloss + variance
passes: float m=0.,s=0.;for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){float l=L(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*u_px);m+=l;s+=l*l;}m/=9.;float v=max(s/9.-m*m,0.);float r=(1.-luma(c.rgb)-.5)*u_p0+.5;return vec4(vec3(clamp(r+sqrt(v)*2.,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Specular
filters.note: gloss map
passes: return vec4(vec3(pow(luma(c.rgb),u_p0)),1.);

filters.name: Displacement
filters.note: smoothed height
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
float h=luma(blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0)).rgb);return vec4(vec3(clamp((h-.5)*u_p1+.5,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Albedo (De-light)
filters.note: removes shading
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
float bl=luma(blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0)).rgb);return vec4(O(uv).rgb/(bl+.05)*.5,1.);

filters.name: Relight
filters.note: normals + Blinn-Phong
passes: vec2 g=sobel(uv)*u_p2;vec3 n=normalize(vec3(-g,1.));float az=radians(u_p0),el=radians(u_p1);vec3 ld=normalize(vec3(cos(az)*cos(el),sin(az)*cos(el),sin(el)));float df=max(dot(n,ld),0.);vec3 hv=normalize(ld+vec3(0.,0.,1.));float sp=pow(max(dot(n,hv),0.),40.)*u_p3;return vec4(c.rgb*(.35+.9*df)+sp,1.);

filters.name: Pixelate
filters.note: block sample
passes: vec2 cell=vec2(u_p0);return T(fromPX(floor(PX(uv)/cell)*cell+cell*.5));

filters.name: Hex Mosaic
filters.note: hex grid
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 r=vec2(1.,1.7320508);vec2 h=r*.5;vec2 a=mod(p,r)-h;vec2 b=mod(p-h,r)-h;vec2 g=dot(a,a)<dot(b,b)?a:b;return T(fromPX((p-g)*u_p0));

filters.name: Crystallize
filters.note: Voronoi
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);float md=9.;vec2 best=vec2(0.);for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec2 cc=ip+vec2(float(i),float(j));vec2 s=cc+hash2(cc);float d=length(p-s);if(d<md){md=d;best=s;}}return T(fromPX(best*u_p0));

filters.name: Stained Glass
filters.note: Voronoi + leading
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);float md=9.,md2=9.;vec2 best=vec2(0.);for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec2 cc=ip+vec2(float(i),float(j));vec2 s=cc+hash2(cc);float d=length(p-s);if(d<md){md2=md;md=d;best=s;}else if(d<md2)md2=d;}float e=smoothstep(u_p1*.5,u_p1,md2-md);return vec4(sat(T(fromPX(best*u_p0)).rgb,1.4)*1.1*e,1.);

filters.name: CMYK Halftone
filters.note: 4 screens
passes:
vec2 p=PX(uv);float ang[4]=float[4](15.,75.,0.,45.);float dt[4];for(int i=0;i<4;i++){float a=radians(ang[i]+u_p1);vec2 q=rot(p,a)/u_p0;vec2 fq=fract(q)-.5;vec2 cell=floor(q)+.5;vec3 sc=T(fromPX(rot(cell*u_p0,-a))).rgb;float kk=1.-max(sc.r,max(sc.g,sc.b));vec3 cm=(1.-sc-kk)/max(1.-kk,.001);float v=i==0?cm.x:i==1?cm.y:i==2?cm.z:kk;float rad=sqrt(clamp(v,0.,1.))*.6;dt[i]=1.-smoothstep(rad-.07,rad+.07,length(fq));}
  vec3 r=vec3(1.);r.r*=1.-dt[0];r.g*=1.-dt[1];r.b*=1.-dt[2];r*=1.-dt[3];return vec4(r,1.);

filters.name: Mono Halftone
filters.note: newsprint
passes: float a=radians(u_p1);vec2 q=rot(PX(uv),a)/u_p0;vec2 fq=fract(q)-.5;vec3 sc=T(fromPX(rot((floor(q)+.5)*u_p0,-a))).rgb;float rad=sqrt(1.-luma(sc))*.62;return vec4(vec3(smoothstep(rad-.07,rad+.07,length(fq))),1.);

filters.name: Line Engraving
filters.note: banknote lines
passes: vec2 q=rot(PX(uv),radians(u_p1));q.y+=sin(q.x*.05)*3.;float d=1.-luma(c.rgb);float w=abs(fract(q.y/u_p0)-.5)*2.;return vec4(vec3(smoothstep(d-.08,d+.08,w)),1.);

filters.name: Toon
filters.note: cel shading
passes: vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);h.z=floor(h.z*u_p0+.5)/u_p0;h.y=min(h.y*1.2,1.);float e=smoothstep(.3,.6,length(sobel(uv))*u_p1*.5);return vec4(hsv2rgb(h)*(1.-e),1.);

filters.name: Comic Book
filters.note: inks + Ben-Day
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);h.y=min(h.y*1.5,1.);h.z=l<.33?.35:l<.66?.75:1.;vec3 base=hsv2rgb(h);vec2 q=rot(PX(uv),.785)/u_p0;float dd=1.-smoothstep(.25,.3,length(fract(q)-.5));base*=mix(1.,1.-dd*.5,step(l,.5));float e=smoothstep(.4,.8,length(sobel(uv)));return vec4(base*(1.-e),1.);

filters.name: Kuwahara
filters.note: edge-preserving
passes: return vec4(kuwa(uv,u_p0),1.);

filters.name: Oil Paint
filters.note: Kuwahara + bump
passes: return vec4(kuwa(uv,u_p0),1.);
vec2 g=sobel(uv)*2.*u_p1;vec3 n=normalize(vec3(-g,1.));float d=dot(n,normalize(vec3(-.5,.6,.8)));return vec4(c.rgb*(.75+.35*d),1.);

filters.name: Watercolor
filters.note: pigment + paper
passes: return vec4(kuwa(uv,u_p0),1.);

vec3 col=c.rgb;float e=length(sobel(uv));col=mix(col,col*col,smoothstep(.05,.4,e)*.6);float paper=fbm(PX(uv)*.08)*.5+fbm(PX(uv)*.5)*.5;col*=1.-(paper-.5)*.5*u_p1;return vec4(mix(col,vec3(1.),.08),1.);

filters.name: Charcoal
filters.note: smudged
passes: float e=length(sobel(uv))*2.;float l=luma(c.rgb);float g=hash(floor(PX(uv)*vec2(.5,2.)))*.25;float v=clamp(l*1.2+.1-e*.8-g*(1.-l),0.,1.);return vec4(vec3(v)*vec3(1.,.98,.95),1.);

filters.name: Pointillism
filters.note: Seurat
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec3 col=vec3(.96,.94,.9);float best=9.;for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec2 cc=ip+vec2(float(i),float(j));vec2 s=cc+hash2(cc)*.8+.1;float d=length(p-s);float rad=.55+hash(cc+3.)*.25;if(d<rad&&d<best){best=d;col=sat(T(fromPX(s*u_p0)).rgb,1.4);}}return vec4(col,1.);

filters.name: Pop Art Quad
filters.note: Warhol 2×2
passes: vec2 q=fract(uv*2.);int t=int(floor(uv.x*2.)+2.*floor(uv.y*2.));float l=luma(T(q).rgb);float v=floor(l*3.)/2.;vec3 hu[4]=vec3[4](vec3(1.,.2,.6),vec3(.1,.8,1.),vec3(1.,.85,.1),vec3(.5,1.,.3));vec3 bg[4]=vec3[4](vec3(.1,.2,.8),vec3(1.,.3,.1),vec3(.6,.1,.7),vec3(1.,.5,.8));return vec4(mix(bg[t],hu[t],v),1.);

filters.name: Ordered Dither
filters.note: threshold matrix
passes: vec2 cell=vec2(u_p1);vec2 p=floor(PX(uv)/cell);vec3 s=T(fromPX((p+.5)*cell)).rgb;float t=(u_p3>.5?hash(p):bayer8(p))-.5;float n=u_p0-1.;vec3 v=u_p2>.5?s:vec3(luma(s));return vec4(clamp(floor(v*n+t+.5)/n,0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Retro Palette
filters.note: nearest color
passes: vec2 cell=vec2(u_p1);vec2 p=floor(PX(uv)/cell);vec3 s=T(fromPX((p+.5)*cell)).rgb;if(u_p2<.5)s+=(bayer4(p)-.5)*.18;return vec4(nearestPal(int(u_p0+.5),s),1.);

filters.name: Game Boy
filters.note: DMG 4-shade
passes: vec2 cell=vec2(u_p0);vec2 p=floor(PX(uv)/cell);float l=luma(T(fromPX((p+.5)*cell)).rgb)+(bayer4(p)-.5)*.3;return vec4(nearestPal(3,vec3(l)*vec3(.61,.74,.06)/.74),1.);

filters.name: ASCII Art
filters.note: 10-glyph ramp
passes: vec2 cell=vec2(u_p0,u_p0*1.6);vec2 p=PX(uv);vec2 ci=floor(p/cell);vec2 fq=fract(p/cell);vec3 s=T(fromPX((ci+.5)*cell)).rgb;float gi=floor(clamp(luma(s),0.,.999)*10.);float m=texture(u_aux,vec2((gi+fq.x)/10.,fq.y)).r;vec3 col=u_p1<.5?vec3(.2,1.,.35):u_p1<1.5?sat(s,1.3)*1.3:vec3(1.);return vec4(col*m,1.);

filters.name: CRT Monitor
filters.note: shadow mask
passes: vec2 q=uv*2.-1.;q+=q*dot(q.yx,q.yx)*u_p0;vec2 s2=q*.5+.5;if(s2.x<0.||s2.y<0.||s2.x>1.||s2.y>1.)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);vec3 s=T(s2).rgb;float sl=1.-u_p1*.5*(.5-.5*sin(PX(s2).y*PI));int m=int(mod(PX(uv).x,3.));vec3 mask=m==0?vec3(1.,.7,.7):m==1?vec3(.7,1.,.7):vec3(.7,.7,1.);float v=1.-.6*pow(length(q)*.7,3.);return vec4(s*sl*mix(vec3(1.),mask,u_p1)*v*1.2,1.);

filters.name: VHS Tape
filters.note: tracking + bleed
passes: float y=uv.y;float w=sin(y*40.+u_seed)*.002*u_p0+(hash(vec2(floor(PX(uv).y/3.),u_seed))-.5)*.004*u_p0;float tb=step(abs(y-fract(u_seed*.37)),.015);vec2 s2=vec2(uv.x+w+tb*.02,y);vec3 col=vec3(T(s2+vec2(.004*u_p0,0.)).r,T(s2).g,T(s2-vec2(.004*u_p0,0.)).b);col=sat(col,.85);col+=hash(PX(uv)*vec2(1.,.5))*u_p1*.25-u_p1*.12;col+=tb*.3*hash(PX(uv)+7.);return vec4(col,1.);

filters.name: Glitch
filters.note: block datamosh
passes: float ry=floor((1.-uv.y)*u_p1);float on=step(1.-u_p0*.6,hash(vec2(ry,7.)));float bx=floor(uv.x*u_p1*.5);on*=step(.3,hash(vec2(bx,ry)));vec2 s2=uv+vec2((hash(vec2(ry,3.))-.5)*.2*on*u_p0,0.);float sp=.01*u_p0*(on+.3);vec3 r=vec3(T(s2+vec2(sp,0.)).r,T(s2).g,T(s2-vec2(sp,0.)).b);if(on>.5&&hash(vec2(ry,bx+1.))>.7)r=r.bgr;return vec4(r,1.);

filters.name: Chromatic Aberration
filters.note: radial fringe
passes: vec2 o=(uv-.5)*2.*R(u_p0)*u_px;return vec4(T(uv+o).r,c.g,T(uv-o).b,1.);

filters.name: RGB Split
filters.note: channel offset
passes: vec2 o=vec2(cos(radians(u_p1)),sin(radians(u_p1)))*R(u_p0)*u_px;return vec4(T(uv+o).r,c.g,T(uv-o).b,1.);

filters.name: Pixel Smear
filters.note: pixel-sort style
passes: int m=int(u_p2+.5);vec2 dir=m==0?vec2(0.,1.):m==1?vec2(0.,-1.):m==2?vec2(1.,0.):vec2(-1.,0.);vec3 best=c.rgb;float bl=luma(c.rgb);if(bl<u_p0)return c;float st=R(u_p1)/48.;for(int i=1;i<=48;i++){vec3 s=T(uv+dir*float(i)*st*u_px).rgb;float l=luma(s);if(l<u_p0)break;if(l>bl){bl=l;best=s;}}return vec4(best,1.);

filters.name: Barrel / Pincushion
filters.note: lens distortion

filters.name: Bulge / Pinch
filters.note: radial power
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);float r=length(p);float R0=u_p1*.6;if(r<R0&&r>0.){p=p/r*R0*pow(r/R0,exp(u_p0*.9));}return T(p/vec2(asp(),1.)+.5);

filters.name: Swirl
filters.note: twirl
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);float r=length(p);float R0=u_p1*.6;if(r<R0){float t=1.-r/R0;p=rot(p,radians(u_p0)*t*t);}return T(p/vec2(asp(),1.)+.5);

filters.name: Wave
filters.note: sine displace
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);int m=int(u_p2+.5);vec2 o=vec2(0.);if(m!=1)o.x=sin(p.y/u_p1*2.*PI)*u_p0;if(m!=0)o.y=sin(p.x/u_p1*2.*PI)*u_p0;return T(fromPX(p+o));

filters.name: Water Ripple
filters.note: concentric
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);vec2 C=u_res/u_k*.5;vec2 d=p-C;float r=length(d);vec2 o=d/max(r,.001)*sin(r/u_p1*2.*PI)*u_p0*exp(-r/(length(C)*1.2));return T(fromPX(p+o));

filters.name: Polar Coordinates
filters.note: tiny planet
passes: if(u_p0<.5){vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);return T(vec2(atan(p.y,p.x)/(2.*PI)+.5,1.-clamp(length(p)*2.,0.,1.)));}float a=(uv.x-.5)*2.*PI;float r=(1.-uv.y)*.5;return T(vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*r/vec2(asp(),1.)+.5);

filters.name: Spherize
filters.note: globe
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*2.;p.x*=asp();float r=length(p);if(r>=1.)return c;vec2 q=p*mix(1.,asin(r)/max(r,1e-4)/(PI*.5),u_p0);q.x/=asp();return T(q*.5+.5);

filters.name: Kaleidoscope
filters.note: mirrored wedges
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);float r=length(p);float a=atan(p.y,p.x)+radians(u_p1);float seg=PI*2./u_p0;a=mod(a,seg);a=abs(a-seg*.5);return T(vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*r/vec2(asp(),1.)+.5);

filters.name: Mirror
filters.note: symmetry
passes: int m=int(u_p0+.5);vec2 q=uv;if(m==0||m==4)q.x=q.x>.5?1.-q.x:q.x;if(m==1)q.x=q.x<.5?1.-q.x:q.x;if(m==2||m==4)q.y=q.y<.5?1.-q.y:q.y;if(m==3)q.y=q.y>.5?1.-q.y:q.y;return T(q);

filters.name: Tile
filters.note: repeat
passes: return T(fract(uv*u_p0));

filters.name: Flip
filters.note: mirror image
passes: int m=int(u_p0+.5);vec2 q=uv;if(m!=1)q.x=1.-q.x;if(m!=0)q.y=1.-q.y;return T(q);

filters.name: Shear
filters.note: skew, wrapped
passes: vec2 p=uv-.5;p=vec2(p.x+p.y*u_p0,p.y+p.x*u_p1);return T(fract(p+.5));

filters.name: Frosted Glass
filters.note: random scatter
passes: vec2 o=(hash2(PX(uv))-.5)*2.*R(u_p0)*u_px;return T(uv+o);

filters.name: Turbulence
filters.note: fbm displace
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);vec2 o=vec2(fbm(p/u_p1),fbm(p/u_p1+31.7))-.5;return T(fromPX(p+o*u_p0*2.));

filters.name: Add Noise
filters.note: uniform
passes: vec2 p=floor(PX(uv)/u_p1);vec3 n=u_p0>.5?vec3(hash(p)):vec3(hash(p),hash(p+11.3),hash(p+23.7));return vec4(c.rgb+(n-.5)*.6,1.);

filters.name: Salt & Pepper
filters.note: impulse
passes: float h=hash(PX(uv));return vec4(h<u_p0*.5?vec3(0.):h>1.-u_p0*.5?vec3(1.):c.rgb,1.);

filters.name: Clouds
filters.note: fbm overlay
passes: float n=fbm(PX(uv)/u_p0);int m=int(u_p1+.5);vec3 r=m==0?c.rgb*(n*1.3):m==1?screen(c.rgb,vec3(n)):overlay(c.rgb,vec3(n));return vec4(r,1.);

filters.name: Fog
filters.note: ground haze
passes: float n=fbm(PX(uv)/220.);float m=clamp((1.-smoothstep(0.,u_p0+.3,uv.y))*.8+n*.5-.2,0.,1.);return vec4(mix(c.rgb,vec3(.82,.85,.88),m),1.);

filters.name: TV Static
filters.note: pure noise
passes: return vec4(vec3(hash(floor(PX(uv)))),1.);

filters.name: False Color (IRE)
filters.note: exposure zones

filters.name: Zebra Stripes
filters.note: overexposure
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);vec2 p=PX(uv);float z=step(.5,fract((p.x+p.y)/12.));return vec4(l>=u_p0?mix(c.rgb,vec3(z),.85):c.rgb,1.);

filters.name: Focus Peaking
filters.note: sharp-edge overlay
passes: float e=length(sobel(uv))*u_p0;int m=int(u_p1+.5);vec3 pc=m==0?vec3(1.,.1,.1):m==1?vec3(0.,1.,1.):vec3(1.,1.,0.);return vec4(mix(sat(c.rgb,.3)*.85,pc,smoothstep(.5,.8,e)),1.);

filters.name: Clipping Warning
filters.note: crushed / blown
passes: float mx=max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b)),mn=min(c.r,min(c.g,c.b));vec3 r=c.rgb;if(mx>=u_p1)r=vec3(1.,0.,0.);if(mn<=u_p0)r=vec3(0.,.3,1.);return vec4(r,1.);

filters.name: Channel View
filters.note: single channel
passes: int m=int(u_p0+.5);float mx=max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b)),mn=min(c.r,min(c.g,c.b));float v=m==0?c.r:m==1?c.g:m==2?c.b:m==3?luma(c.rgb):mx-mn;vec3 t=m==0?vec3(1.,0.,0.):m==1?vec3(0.,1.,0.):m==2?vec3(0.,0.,1.):vec3(1.);return vec4(u_p1>.5?v*t:vec3(v),1.);

filters.name: Saturation Map
filters.note: HSV S
passes: float mx=max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b)),mn=min(c.r,min(c.g,c.b));return vec4(vec3(mx>0.?(mx-mn)/mx:0.),1.);

filters.name: Hue Map
filters.note: pure hue
passes: vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);return vec4(h.y>.08?hsv2rgb(vec3(h.x,1.,1.)):vec3(.5),1.);

filters.name: Texture Map
filters.note: local std-dev 5×5
passes: float m=0.,s=0.;for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++){float l=L(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*u_px);m+=l;s+=l*l;}m/=25.;return vec4(vec3(clamp(sqrt(max(s/25.-m*m,0.))*u_p0,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Noise Map
filters.note: residual
passes: vec3 m=vec3(0.);for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++)m+=T(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*u_px).rgb;m/=9.;return vec4(clamp(abs(c.rgb-m)*u_p0,0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Chroma Key
filters.note: green screen
passes: vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);float d=abs(fract(h.x-u_p0/360.+.5)-.5)*360.;float m=(1.-smoothstep(u_p1*.6,u_p1,d))*smoothstep(.15,.35,h.y)*smoothstep(.1,.3,h.z);if(u_p2<.5)return vec4(vec3(1.-m),1.);vec2 p=PX(uv);float ch=mod(floor(p.x/16.)+floor(p.y/16.),2.);return vec4(mix(c.rgb,mix(vec3(.72),vec3(.95),ch),m),1.);

filters.name: Difference vs Source
filters.note: what the stack changed
passes: return vec4(clamp(abs(c.rgb-texture(u_src,uv).rgb)*u_p0,0.,1.),1.);

filters.note: sepia .5, hue-rotate -30
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.5);x=cssHue(x,-30.0);x=cssSat(x,1.4);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.note: sepia .2, brightness 1.15

passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.35);x=cssContrast(x,1.1);x=cssBright(x,1.2);x=cssSat(x,1.3);vec4 ov=vec4(0.4902,0.4118,0.0941,0.200);x=mix(x,blendMode(3,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.5);x=cssContrast(x,1.2);x=cssSat(x,1.8);vec4 ov=vec4(0.4902,0.4118,0.0941,0.350);x=mix(x,blendMode(5,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.4);x=cssContrast(x,1.25);x=cssBright(x,1.1);x=cssSat(x,0.9);x=cssHue(x,-2.0);return vec4(x,1.);

passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.15);x=cssContrast(x,1.25);x=cssBright(x,1.25);x=cssHue(x,5.0);vec4 ov=vec4(0.4980,0.7333,0.8902,0.400);x=mix(x,blendMode(3,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.5);x=cssContrast(x,1.25);x=cssBright(x,1.15);x=cssSat(x,0.9);x=cssHue(x,-2.0);vec4 ov=vec4(0.4902,0.4118,0.0941,0.200);x=mix(x,blendMode(1,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.note: sepia .25, contrast 1.25
