filters.name: Maven
filters.note: sepia .35, contrast 1.05
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.35);x=cssContrast(x,1.05);x=cssBright(x,1.05);x=cssSat(x,1.75);vec4 ov=vec4(0.6196,0.6863,0.1176,0.250);x=mix(x,blendMode(4,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Mayfair
filters.note: contrast 1.1, brightness 1.15
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssContrast(x,1.1);x=cssBright(x,1.15);x=cssSat(x,1.1);vec4 ov=grad2(vec4(0.0000,0.0000,0.0000,0.000),0.000,vec4(0.6863,0.4118,0.0941,0.400),1.000,length((uv-.5)*u_res)/(.5*length(u_res)));x=mix(x,blendMode(1,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Moon
filters.note: brightness 1.4, contrast .95
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssBright(x,1.4);x=cssContrast(x,0.95);x=cssSat(x,0.0);x=cssSepia(x,0.35);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Nashville
filters.note: sepia .25, contrast 1.5
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.25);x=cssContrast(x,1.5);x=cssBright(x,0.9);x=cssHue(x,-15.0);vec4 ov=grad2(vec4(0.5020,0.3059,0.0588,0.500),0.000,vec4(0.5020,0.3059,0.0588,0.650),1.000,length((uv-.5)*u_res)/(.5*length(u_res)));x=mix(x,blendMode(2,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Perpetua
filters.note: contrast 1.1, brightness 1.25
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssContrast(x,1.1);x=cssBright(x,1.25);x=cssSat(x,1.1);vec4 ov=grad2(vec4(0.0000,0.3569,0.6039,0.250),0.000,vec4(0.9020,0.7569,0.2392,0.250),1.000,1.-uv.y);x=mix(x,blendMode(1,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Poprocket
filters.note: sepia .15, brightness 1.2
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.15);x=cssBright(x,1.2);vec4 ov=grad2(vec4(0.8078,0.1529,0.2745,0.750),0.400,vec4(0.0000,0.0000,0.0000,1.000),0.800,length((uv-.5)*u_res)/(.5*length(u_res)));x=mix(x,blendMode(2,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Reyes
filters.note: sepia .75, contrast .75
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.75);x=cssContrast(x,0.75);x=cssBright(x,1.25);x=cssSat(x,1.4);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Rise
filters.note: sepia .25, contrast 1.25
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.25);x=cssContrast(x,1.25);x=cssBright(x,1.2);x=cssSat(x,0.9);vec4 ov=grad2(vec4(0.0000,0.0000,0.0000,0.000),0.000,vec4(0.9020,0.7569,0.2392,0.250),1.000,length((uv-.5)*u_res)/(.5*length(u_res)));x=mix(x,blendMode(5,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Sierra
filters.note: sepia .25, contrast 1.5
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.25);x=cssContrast(x,1.5);x=cssBright(x,0.9);x=cssHue(x,-15.0);vec4 ov=grad2(vec4(0.5020,0.3059,0.0588,0.500),0.000,vec4(0.0000,0.0000,0.0000,0.650),1.000,length((uv-.5)*u_res)/(.5*length(u_res)));x=mix(x,blendMode(2,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Skyline
filters.note: sepia .15, contrast 1.25
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.15);x=cssContrast(x,1.25);x=cssBright(x,1.25);x=cssSat(x,1.2);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Slumber
filters.note: sepia .35, contrast 1.25
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.35);x=cssContrast(x,1.25);x=cssSat(x,1.25);vec4 ov=vec4(0.4902,0.4118,0.0941,0.200);x=mix(x,blendMode(4,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Stinson
filters.note: sepia .35, contrast 1.25
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.35);x=cssContrast(x,1.25);x=cssBright(x,1.1);x=cssSat(x,1.25);vec4 ov=vec4(0.4902,0.4118,0.0941,0.450);x=mix(x,blendMode(5,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Sutro
filters.note: sepia .4, contrast 1.2
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.4);x=cssContrast(x,1.2);x=cssBright(x,0.9);x=cssSat(x,1.4);x=cssHue(x,-10.0);vec4 ov=grad2(vec4(0.0000,0.0000,0.0000,0.000),0.500,vec4(0.0000,0.0000,0.0000,0.500),0.900,length((uv-.5)*u_res)/(.5*length(u_res)));x=mix(x,blendMode(4,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Toaster
filters.note: sepia .25, contrast 1.5
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.25);x=cssContrast(x,1.5);x=cssBright(x,0.95);x=cssHue(x,-15.0);vec4 ov=grad2(vec4(0.5020,0.3059,0.0588,1.000),0.000,vec4(0.0000,0.0000,0.0000,0.250),1.000,length((uv-.5)*u_res)/(.5*length(u_res)));x=mix(x,blendMode(2,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Valencia
filters.note: sepia .25, contrast 1.1
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.25);x=cssContrast(x,1.1);x=cssBright(x,1.1);vec4 ov=vec4(0.9020,0.7569,0.2392,0.100);x=mix(x,blendMode(5,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Vesper
filters.note: sepia .35, contrast 1.15
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.35);x=cssContrast(x,1.15);x=cssBright(x,1.2);x=cssSat(x,1.3);vec4 ov=vec4(0.4902,0.4118,0.0941,0.250);x=mix(x,blendMode(3,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Walden
filters.note: sepia .35, contrast .8
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.35);x=cssContrast(x,0.8);x=cssBright(x,1.25);x=cssSat(x,1.4);vec4 ov=vec4(0.8980,0.9412,0.5020,0.500);x=mix(x,blendMode(4,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Willow
filters.note: brightness 1.2, contrast .85
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssBright(x,1.2);x=cssContrast(x,0.85);x=cssSat(x,0.05);x=cssSepia(x,0.2);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: X-Pro II
filters.note: sepia .45, contrast 1.25
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;x=cssSepia(x,0.45);x=cssContrast(x,1.25);x=cssBright(x,1.75);x=cssSat(x,1.3);x=cssHue(x,-5.0);vec4 ov=grad2(vec4(0.0000,0.3569,0.6039,0.350),0.000,vec4(0.0000,0.0000,0.0000,0.650),1.000,length((uv-.5)*u_res)/(.5*length(u_res)));x=mix(x,blendMode(1,x,ov.rgb),ov.a);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Cutout
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: vec3 k=kuwa(uv,u_p1);vec3 h=rgb2hsv(k);h.z=floor(h.z*u_p0+.5)/u_p0;h.y=floor(h.y*u_p0+.5)/u_p0;return vec4(hsv2rgb(h),1.);

filters.name: Dry Brush
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: vec3 k=floor(kuwa(uv,u_p0)*6.+.5)/6.;float s=strokeTex(PX(uv),.6,.15,.6);float e=length(sobel(uv));return vec4(k*(1.-u_p1*.3+u_p1*.45*s)*(1.-smoothstep(.2,.8,e)*.4),1.);

filters.name: Fresco
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: vec3 k=pow(kuwa(uv,u_p0),vec3(1.25))*1.15;float e=smoothstep(.15,.6,length(sobelD(uv,R(1.5))));return vec4(k*(1.-e*.75)*(.9+.2*vnoise(PX(uv)*.3)),1.);

filters.name: Neon Glow
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);vec3 g=hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p2/360.,.8,1.));float bl=blurL(uv,R(u_p0)*.5);return vec4(mix(vec3(l)*.55,g,smoothstep(.35,.95,bl)*u_p1*.8),1.);

filters.name: Paint Daubs
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: vec3 k=kuwa(uv,u_p0);vec3 b=blur5(uv,R(u_p0*.6));return vec4(k+(k-b)*u_p1,1.);

filters.name: Palette Knife
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: vec3 h=rgb2hsv(kuwa(uv,u_p0));h.z=floor(h.z*8.+.5)/8.;float e=smoothstep(.2,.5,length(sobel(uv)))*u_p1;return vec4(hsv2rgb(h)*(1.-e*.5),1.);

filters.name: Plastic Wrap
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: vec2 g=sobelD(uv,R(u_p2))*u_p1*.6;vec3 n=normalize(vec3(-g,1.));float sp=pow(max(dot(n,normalize(vec3(-.4,.5,1.))),0.),24.);float rim=pow(1.-n.z,.8);return vec4(c.rgb*.85+(sp*1.2+rim*.4)*u_p0,1.);

filters.name: Poster Edges
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: vec3 p=clamp(floor(c.rgb*(u_p2-.001))/(u_p2-1.),0.,1.);float e=smoothstep(.3,.7,length(sobelD(uv,R(u_p0)))*u_p1);return vec4(p*(1.-e),1.);

filters.name: Rough Pastels
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);float s=strokeTex(p,.785,.5/u_p0,.6);vec3 k=blur5(uv,R(1.));float cov=mix(1.,smoothstep(.2,.8,s+luma(k)*.6),u_p1);return vec4(mix(vec3(.93,.9,.86)*(.9+.1*fbm(p*.25)),sat(k,1.2)*(1.05+.15*s),cov),1.);

filters.name: Smudge Stick
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: vec3 m=vec3(0.);vec2 d=vec2(.7071)*R(u_p0)*u_px;for(int i=0;i<12;i++)m+=T(uv+d*(float(i)/11.-.5)).rgb;m/=12.;return vec4(mix(m,c.rgb*(1.+u_p1*.4),smoothstep(.45,.85,luma(c.rgb))),1.);

filters.name: Sponge
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: vec3 k=kuwa(uv,u_p0);float n=fbm(PX(uv)/u_p2);return vec4(k*(.65+.6*smoothstep(.45-.15*u_p1,.6,n)),1.);

filters.name: Underpainting
filters.note: PS Artistic
passes: vec3 b=blur5(uv,R(u_p0*.5));vec2 p=PX(uv);float cv=.5+.25*(sin(p.x*1.6)+sin(p.y*1.6));return vec4(sat(b,1.15)*(1.-u_p1*.25+u_p1*.35*cv)*.6+c.rgb*.4,1.);

filters.name: Accented Edges
filters.note: PS Brush Strokes
passes: float e=smoothstep(.1+u_p2*.3,.6+u_p2*.4,length(sobelD(uv,R(u_p0))));return vec4(c.rgb+e*u_p1*.8,1.);

filters.name: Angled Strokes
filters.note: PS Brush Strokes
passes: vec2 d=(luma(c.rgb)>.5?vec2(1.,1.):vec2(1.,-1.))*.7071*R(u_p0)*u_px;vec3 m=vec3(0.);for(int i=0;i<12;i++)m+=T(uv+d*(float(i)/11.-.5)).rgb;m/=12.;return vec4(m+(m-blur5(uv,R(2.)))*u_p1*.5,1.);

filters.name: Dark Strokes
filters.note: PS Brush Strokes
passes: bool dk=luma(c.rgb)<u_p0;vec2 d=(dk?vec2(1.,-1.):vec2(1.,1.))*.7071*(dk?R(5.):R(14.))*u_px;vec3 m=vec3(0.);for(int i=0;i<12;i++)m+=T(uv+d*(float(i)/11.-.5)).rgb;m/=12.;return vec4(dk?m*(1.-u_p1*.7):mix(m,vec3(1.),u_p2*.5),1.);

filters.name: Spatter
filters.note: PS Brush Strokes
passes: vec2 o=(hash2(floor(PX(uv)/max(u_p1*.5,1.)))-.5)*2.*R(u_p0)*u_px;vec2 o2=(hash2(floor(PX(uv)))-.5)*R(u_p0*.4)*u_px;return T(uv+o+o2);

filters.name: Sprayed Strokes
filters.note: PS Brush Strokes
passes: float a=radians(u_p2);float n=vnoise(rot(PX(uv),a)*vec2(1./max(u_p0,1.),.6))-.5;return T(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*n*2.*R(u_p1)*u_px);

filters.name: Sumi-e
filters.note: PS Brush Strokes
passes: vec3 b=blur5(uv,R(u_p0*.4));float ink=smoothstep(.55,.15,luma(b))*u_p1;vec3 r=mix(sat(b,.8),vec3(.04),ink);return vec4((r-.5)*(1.+u_p2*.3)+.5,1.);

filters.name: Bas Relief
filters.note: PS Sketch
passes: float a=radians(90.+float(int(u_p2+.5))*45.);vec2 d=vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*u_px*R(u_p0);float e=(blurL(uv+d,R(u_p1)*.5)-blurL(uv-d,R(u_p1)*.5))*6.;return vec4(mix(vec3(.12,.11,.1),vec3(.96,.95,.93),clamp(.55+e,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Chalk & Charcoal
filters.note: PS Sketch
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);float l=blurL(uv,R(1.));float s1=strokeTex(p,.785,1./u_p2,.5),s2=strokeTex(p,-.785,1./u_p2,.5);vec3 r=vec3(.5);r=mix(r,vec3(.05),smoothstep(.5,.15,l)*u_p0*(.6+.6*s1));r=mix(r,vec3(.98),smoothstep(.5,.85,l)*u_p1*(.6+.6*s2));return vec4(r,1.);

filters.name: Chrome
filters.note: PS Sketch
passes: float l=blurL(uv,R(u_p1));float v=.5+.5*cos(l*PI*u_p0*.8+1.);v=v*.85+.15*clamp(.5+sobelD(uv,R(u_p1)).y,0.,1.);return vec4(vec3(v*v*(3.-2.*v)),1.);

filters.name: Conté Crayon
filters.note: PS Sketch

filters.name: Graphic Pen
filters.note: PS Sketch
passes: int m=int(u_p2+.5);float a=m==0?.785:m==1?0.:m==2?-.785:1.5708;float n=vnoise(rot(PX(uv),a)*vec2(1./u_p0,1.3));float ink=step(n,(1.-blurL(uv,R(.7)))*(.6+u_p1));return vec4(vec3(1.-ink*.95),1.);

filters.name: Note Paper
filters.note: PS Sketch
passes: float v=smoothstep(u_p0-.06,u_p0+.06,blurL(uv,R(1.5)));float v2=smoothstep(u_p0-.06,u_p0+.06,blurL(uv+vec2(-1.,1.)*R(1.5)*u_px,R(1.5)));float gr=(hash(floor(PX(uv)))-.5)*u_p1*.15;return vec4(mix(vec3(.62,.6,.58),vec3(.93,.92,.9),v)+(v-v2)*u_p2*.25+gr,1.);

filters.name: Photocopy
filters.note: PS Sketch
passes: float m=blurL(uv,R(u_p0)*.5);float d=m-L(uv);float v=1.-smoothstep(0.,.08,d*u_p1*2.)-smoothstep(.35,.1,m)*.4*u_p1;return vec4(vec3(clamp(v,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Plaster
filters.note: PS Sketch
passes: float s=R(u_p1)*.5;float h=smoothstep(u_p0-.1,u_p0+.1,blurL(uv,s));float hx=smoothstep(u_p0-.1,u_p0+.1,blurL(uv+vec2(R(2.),0.)*u_px,s));float hy=smoothstep(u_p0-.1,u_p0+.1,blurL(uv+vec2(0.,R(2.))*u_px,s));vec3 n=normalize(vec3(h-hx,h-hy,.15));return vec4(mix(vec3(.55),vec3(.92),h)*(.7+.45*dot(n,normalize(vec3(-.5,.6,.6)))),1.);

filters.name: Reticulation
filters.note: PS Sketch
passes: float n=fbm(PX(uv)*.45);float v=smoothstep(-.08,.08,luma(c.rgb)-n*(.6+u_p0*.6)+.15);return vec4(mix(vec3(u_p1*.3),vec3(.7+u_p2*.3),v),1.);

filters.name: Stamp
filters.note: PS Sketch
passes: return vec4(vec3(smoothstep(u_p0-.02,u_p0+.02,blurL(uv,R(u_p1)*.5))),1.);

filters.name: Torn Edges
filters.note: PS Sketch
passes: float n=fbm(PX(uv)/u_p1)-.5;return vec4(vec3(smoothstep(-.05/u_p2,.05/u_p2,blurL(uv,R(1.))-u_p0+n*.25)),1.);

filters.name: Water Paper
filters.note: PS Sketch
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);vec3 m=vec3(0.);float ws=0.;for(int i=0;i<10;i++){float t=float(i)/9.-.5;float w=fbm(vec2(p.x*.4,(p.y+t*u_p0)*.05));m+=T(uv+vec2(0.,t*R(u_p0))*u_px).rgb*w;ws+=w;}m/=ws;vec3 r=(m-.5)*(1.+u_p2*.4)+.5+u_p1*.2;return vec4(r*(.9+.15*fbm(vec2(p.x*.6,p.y*.03))),1.);

filters.name: Craquelure
filters.note: PS Texture
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);float md=9.,md2=9.;for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec2 cc=ip+vec2(float(i),float(j));float d=length(p-cc-hash2(cc));if(d<md){md2=md;md=d;}else if(d<md2)md2=d;}float cr=1.-smoothstep(0.,.06,md2-md);return vec4(c.rgb*(.75+.35*u_p2)*(1.-cr*u_p1*.8)*(1.05-md*.12),1.);

filters.name: Mosaic Tiles
filters.note: PS Texture
passes: vec2 f2=fract(PX(uv)/u_p0);float gx=min(min(f2.x,1.-f2.x),min(f2.y,1.-f2.y));float grout=1.-smoothstep(u_p1*.5,u_p1*.5+.04,gx);return vec4(mix(c.rgb*(.85+.2*smoothstep(0.,.25,gx)),vec3(u_p2*.8+.1),grout),1.);

filters.name: Patchwork
filters.note: PS Texture
passes: vec2 cell=vec2(u_p0);vec2 p=PX(uv);vec2 ip=floor(p/cell);vec2 f2=fract(p/cell);vec3 col=T(fromPX((ip+.5)*cell)).rgb;float sh=f2.x<.15||f2.y>.85?1.25:f2.x>.85||f2.y<.15?.7:1.;return vec4(col*mix(1.,sh,u_p1*(.4+luma(col))),1.);

filters.name: Texturizer
filters.note: PS Texture
passes: int m=int(u_p0+.5);vec2 p=PX(uv);float s=6.*u_p1/100.;float h=texH(m,p,s);float hx=texH(m,p+vec2(1.,0.),s),hy=texH(m,p+vec2(0.,1.),s);int li=int(u_p3+.5);vec2 ld=li==0?vec2(0.,1.):li==1?vec2(-.7,.7):li==2?vec2(-1.,0.):li==3?vec2(0.,-1.):vec2(1.,0.);return vec4(c.rgb*(1.+dot(vec2(hx-h,hy-h),ld)*u_p2*.3),1.);

filters.name: Facet
filters.note: PS Pixelate
passes: return vec4(kuwa(uv,u_p0),1.);

filters.name: Fragment
filters.note: PS Pixelate
passes: vec2 o=R(u_p0)*u_px;return (T(uv+o)+T(uv-o)+T(uv+vec2(o.x,-o.y))+T(uv+vec2(-o.x,o.y)))*.25;

filters.name: Mezzotint
filters.note: PS Pixelate
passes: int m=int(u_p0+.5);vec2 p=PX(uv);float n;if(m<3){n=hash(floor(p/(m==0?1.:m==1?2.:3.)));}else if(m<6){float ln=m==3?4.:m==4?10.:24.;n=hash(vec2(floor(p.x/ln),floor(p.y)));}else{n=vnoise(rot(p,.6)*vec2(1./(m==6?6.:16.),1.));}return vec4(step(vec3(n),c.rgb),1.);

filters.name: Extrude
filters.note: PS Stylize
passes: vec2 cell=vec2(u_p0);vec2 p=PX(uv);vec2 ip=floor(p/cell);vec2 q=fract(p/cell)-.5;vec3 col=T(fromPX((ip+.5)*cell)).rgb;float sh;if(u_p2<.5){float b=.5-max(abs(q.x),abs(q.y));sh=b<.12*u_p1*luma(col)?(q.x>abs(q.y)?.6:q.y>abs(q.x)?1.25:q.x<-abs(q.y)?.8:.7):1.;}else{sh=abs(q.x)>abs(q.y)?(q.x>0.?.65:1.2):(q.y>0.?1.3:.75);sh=mix(1.,sh,u_p1*.8);}return vec4(col*sh,1.);

filters.name: Tiles
filters.note: PS Stylize
passes: vec2 cs=vec2(1./u_p0,asp()/u_p0);vec2 ip=floor(uv/cs);vec2 q=uv-(hash2(ip)-.5)*2.*u_p1*cs;if(any(notEqual(floor(q/cs),ip))){int m=int(u_p2+.5);return m==0?vec4(1.):m==1?vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.):m==2?vec4(1.-c.rgb,1.):c;}return T(q);

filters.name: Wind
filters.note: PS Stylize
passes: int m=int(u_p1+.5);float len=R(u_p0)*(m==1?2.:1.);if(m==2)len*=.3+hash(vec2(floor(PX(uv).y),3.));float dir=u_p2>.5?-1.:1.;vec3 best=c.rgb;float bl=luma(c.rgb);for(int i=1;i<=32;i++){float t=float(i)/32.;vec3 s=T(uv+vec2(dir*t*len,0.)*u_px).rgb;float k=1.-t;float l=luma(s)*k;if(l>bl){bl=l;best=mix(c.rgb,s,k);}}return vec4(best,1.);

filters.name: Median
filters.note: 3×3 sorting network
passes: return vec4(med9(uv,R(u_p0)),1.);

filters.name: Dust & Scratches
filters.note: median + threshold
passes: vec3 m=med9(uv,R(u_p0));return vec4(length(c.rgb-m)>u_p1?m:c.rgb,1.);

filters.name: Despeckle
filters.note: edge-preserving
passes: return vec4(mix(blur5(uv,R(.6)),c.rgb,smoothstep(.15,.5,length(sobel(uv)))),1.);

filters.name: Reduce Noise
filters.note: bilateral 7×7
passes: vec3 acc=vec3(0.);float ws=0.;float sg=.03+.25*(1.-u_p1)*u_p0;for(int j=-3;j<=3;j++)for(int i=-3;i<=3;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));vec3 s=T(uv+o*u_k*u_px).rgb;vec3 d=s-c.rgb;float w=exp(-dot(o,o)/8.)*exp(-dot(d,d)/(2.*sg*sg));acc+=s*w;ws+=w;}return vec4(mix(c.rgb,acc/ws,u_p0),1.);

filters.name: Glass
filters.note: PS Distort
passes: int m=int(u_p2+.5);int tm=m==0?4:m==1?5:m==2?6:0;vec2 p=PX(uv);float s=u_p1*2.*u_p3/100.;float h=texH(tm,p,s),hx=texH(tm,p+vec2(1.,0.),s),hy=texH(tm,p+vec2(0.,1.),s);return T(uv+vec2(hx-h,hy-h)*s*R(u_p0)*u_px);

filters.name: ZigZag
filters.note: PS Distort
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);float r=length(p);float a=sin(r*u_p1*20.)*u_p0/100.*(1.-smoothstep(.3,.75,r));int m=int(u_p2+.5);vec2 q=p;if(m!=1)q=rot(q,a*.6);if(m!=2)q+=normalize(p+1e-5)*a*.03;return T(q/vec2(asp(),1.)+.5);

filters.name: Ocean Ripple
filters.note: PS Distort
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;return T(uv+(vec2(vnoise(p),vnoise(p+19.7))-.5)*2.*R(u_p1)*u_px);

filters.name: Offset
filters.note: wrap around
passes: return T(fract(uv-vec2(u_p0,-u_p1)));

filters.name: Fibers
filters.note: replaces image
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);float n=fbm(vec2(p.x*.08*u_p0/16.,p.y*.004*u_p1));return vec4(mix(hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p2/360.,.6,.25)),hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p2/360.,.25,.95)),n),1.);

filters.name: Lens Flare
filters.note: flare + ghosts

filters.name: Flame
filters.note: fire along the bottom
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);float n=fbm(vec2(p.x*.012*u_p1,p.y*.01-u_seed*3.));float n2=fbm(vec2(p.x*.03*u_p1,p.y*.025+7.));float h=u_p0*(.55+.7*n)+n2*.08;float t=clamp(1.-uv.y/max(h,.01),0.,1.);t=pow(t,1.6);vec3 fire=mix(vec3(.5,0.,0.),hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p2/360.,.95,1.)),smoothstep(.1,.55,t));fire=mix(fire,vec3(1.,.95,.75),smoothstep(.6,1.,t));return vec4(screen(c.rgb,fire*smoothstep(0.,.2,t)),1.);

filters.name: Tree
filters.note: space-folding fractal
passes:
vec2 p=(uv-vec2(.5,0.))*vec2(asp(),1.);float len=.24*u_p0;float sc=1.;float d=1e9;float lf=1e9;for(int i=0;i<10;i++){vec2 q=p;q.y-=clamp(q.y,0.,len);float w=.018*len/.24*(1.-float(i)*.06);d=min(d,(length(q)-w)*sc);p.y-=len;p.x=abs(p.x);p=rot(p,-radians(u_p1));p/=.74;sc*=.74;if(i>=7)lf=min(lf,(length(p-vec2(0.,.03))-.08)*sc);}
  float px=1.5/u_res.y;vec3 col=mix(c.rgb,vec3(.18,.11,.06),smoothstep(px,0.,d));float ln=smoothstep(px,0.,lf)*u_p2*step(.35,hash(floor(uv*u_res/3.)));return vec4(mix(col,vec3(.16,.42,.12)*(.8+.4*hash(floor(uv*u_res))),ln),1.);

filters.name: Picture Frame
filters.note: PS Render

filters.name: Shape Blur
filters.note: custom kernel shapes

filters.name: Path Blur
filters.note: curved motion
passes: vec4 a=vec4(0.);for(int i=0;i<32;i++){float t=float(i)/31.-.5;float ang=radians(u_p2)+u_p1*t*2.;a+=T(uv+vec2(cos(ang),sin(ang))*t*R(u_p0)*u_px);}return a/32.;

filters.name: Average
filters.note: mean color
passes: vec3 a=vec3(0.);for(int j=0;j<8;j++)for(int i=0;i<8;i++)a+=O(vec2(float(i)+.5,float(j)+.5)/8.).rgb;return vec4(a/64.,1.);

filters.name: Iris Blur
filters.note: PS Blur Gallery
passes: float m=smoothstep(u_p2,u_p2+.25,length((uv-vec2(u_p0,1.-u_p1))*vec2(asp(),1.)));return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p3)*m);
float m=smoothstep(u_p2,u_p2+.25,length((uv-vec2(u_p0,1.-u_p1))*vec2(asp(),1.)));return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p3)*m);

filters.name: De-Interlace
filters.note: PS Video
passes: float row=floor(PX(uv).y);if(mod(row,2.)!=(u_p0>.5?0.:1.))return c;vec2 o=vec2(0.,u_k*u_px.y);return u_p1>.5?(T(uv+o)+T(uv-o))*.5:T(uv+o);

filters.name: NTSC Colors
filters.note: broadcast-safe

filters.name: Custom Kernel
filters.note: PS Other › Custom

filters.name: HSB / HSL
filters.note: PS Other
passes: int m=int(u_p0+.5);return vec4(m==0?rgb2hsv(c.rgb):m==1?rgb2hsl(c.rgb):m==2?hsv2rgb(c.rgb):hsl2rgb(c.rgb),1.);

filters.name: Color Balance
filters.note: preserve luminosity
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);int t=int(u_p3+.5);float w=t==0?1.-abs(l-.5)*2.:t==1?1.-smoothstep(0.,.5,l):smoothstep(.5,1.,l);vec3 r=c.rgb+vec3(u_p0,u_p1,u_p2)*.3*w;return vec4(r*l/max(luma(r),1e-3),1.);

filters.name: Photo Filter
filters.note: PS Adjustments

filters.name: Channel Mixer
filters.note: PS Adjustments

filters.name: Selective Color
filters.note: PS Adjustments
passes: int t=int(u_p0+.5);vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);float w;if(t<6){float d=abs(fract(h.x-float(t)/6.+.5)-.5)*6.;w=clamp(1.-d,0.,1.)*h.y*h.z;}else{float l=luma(c.rgb);w=t==6?smoothstep(.5,1.,l):t==7?1.-abs(l-.5)*2.:1.-smoothstep(0.,.5,l);}return vec4(c.rgb-vec3(u_p1,u_p2,u_p3)*.5*w,1.);

filters.name: Replace Color
filters.note: PS Adjustments
passes: vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);float d=abs(fract(h.x-u_p0/360.+.5)-.5)*360.;float m=(1.-smoothstep(u_p1*.5,u_p1,d))*smoothstep(.05,.2,h.y);h.x=fract(h.x+u_p2/360.*m);h.y=clamp(h.y*(1.+u_p3*m),0.,1.);return vec4(hsv2rgb(h),1.);

filters.name: Color Lookup
filters.note: grading looks (not Adobe LUTs)

filters.name: HDR Toning
filters.note: local tone mapping
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
float bl=luma(blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0)).rgb);vec3 o=O(uv).rgb;float l=luma(o);float nl=clamp(mix(bl,.5,u_p1*.6)+(l-bl)*u_p2,0.,1.);return vec4(o*nl/max(l,1e-3),1.);

filters.name: Equalize
filters.note: histogram CDF
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);float n=0.;for(int j=0;j<16;j++)for(int i=0;i<16;i++){float s=luma(O(vec2(float(i)+.5,float(j)+.5)/16.).rgb);n+=smoothstep(s-.01,s+.01,l);}return vec4(c.rgb*(n/256.)/max(l,1e-3),1.);

filters.name: Dodge
filters.note: Krita Adjust
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);int t=int(u_p1+.5);float w=t==0?1.-abs(l-.5)*2.:t==1?1.-smoothstep(0.,.6,l):smoothstep(.4,1.,l);return vec4(c.rgb+c.rgb*u_p0*w*1.2,1.);

filters.name: Burn
filters.note: Krita Adjust
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);int t=int(u_p1+.5);float w=t==0?1.-abs(l-.5)*2.:t==1?1.-smoothstep(0.,.6,l):smoothstep(.4,1.,l);return vec4(c.rgb*(1.-u_p0*w*.8),1.);

filters.name: Dehaze
filters.note: dark-channel prior
passes: float dk=1.;for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++){vec3 s=T(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*R(u_p1)*.5*u_px).rgb;dk=min(dk,min(s.r,min(s.g,s.b)));}float A=.95;float t=max(1.-u_p0*.95*dk/A,.15);return vec4((c.rgb-A)/t+A,1.);

filters.name: HSL / Color Mixer
filters.note: Lightroom
passes: float centers[8]=float[8](0.,30.,60.,120.,180.,225.,270.,315.);vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);float d=abs(fract(h.x-centers[int(u_p0+.5)]/360.+.5)-.5)*360.;float w=(1.-smoothstep(10.,40.,d))*smoothstep(.05,.2,h.y);h.x=fract(h.x+u_p1/360.*w);h.y=clamp(h.y*(1.+u_p2*w),0.,1.);h.z=clamp(h.z*(1.+u_p3*.6*w),0.,1.);return vec4(hsv2rgb(h),1.);

filters.name: Pick
filters.note: GIMP Noise
passes: vec2 p=floor(PX(uv));if(hash(p)>u_p0)return c;vec2 o=floor(hash2(p+5.)*(2.*u_p1+1.))-u_p1;return T(uv+o*u_k*u_px);

filters.name: Slur
filters.note: GIMP Noise · melting
passes: vec2 p=floor(PX(uv));if(hash(p)>u_p0)return c;return T(uv+vec2(floor((hash(p+3.)-.5)*3.),floor(hash(p+9.)*u_p1))*u_k*u_px);

filters.name: Fragment Blur
filters.note: Paint.NET Blurs
passes: vec4 a=vec4(0.);for(int i=0;i<16;i++){if(float(i)>=u_p0)break;float ang=radians(u_p2)+6.2832*float(i)/u_p0;a+=T(uv+vec2(cos(ang),sin(ang))*R(u_p1)*u_px);}return a/u_p0;

filters.name: Mean Curvature Blur
filters.note: blur along edges
passes: vec2 g=sobel(uv);vec2 t=length(g)>1e-4?normalize(vec2(-g.y,g.x)):vec2(1.,0.);vec3 a=vec3(0.);for(int i=-8;i<=8;i++)a+=T(uv+t*float(i)/8.*R(u_p0*.6)*u_px).rgb;return vec4(a/17.,1.);

filters.name: Sketch Blur
filters.note: Paint.NET Blurs
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);vec4 a=vec4(0.);for(int i=0;i<10;i++){float ang=vnoise(p*.05+float(i)*3.1)*6.2832;a+=T(uv+vec2(cos(ang),sin(ang))*R(u_p0)*float(i)/9.*u_px);}return mix(c,a/10.,u_p1);

filters.name: Tileable Blur
filters.note: wraps at edges
passes: vec4 a=vec4(0.);float w=0.;float r=R(u_p0);float sg=max(r*.5,.5);for(int i=-24;i<=24;i++){float x=float(i)*max(1.,r/24.);if(abs(x)>r)continue;float g=exp(-x*x/(2.*sg*sg));a+=T(fract(uv+vec2(x,0.)*u_px))*g;w+=g;}return a/max(w,1e-4);

vec4 a=vec4(0.);float w=0.;float r=R(u_p0);float sg=max(r*.5,.5);for(int i=-24;i<=24;i++){float x=float(i)*max(1.,r/24.);if(abs(x)>r)continue;float g=exp(-x*x/(2.*sg*sg));a+=T(fract(uv+vec2(0.,x)*u_px))*g;w+=g;}return a/max(w,1e-4);

filters.name: Unfocus
filters.note: uniform disc
passes: vec3 a=vec3(0.);for(int i=0;i<64;i++){float fi=float(i);float rr=sqrt((fi+.5)/64.)*R(u_p0);float ang=fi*2.39996;a+=T(uv+vec2(cos(ang),sin(ang))*rr*u_px).rgb;}return vec4(a/64.,1.);

filters.name: Abstraction
filters.note: G’MIC Colors
passes: vec3 k=kuwa(uv,u_p1);vec3 h=rgb2hsv(k);h.x=floor(h.x*u_p0*2.+.5)/(u_p0*2.);h.y=floor(h.y*u_p0+.5)/u_p0;h.z=floor(h.z*u_p0+.5)/u_p0;return vec4(hsv2rgb(h),1.);

filters.name: Basic Adjustments
passes: vec3 x=(c.rgb+u_p0-.5)*(1.+u_p1)+.5;x=pow(max(x,0.),vec3(exp(-u_p2)));return vec4(sat(x,1.+u_p3),1.);

filters.name: Boost Chromaticity
filters.note: protects strong colors
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);vec3 ch=c.rgb-l;float m=length(ch);return vec4(l+ch*(1.+u_p0*(1.-smoothstep(0.,.5,m))),1.);

filters.name: Boost-Fade
filters.note: luma contrast
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);float nl=clamp(u_p0>0.?mix(l,l*l*(3.-2.*l),u_p0):mix(l,.5,-u_p0*.6),0.,1.);return vec4(c.rgb*nl/max(l,1e-3),1.);

filters.name: Channel Processing
filters.note: per-channel curve

filters.name: Color Blindness
filters.note: Machado 2009

filters.name: Colorful Blobs
filters.note: regional hue drift
passes: vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);h.x=fract(h.x+(fbm(PX(uv)/u_p0)-.5)*2.*u_p1/360.);return vec4(hsv2rgb(h),1.);

filters.name: Detect Skin
filters.note: YCbCr ranges
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb*255.;float cb=128.-.168736*x.r-.331264*x.g+.5*x.b;float cr=128.+.5*x.r-.418688*x.g-.081312*x.b;float m=smoothstep(70.,80.,cb)*(1.-smoothstep(124.,134.,cb))*smoothstep(128.,138.,cr)*(1.-smoothstep(168.,178.,cr));return u_p0<.5?vec4(vec3(m),1.):vec4(mix(c.rgb*.35,c.rgb,m),1.);

filters.name: Equalize HSV
filters.note: per-channel CDF
passes: int m=int(u_p0+.5);vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);float v=m==0?h.z:m==1?h.y:luma(c.rgb);float n=0.;for(int j=0;j<16;j++)for(int i=0;i<16;i++){vec3 s=O(vec2(float(i)+.5,float(j)+.5)/16.).rgb;vec3 hs=rgb2hsv(s);float sv=m==0?hs.z:m==1?hs.y:luma(s);n+=smoothstep(sv-.01,sv+.01,v);}n/=256.;if(m==0)h.z=n;else if(m==1)h.y=n;else return vec4(c.rgb*n/max(v,1e-3),1.);return vec4(hsv2rgb(h),1.);

filters.name: Channel Mixer [Space]
filters.note: G’MIC Mixer family

filters.name: Random Color Transformation
filters.note: press New random seed
passes: mat3 M=mat3(hash1(1.),hash1(2.),hash1(3.),hash1(4.),hash1(5.),hash1(6.),hash1(7.),hash1(8.),hash1(9.))*2.-1.;vec3 x=c.rgb+M*(c.rgb-.5)*u_p0;return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Retinex
filters.note: single-scale
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
vec3 b=blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0)).rgb;vec3 o=O(uv).rgb;vec3 r=log(o+.01)-log(b+.01);return vec4(clamp(.5+r*u_p1*.35+(o-.5)*.3,0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Retro Fade
filters.note: faded print

filters.name: Tune HSV Colors
filters.note: HSV gains
passes: vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);h.x=fract(h.x+u_p0/360.);h.y=clamp(h.y*u_p1,0.,1.);h.z=clamp(h.z*u_p2,0.,1.);return vec4(hsv2rgb(h),1.);

filters.name: Morphological Filter
filters.note: 2-pass, disc element
passes: int op=int(u_p0+.5);if(op==0||op==3||op==6){vec3 m=vec3(0.);for(int j=-6;j<=6;j++)for(int i=-6;i<=6;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));if(length(o)>u_p1+.5)continue;m=max(m,T(uv+o*u_k*u_px).rgb);}return vec4(m,1.);}vec3 m=vec3(1.);for(int j=-6;j<=6;j++)for(int i=-6;i<=6;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));if(length(o)>u_p1+.5)continue;m=min(m,T(uv+o*u_k*u_px).rgb);}return vec4(m,1.);

int op=int(u_p0+.5);vec3 o0=O(uv).rgb;if(op<2)return T(uv);if(op==4){vec3 mx=vec3(0.),mn=vec3(1.);for(int j=-6;j<=6;j++)for(int i=-6;i<=6;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));if(length(o)>u_p1+.5)continue;vec3 s=O(uv+o*u_k*u_px).rgb;mx=max(mx,s);mn=min(mn,s);}return vec4(mx-mn,1.);}
   if(op==2||op==5){vec3 m=vec3(0.);for(int j=-6;j<=6;j++)for(int i=-6;i<=6;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));if(length(o)>u_p1+.5)continue;m=max(m,T(uv+o*u_k*u_px).rgb);}return vec4(op==2?m:clamp((o0-m)*3.,0.,1.),1.);}vec3 m=vec3(1.);for(int j=-6;j<=6;j++)for(int i=-6;i<=6;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));if(length(o)>u_p1+.5)continue;m=min(m,T(uv+o*u_k*u_px).rgb);}return vec4(op==3?m:clamp((m-o0)*3.,0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Adaptive Threshold
filters.note: local mean
passes: return vec4(vec3(step(blurL(uv,R(u_p0)*.5)-u_p1,L(uv))),1.);

filters.name: Otsu Threshold
filters.note: global, automatic

filters.name: Distance Map
filters.note: signed, sampled search
passes: bool inside=L(uv)>u_p0;float d=u_p1;for(int i=0;i<96;i++){float fi=float(i);float rr=sqrt((fi+.5)/96.)*R(u_p1);float a=fi*2.39996;if((L(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*rr*u_px)>u_p0)!=inside)d=min(d,rr/u_k);}float v=d/u_p1;if(u_p2>.5)return vec4(vec3(step(.5,fract(d/4.))),1.);return vec4(vec3(inside?.5+v*.5:.5-v*.5),1.);

filters.name: Corner Detector
filters.note: structure tensor
passes: float a=0.,b=0.,cc=0.;for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++){vec2 g=sobelD(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*R(u_p2)*u_px,1.);a+=g.x*g.x;b+=g.x*g.y;cc+=g.y*g.y;}a/=25.;b/=25.;cc/=25.;float tr=a+cc,det=a*cc-b*b;float r=u_p0<.5?det-.04*tr*tr:tr*.5-sqrt(max(tr*tr*.25-det,0.));float m=smoothstep(u_p1*.05,u_p1*.05+.01,r);return vec4(mix(sat(c.rgb,.2)*.6,vec3(1.,.15,.1),m),1.);

filters.name: FAST Corners
filters.note: 16-pixel segment test
passes: float ic=L(uv);float br=0.,dk=0.;for(int i=0;i<16;i++){float a=float(i)*.3927;float s=L(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*3.*u_px);br+=step(ic+u_p0,s);dk+=step(s,ic-u_p0);}float m=step(u_p1,max(br,dk));return vec4(mix(sat(c.rgb,.2)*.6,vec3(.1,1.,.3),m),1.);

filters.name: SUSAN
filters.note: USAN area
passes: float ic=L(uv);float n=0.,tot=0.;for(int j=-3;j<=3;j++)for(int i=-3;i<=3;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));if(length(o)>3.4)continue;tot+=1.;float d=(L(uv+o*u_px)-ic)/u_p0;n+=exp(-pow(d,6.));}float g=u_p1<.5?tot*.75:tot*.5;return vec4(vec3(clamp((g-n)/g*2.,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Gabor Filter
filters.note: oriented band-pass
passes: float th=radians(u_p1);float acc=0.;for(int j=-7;j<=7;j++)for(int i=-7;i<=7;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j))*u_p2/3.;vec2 q=rot(o,-th);float w=exp(-dot(o,o)/(2.*u_p2*u_p2))*cos(6.2832*q.x/u_p0);acc+=w*L(uv+o*u_k*u_px);}return vec4(vec3(.5+acc*u_p3*.05),1.);

filters.name: Structure Tensor Coherence
filters.note: flow strength
passes: float a=0.,b=0.,cc=0.;for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++){vec2 g=sobel(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*u_px);a+=g.x*g.x;b+=g.x*g.y;cc+=g.y*g.y;}float tr=a+cc;float df=sqrt(max((a-cc)*(a-cc)+4.*b*b,0.));float coh=tr>1e-5?pow(df/tr,2.):0.;if(u_p0<.5)return vec4(vec3(coh),1.);float ang=.5*atan(2.*b,a-cc);return vec4(hsv2rgb(vec3(ang/PI+.5,1.,coh*clamp(tr*4.,0.,1.))),1.);

filters.name: Line Detection Kernels
filters.note: 4 line masks

filters.name: CLAHE
filters.note: local CDF, clipped
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);float n=0.;for(int j=0;j<8;j++)for(int i=0;i<8;i++){vec2 o=(vec2(float(i),float(j))/7.-.5)*2.*R(u_p0)*u_px;float s=L(uv+o);n+=min(smoothstep(s-.02,s+.02,l)*u_p1,1.);}float rk=n/64.;float nl=mix(l,mix(l,rk,1./u_p1+.5),u_p2);return vec4(c.rgb*nl/max(l,1e-3),1.);

filters.name: Superpixels (SLIC)
filters.note: 1 iteration on a grid
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);float best=1e9,second=1e9;vec3 col=c.rgb;for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec2 cc=ip+vec2(float(i),float(j))+.5;vec3 cs=blur5(fromPX(cc*u_p0),R(u_p0)*.15);float d=length(c.rgb-cs)+u_p1*length(p-cc)*.5;if(d<best){second=best;best=d;col=cs;}else if(d<second)second=d;}float bd=u_p2>.5?1.-smoothstep(0.,.03,second-best):0.;return vec4(mix(col,vec3(0.),bd*.8),1.);

filters.name: Details Equalizer
filters.note: 3-band

filters.name: Freaky Details
filters.note: extreme local contrast
passes: vec3 b=blur5(uv,R(u_p1)*.5);vec3 d=c.rgb-b;return vec4(sat(c.rgb+d*u_p0*2.,1.+u_p0*.15),1.);

filters.name: Local Normalization
filters.note: (x − mean) / std
passes: float m=0.,s=0.;for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++){float l=L(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*R(u_p0)*.5*u_px);m+=l;s+=l*l;}m/=25.;float sd=sqrt(max(s/25.-m*m,1e-5));float l=luma(c.rgb);float nl=clamp(.5+(l-m)/sd*u_p1*.25,0.,1.);return vec4(c.rgb*nl/max(l,1e-3),1.);

filters.name: Deconvolution Sharpen
filters.note: 1-step approximation
passes: vec3 b=blur5(uv,R(u_p1)*.5);int m=int(u_p0+.5);vec3 r=m==0?c.rgb*pow(c.rgb/max(b,vec3(.01)),vec3(u_p2)):m==1?c.rgb*mix(vec3(1.),c.rgb/max(b,vec3(.01)),u_p2):c.rgb+(c.rgb-b)*u_p2*1.5;return vec4(r,1.);

filters.name: Shock Filter
filters.note: Osher–Rudin
passes: vec2 p=u_px*R(u_p0);float lap=L(uv+vec2(p.x,0.))+L(uv-vec2(p.x,0.))+L(uv+vec2(0.,p.y))+L(uv-vec2(0.,p.y))-4.*L(uv);if(length(sobel(uv))<u_p1)return c;vec3 mx=vec3(0.),mn=vec3(1.);for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec3 s=T(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*p).rgb;mx=max(mx,s);mn=min(mn,s);}return vec4(lap<0.?mx:mn,1.);

filters.name: Anisotropic Diffusion
filters.note: Perona–Malik style
passes: vec3 acc=c.rgb;float ws=1.;for(int k=0;k<8;k++){vec2 d=vec2(cos(float(k)*.785),sin(float(k)*.785));for(int s=1;s<=4;s++){vec3 v=T(uv+d*float(s)*R(u_p2)*.25*u_px).rgb;float g=exp(-pow(length(v-c.rgb)/u_p1,2.));acc+=v*g;ws+=g;}}return vec4(mix(c.rgb,acc/ws,u_p0),1.);

filters.name: Antialias
filters.note: edge-directed
passes: vec2 g=sobel(uv);float e=length(g);if(e<.05)return c;vec2 t=normalize(vec2(-g.y,g.x))*u_px;vec3 a=(T(uv+t).rgb+T(uv-t).rgb+T(uv+t*2.).rgb+T(uv-t*2.).rgb+c.rgb)/5.;return vec4(mix(c.rgb,a,u_p0*smoothstep(.05,.4,e)),1.);

filters.name: NL Filter
filters.note: GIMP Enhance
passes: vec3 s=vec3(0.),mx=vec3(0.),mn=vec3(1.);for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec3 v=T(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*u_px).rgb;s+=v;mx=max(mx,v);mn=min(mn,v);}vec3 tm=(s-mx-mn)/7.;return vec4(u_p0<.5?tm:c.rgb+(c.rgb-tm)*1.5,1.);

filters.name: Red-Eye Attenuation
filters.note: global, no detection
passes: float m=smoothstep(u_p0,u_p0+.3,c.r/max((c.g+c.b)*.5,.02))*smoothstep(.15,.3,c.r);return vec4(mix(c.rgb,vec3((c.g+c.b)*.5,c.g,c.b),m),1.);

filters.name: Remove Hot Pixels
filters.note: isolated bright pixels
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);float r[8];ring8(uv,r);float mx=max(max(max(r[0],r[1]),max(r[2],r[3])),max(max(r[4],r[5]),max(r[6],r[7])));return l>mx+u_p0?vec4(med9(uv,1.),1.):c;

filters.name: Guided Filter
filters.note: self-guided, He 2010
passes: vec3 m=vec3(0.),s=vec3(0.);for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++){vec3 v=T(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*R(u_p0)*.5*u_px).rgb;m+=v;s+=v*v;}m/=25.;vec3 vr=max(s/25.-m*m,0.);vec3 a=vr/(vr+u_p1);return vec4(a*c.rgb+(1.-a)*m,1.);

filters.name: Non-Local Means
filters.note: 3×3 patches, 5×5 search
passes: vec3 acc=vec3(0.);float ws=0.;for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j))*u_k*u_px;float d=0.;for(int b=-1;b<=1;b++)for(int a=-1;a<=1;a++){vec2 q=vec2(float(a),float(b))*u_px;vec3 e=T(uv+q).rgb-T(uv+o+q).rgb;d+=dot(e,e);}float w=exp(-d/(9.*u_p0*u_p0));acc+=T(uv+o).rgb*w;ws+=w;}return vec4(acc/ws,1.);

filters.name: Skin Smoothing
filters.note: skin-masked bilateral
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb*255.;float cb=128.-.168736*x.r-.331264*x.g+.5*x.b;float cr=128.+.5*x.r-.418688*x.g-.081312*x.b;float sk=smoothstep(70.,80.,cb)*(1.-smoothstep(124.,134.,cb))*smoothstep(128.,138.,cr)*(1.-smoothstep(168.,178.,cr));vec3 acc=vec3(0.);float ws=0.;for(int j=-3;j<=3;j++)for(int i=-3;i<=3;i++){vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));vec3 s=T(uv+o*R(u_p1)/3.*u_px).rgb;vec3 d=s-c.rgb;float w=exp(-dot(d,d)/.008);acc+=s*w;ws+=w;}return vec4(mix(c.rgb,acc/ws,sk*u_p0),1.);

filters.name: Symmetric Nearest Neighbor
filters.note: edge-preserving
passes: vec3 acc=c.rgb;float n=1.;for(int j=-6;j<=0;j++)for(int i=-6;i<=6;i++){if(j==0&&i>=0)continue;vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j));if(abs(o.x)>u_p0||abs(o.y)>u_p0)continue;vec3 a=T(uv+o*u_k*u_px).rgb,b=T(uv-o*u_k*u_px).rgb;acc+=dot(a-c.rgb,a-c.rgb)<dot(b-c.rgb,b-c.rgb)?a:b;n+=1.;}return vec4(acc/n,1.);

filters.name: JPEG Artifacts
filters.note: real 8×8 DCT, 4 passes
passes: vec2 px=floor(uv*u_res);float b0=floor(px.x/8.)*8.;float k=mod(px.x,8.);vec3 s=vec3(0.);for(int n=0;n<8;n++){vec3 v=T((vec2(b0+float(n),px.y)+.5)/u_res).rgb;vec3 y=vec3(dot(v,vec3(.299,.587,.114)),dot(v,vec3(-.1687,-.3313,.5))+.5,dot(v,vec3(.5,-.4187,-.0813))+.5)-.5;s+=y*cos((2.*float(n)+1.)*k*PI/16.);}s*=k<.5?sqrt(.125):.5;return vec4(s/3.+128./255.,1.);

vec2 px=floor(uv*u_res);float b0=floor(px.y/8.)*8.;float n=mod(px.y,8.);vec3 s=vec3(0.);for(int k=0;k<8;k++){vec3 v=(T((vec2(px.x,b0+float(k))+.5)/u_res).rgb-128./255.)*8.;s+=v*(k==0?sqrt(.125):.5)*cos((2.*n+1.)*float(k)*PI/16.);}return vec4(s/3.+128./255.,1.);

vec2 px=floor(uv*u_res);float b0=floor(px.x/8.)*8.;float n=mod(px.x,8.);vec3 s=vec3(0.);for(int k=0;k<8;k++){vec3 v=(T((vec2(b0+float(k),px.y)+.5)/u_res).rgb-128./255.)*3.;s+=v*(k==0?sqrt(.125):.5)*cos((2.*n+1.)*float(k)*PI/16.);}vec3 y=s+.5;y.yz-=.5;return vec4(y.x+1.402*y.z,y.x-.34414*y.y-.71414*y.z,y.x+1.772*y.y,1.);

filters.name: Huffman Glitches
filters.note: corrupted entropy blocks
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);vec2 bl=floor(p/u_p1);float h=hash(bl);float row=floor(p.y/u_p1);float corrupt=step(1.-u_p0*.35,hash(vec2(row,17.)))*step(bl.x,floor(hash(vec2(row,5.))*u_res.x/u_k/u_p1)+3.);if(corrupt<.5&&h>u_p0*.15)return c;vec3 dc=T(fromPX((bl+.5)*u_p1)).rgb;vec3 y=vec3(luma(dc));vec3 shift=vec3(hash(bl+1.),hash(bl+2.),hash(bl+3.))-.5;return vec4(corrupt>.5?mix(dc,y+shift*.8,.6):dc+shift*.4,1.);

filters.name: Mess With Bits
filters.note: integer bit ops
passes: uvec3 u=uvec3(clamp(c.rgb,0.,1.)*255.+.5);uint k=uint(u_p1);int m=int(u_p0+.5);if(m==0)u=(u<<k)&255u;else if(m==1)u^=uvec3(uint(floor(PX(uv).x))*k&255u,uint(floor(PX(uv).y))*k&255u,(k*37u)&255u);else if(m==2)u=((u>>k)&1u)*255u;else u=((u&15u)<<4)|(u>>4);return vec4(vec3(u)/255.,1.);

filters.name: CRT Phosphors
filters.note: phosphor triads
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p1;int m=int(u_p0+.5);vec3 mask;float col=mod(floor(p.x),3.);if(m==0){mask=col<.5?vec3(1.,.15,.15):col<1.5?vec3(.15,1.,.15):vec3(.15,.15,1.);mask*=.75+.25*step(.2,fract(p.x));}else if(m==1){vec2 q=vec2(p.x+mod(floor(p.y/2.),2.)*1.5,p.y);float cc=mod(floor(q.x),3.);vec2 fq=fract(q*vec2(1.,.5))-.5;mask=(cc<.5?vec3(1.,.15,.15):cc<1.5?vec3(.15,1.,.15):vec3(.15,.15,1.))*smoothstep(.5,.3,length(fq));}else{float off=mod(floor(p.x/3.),2.)*1.5;mask=(col<.5?vec3(1.,.15,.15):col<1.5?vec3(.15,1.,.15):vec3(.15,.15,1.))*step(.25,fract((p.y+off)/3.));}vec3 b=blur5(uv,R(u_p1));return vec4(c.rgb*mask*2.2+b*u_p2*.5,1.);

filters.name: Dirty
filters.note: stains, specks, scratches
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);float st=fbm(p/u_p1);float sp=step(.996,hash(floor(p/2.)));float sc=step(.997,hash(vec2(floor(p.x),floor(p.y/40.))));vec3 x=c.rgb*mix(vec3(1.),vec3(.78,.7,.55),smoothstep(.45,.75,st)*u_p0);x=mix(x,vec3(.12,.1,.08),sp*u_p0);x=mix(x,vec3(.9),sc*u_p0*.6);return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Flip & Rotate Blocks
filters.note: per-block transforms
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);vec2 ip=floor(p/u_p0);vec2 q=fract(p/u_p0)-.5;float h=hash(ip);if(h<u_p1){int m=int(hash(ip+7.)*4.);q=m==0?vec2(-q.x,q.y):m==1?vec2(q.x,-q.y):m==2?vec2(-q.y,q.x):-q;}return T(fromPX((ip+q+.5)*u_p0));

filters.name: Gradient Noise
filters.note: smooth noise
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;float n=vnoise(p)*.6+vnoise(p*2.1)*.3+vnoise(p*4.3)*.1;return vec4(c.rgb+(n-.5)*u_p1,1.);

filters.name: Offset Stripes
filters.note: alternating shift
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);bool hz=u_p2<.5;float idx=floor((hz?p.y:p.x)/u_p0);float o=(mod(idx,2.)*2.-1.)*u_p1;return T(fromPX(p+(hz?vec2(o,0.):vec2(0.,o))));

filters.name: Random Shade Stripes
filters.note: banding
passes: float row=floor(PX(uv).y/u_p0);return vec4(c.rgb*(1.+(hash(vec2(row,2.))-.5)*u_p1),1.);

filters.name: Rain & Snow
filters.note: procedural weather
passes:
vec2 p=rot(PX(uv),radians(u_p2));vec3 x=c.rgb*.9;if(u_p0<.5){float acc=0.;for(int l=0;l<3;l++){float sc=(1.+float(l)*.6)/u_p3;vec2 q=p*vec2(.25,.012)*sc+vec2(float(l)*13.,0.);vec2 ip=floor(q);float h=hash(ip);float on=step(1.-u_p1*.35,h);float y=fract(q.y+h*7.);acc+=on*smoothstep(.0,.25,y)*smoothstep(.6,.25,y)*smoothstep(.5,.2,abs(fract(q.x)-.5))*(1.-float(l)*.25);}return vec4(x+acc*.45,1.);}
  float acc=0.;for(int l=0;l<3;l++){float sz=(8.+float(l)*7.)*u_p3;vec2 q=p/sz+vec2(float(l)*7.,0.);vec2 ip=floor(q);vec2 ct=ip+.2+hash2(ip)*.6;float on=step(1.-u_p1*.7,hash(ip+3.));acc+=on*smoothstep(.12+float(l)*.03,0.,length(q-ct));}return vec4(mix(x,vec3(1.),clamp(acc,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Self Glitching
filters.note: displaced by its own colors
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);float row=floor(p.y/u_p1);vec3 rc=T(fromPX(vec2(hash(vec2(row,1.))*u_res.x/u_k,(row+.5)*u_p1))).rgb;return T(fromPX(p+vec2((rc.r-rc.b)*u_p0*2.,0.)));

filters.name: Warp by Intensity
filters.note: luma-gradient displacement
passes: vec2 g=sobelD(uv,R(u_p1));return T(uv+g*R(u_p0)*u_px);

filters.name: Multidirectional Blur
filters.note: star streaks
passes: vec4 a=vec4(0.);float n=0.;for(int d=0;d<8;d++){if(float(d)>=u_p1)break;float ang=PI*float(d)/u_p1;vec2 dv=vec2(cos(ang),sin(ang))*R(u_p0)*u_px;for(int i=0;i<10;i++){a+=T(uv+dv*(float(i)/9.-.5));n+=1.;}}return a/n;

filters.name: Conformal Map
filters.note: complex functions, tiled
passes: vec2 z=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.)*2.*u_p1;int m=int(u_p0+.5);vec2 w;float r=length(z),a=atan(z.y,z.x);if(m==0)w=vec2(z.x*z.x-z.y*z.y,2.*z.x*z.y);else if(m==1)w=sqrt(r)*vec2(cos(a*.5),sin(a*.5));else if(m==2)w=z/max(dot(z,z),1e-4);else if(m==3)w=exp(z.x)*vec2(cos(z.y),sin(z.y));else if(m==4)w=vec2(log(max(r,1e-4)),a);else w=vec2(sin(z.x)*cosh(z.y),cos(z.x)*sinh(z.y));return T(fract(w*.5/u_p1+.5));

filters.name: Fisheye
filters.note: equidistant projection
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.)*2.;float r=length(p);float th=r*radians(u_p0)*.5;if(th>=PI*.499)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);float rs=tan(th)/tan(radians(min(u_p0,170.))*.5)/u_p1;vec2 q=(r>0.?p/r*rs:p)/vec2(asp(),1.)*.5+.5;if(q.x<0.||q.y<0.||q.x>1.||q.y>1.)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);return T(q);

filters.name: Stereographic (Little Planet)
filters.note: equirect → planet
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.)*2.;float r=length(p)/u_p0;float th=2.*atan(r);float lon=atan(p.y,p.x)+radians(u_p1);return T(vec2(fract(lon/(2.*PI)+.5),clamp(1.-th/PI,0.,1.)));

filters.name: Poincaré Disk
filters.note: hyperbolic tiling
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.)*2.;float r=length(p);if(r>=.995)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);float d=log((1.+r)/(1.-r));vec2 q=(r>0.?p/r:p)*d*u_p0;return T(fract(q*.5+.5));

filters.name: Droste Spiral
filters.note: Escher log-spiral
passes: vec2 z=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);float r1=u_p0*.5,r2=.5;float sc=log(r2/r1);float ang=atan(sc*u_p1/(2.*PI));vec2 lz=vec2(log(max(length(z),1e-5)),atan(z.y,z.x));lz=vec2(lz.x*cos(ang)-lz.y*sin(ang),lz.x*sin(ang)+lz.y*cos(ang))*cos(ang);lz.x=mod(lz.x-log(r1),sc)+log(r1);vec2 w=exp(lz.x)*vec2(cos(lz.y),sin(lz.y));return T(w/vec2(asp(),1.)+.5);

filters.name: Fractal Trace
filters.note: Mandelbrot remap
passes: vec2 z=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.)*2.*u_p1;vec2 cst=z+vec2(-.5,0.);for(int i=0;i<20;i++){if(float(i)>=u_p0||dot(z,z)>16.)break;z=vec2(z.x*z.x-z.y*z.y,2.*z.x*z.y)+cst;}return T(fract(z*.25+.5));

filters.name: Flower
filters.note: radial petals
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);float r=length(p),a=atan(p.y,p.x);float rr=r*(1.+u_p1*sin(a*u_p0));return T(vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*rr/vec2(asp(),1.)+.5);

filters.name: Illusion
filters.note: GIMP Map
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);float a=atan(p.y,p.x);float r=length(p);vec2 q=rot(p,PI*2./u_p0);vec3 s=T(q/vec2(asp(),1.)+.5).rgb;return vec4(mix(c.rgb,s,.5+.5*cos(a*u_p0)*smoothstep(0.,.5,r)),1.);

filters.name: Curve Bend
filters.note: parabolic bend

filters.name: Crease
filters.note: folded paper
passes: float sh=1.;for(int i=0;i<12;i++){if(float(i)>=u_p0)break;float a=hash1(float(i))*PI;vec2 n=vec2(cos(a),sin(a));float d=dot((uv-vec2(hash1(float(i)+5.),hash1(float(i)+9.)))*vec2(asp(),1.),n);sh*=1.+u_p1*(.35*exp(-abs(d)*90.)*sign(d)+.12*sign(d)*exp(-abs(d)*8.));}return vec4(c.rgb*sh,1.);

filters.name: Water Drops
filters.note: lens-like drops
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/(u_p0*2.);vec2 ip=floor(p);vec2 off=vec2(0.);float hl=0.;for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec2 cc=ip+vec2(float(i),float(j));if(hash(cc)>u_p1)continue;vec2 ct=cc+.25+hash2(cc+4.)*.5;float rad=.2+.3*hash(cc+9.);vec2 d=p-ct;float r=length(d)/rad;if(r<1.){off=-d*u_p2*(1.-r*r)*u_p0*2.;hl=smoothstep(.35,0.,length(d/rad-vec2(-.35,.35)));}}vec3 x=T(uv+off*u_k*u_px).rgb;return vec4(x+hl*.5,1.);

filters.name: Page Curl
filters.note: folded corner
passes: int m=int(u_p1+.5);vec2 a=vec2(asp(),1.);vec2 cn=vec2(m==1||m==3?0.:1.,m<2?1.:0.);vec2 dir=normalize((cn-.5)*a);vec2 p=uv*a;float d=dot(p-cn*a,dir)+u_p0;vec3 desk=u_p2<.5?vec3(.08):vec3(.85);if(d>0.)return vec4(desk,1.);vec2 rp=p-2.*d*dir;vec2 ru=rp/a;if(d>-u_p0&&ru.x>=0.&&ru.y>=0.&&ru.x<=1.&&ru.y<=1.){float t=-d/u_p0;return vec4(mix(vec3(.95),vec3(.7),t)*(.85+.15*smoothstep(0.,.3,t)),1.);}float shadow=smoothstep(-u_p0*1.3,-u_p0,d)*.45;return vec4(c.rgb*(1.-shadow),1.);

filters.name: Perspective
filters.note: projective warp
passes: vec2 p=uv-.5;float w=1.+u_p0*p.x+u_p1*p.y;vec2 q=p/(w*u_p2)+.5;if(w<=0.||q.x<0.||q.y<0.||q.x>1.||q.y>1.)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);return T(q);

filters.name: Reflection
filters.note: water mirror
passes: float hy=1.-u_p0;if(uv.y>=hy)return c;float dy=hy-uv.y;vec2 q=vec2(uv.x+sin(dy*260.+uv.x*6.)*.004*u_p1*(1.+dy*8.),hy+dy);return vec4(T(q).rgb*(1.-u_p2*smoothstep(0.,.6,dy))*vec3(.92,.97,1.05),1.);

filters.name: Row Shift
filters.note: GIMP Shift
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);bool hz=u_p1<.5;float idx=floor(hz?p.y:p.x);float o=(hash(vec2(idx,1.))-.5)*2.*u_p0;return T(fromPX(p+(hz?vec2(o,0.):vec2(0.,o))));

filters.name: Shuffle Patches
filters.note: random permutation
passes: vec2 g=vec2(u_p0,floor(u_p0/asp()+.5));vec2 ip=floor(uv*g);float id=ip.y*g.x+ip.x;float tot=g.x*g.y;float j=floor(hash(vec2(id,3.))*tot);if(u_p1>.5&&id==tot-1.)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);vec2 src=vec2(mod(j,g.x),floor(j/g.x));return T((src+fract(uv*g))/g);

filters.name: Square ↔ Circle
filters.note: elliptical grid mapping
passes: vec2 p=(uv-.5)*2.;vec2 q;if(u_p0<.5){if(dot(p,p)>1.)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);float s2=2.*sqrt(2.);float u2=p.x*p.x,v2=p.y*p.y;q=vec2(.5*sqrt(max(2.+u2-v2+s2*p.x,0.))-.5*sqrt(max(2.+u2-v2-s2*p.x,0.)),.5*sqrt(max(2.-u2+v2+s2*p.y,0.))-.5*sqrt(max(2.-u2+v2-s2*p.y,0.)));}else q=vec2(p.x*sqrt(1.-p.y*p.y*.5),p.y*sqrt(1.-p.x*p.x*.5));return T(clamp(q*.5+.5,0.,1.));

filters.name: Shatter
filters.note: Voronoi shards
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);float md=9.,md2=9.;vec2 bc=vec2(0.);for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec2 cc=ip+vec2(float(i),float(j));float d=length(p-cc-hash2(cc));if(d<md){md2=md;md=d;bc=cc;}else if(d<md2)md2=d;}vec2 off=(hash2(bc+11.)-.5)*2.*u_p1;float edge=1.-smoothstep(0.,.04,md2-md);return vec4(T(fromPX(PX(uv)+off)).rgb*(1.-edge*.85)*(.9+.2*hash(bc+2.)),1.);

filters.name: Blinds
filters.note: GIMP Distorts
passes: bool hz=u_p2<.5;float s=hz?1.-uv.y:uv.x;float t=fract(s*u_p0);float k=floor(s*u_p0);if(t>u_p1){float g=(t-u_p1)/max(1.-u_p1,1e-3);return vec4(vec3(.82)*(.75+.35*g),1.);}float ss=(k+t/max(u_p1,1e-3))/u_p0;return T(hz?vec2(uv.x,1.-ss):vec2(ss,uv.y));

filters.name: Ministeck
filters.note: plastic peg mosaic
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec2 fq=fract(p)-.5;vec3 col=floor(T(fromPX((ip+.5)*u_p0)).rgb*u_p1+.5)/u_p1;float e=max(abs(fq.x),abs(fq.y));float bev=fq.x<-fq.y?1.12:.86;float gap=smoothstep(.47,.5,e);return vec4(mix(col*mix(1.,bev,smoothstep(.32,.45,e)),vec3(.1),gap),1.);

filters.name: Jigsaw Puzzle
filters.note: GIMP Jigsaw
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec2 fq=fract(p);float sx=hash(vec2(ip.x+1.,ip.y))>.5?1.:-1.;float sy=hash(vec2(ip.x,ip.y+1.)+9.)>.5?1.:-1.;float bx=.18*exp(-pow((fq.y-.5)*6.,2.));float by=.18*exp(-pow((fq.x-.5)*6.,2.));float dx=min(abs(fq.x-bx*sx*.5-1.+step(fq.x,.5)*1.),abs(fq.x-bx*sx*.5));float dy=min(abs(fq.y-by*sy*.5-1.+step(fq.y,.5)*1.),abs(fq.y-by*sy*.5));float d=min(dx,dy);float line=1.-smoothstep(.0,.02,d);float bev=smoothstep(0.,.08,d);return vec4(c.rgb*mix(1.,.75+.3*bev,u_p1)*(1.-line*.7),1.);

filters.name: Make Seamless
filters.note: offset + edge blend
passes: vec2 q=fract(uv+.5);vec3 a=c.rgb,b=T(q).rgb;vec2 e=min(uv,1.-uv);float w=smoothstep(0.,u_p0,min(e.x,e.y));return vec4(mix(b,a,w),1.);

filters.name: Tiled Rotation
filters.note: G’MIC Arrays & Tiles
passes: vec2 g=vec2(u_p0,floor(u_p0/asp()+.5));vec2 ip=floor(uv*g);vec2 fq=fract(uv*g)-.5;int m=int(u_p2+.5);float a=radians(u_p1)*(m==0?1.:m==1?(mod(ip.x+ip.y,2.)*2.-1.):(hash(ip)*2.-1.));vec2 q=rot(fq*vec2(asp(),1.),a)/vec2(asp(),1.);return T((ip+clamp(q+.5,0.,1.))/g);

filters.name: Tiled Effects
filters.note: per-tile processing

filters.name: Array Variations
filters.note: G’MIC Arrays & Tiles
passes: vec2 g=vec2(u_p1);vec2 ip=floor(uv*g);vec2 fq=fract(uv*g);int m=int(u_p0+.5);if(m==0){fq=mix(fq,1.-fq,vec2(mod(ip.x,2.),mod(ip.y,2.)));return T(fq);}if(m==1){float d=length((ip+.5)/g-.5);return vec4(mix(T(fq).rgb,vec3(1.),smoothstep(0.,.7,d)*.8),1.);}if(m==2){vec2 fl=step(.5,hash2(ip));return T(mix(fq,1.-fq,fl));}vec3 h=rgb2hsv(T(fq).rgb);h.x=fract(h.x+hash(ip));return vec4(hsv2rgb(h),1.);

filters.name: Grid Overlay
filters.note: cell outlines
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p1;int m=int(u_p0+.5);float d;if(m==0){vec2 f2=abs(fract(p)-.5);d=(.5-max(f2.x,f2.y));}else if(m==1){vec2 r=vec2(1.,1.7320508);vec2 a=mod(p,r)-r*.5,b=mod(p-r*.5,r)-r*.5;vec2 gg=dot(a,a)<dot(b,b)?a:b;gg=abs(gg);d=.5-max(dot(gg,vec2(.5,.8660254)),gg.x);}else{vec2 q=vec2(p.x+p.y*.57735,p.y*1.1547);vec3 t=vec3(fract(q.x),fract(q.y),fract(q.x-q.y));d=min(min(min(t.x,1.-t.x),min(t.y,1.-t.y)),min(t.z,1.-t.z))*.866;}float ln=1.-smoothstep(0.,u_p2/u_p1,d);return vec4(mix(c.rgb,vec3(.05),ln),1.);

filters.name: Chessboard
filters.note: G’MIC Arrays & Tiles
passes: vec2 ip=floor(PX(uv)/u_p0);bool k=mod(ip.x+ip.y,2.)>.5;return k?vec4(u_p1<.5?1.-c.rgb:c.rgb*.45,1.):c;

filters.name: Dice
filters.note: luma → pips 1–6
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec2 fq=fract(p)-.5;float l=luma(T(fromPX((ip+.5)*u_p0)).rgb);int n=int(clamp(7.-floor(l*6.)-1.,1.,6.));float dot_=0.;vec2 pts[7]=vec2[7](vec2(0.),vec2(-.25,-.25),vec2(.25,.25),vec2(-.25,.25),vec2(.25,-.25),vec2(-.25,0.),vec2(.25,0.));for(int i=0;i<7;i++){bool on=(n==1&&i==0)||(n==2&&(i==1||i==2))||(n==3&&i<3)||(n==4&&i>0&&i<5)||(n==5&&i<5)||(n==6&&i>0);if(on)dot_=max(dot_,smoothstep(.09,.07,length(fq-pts[i])));}float face=step(max(abs(fq.x),abs(fq.y)),.45);return vec4(mix(vec3(.15),mix(vec3(.96),vec3(.05),dot_),face),1.);

filters.name: Zoom
filters.note: scale about a point
passes: vec2 ctr=vec2(u_p1,1.-u_p2);vec2 q=(uv-ctr)/u_p0+ctr;if(q.x<0.||q.y<0.||q.x>1.||q.y>1.)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);return T(q);

filters.name: Low Poly
filters.note: jittered triangle mesh
passes:
vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec2 v00=ip+(hash2(ip)-.5)*u_p1*.8,v10=ip+vec2(1.,0.)+(hash2(ip+vec2(1.,0.))-.5)*u_p1*.8,v01=ip+vec2(0.,1.)+(hash2(ip+vec2(0.,1.))-.5)*u_p1*.8,v11=ip+1.+(hash2(ip+1.)-.5)*u_p1*.8;
  vec2 cen;vec2 a0=v10-v01;float side=a0.x*(p.y-v01.y)-a0.y*(p.x-v01.x);cen=side>0.?(v00+v10+v01)/3.:(v11+v10+v01)/3.;return T(fromPX(cen*u_p0));

filters.name: Quadtree Abstraction
filters.note: variance split
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);float sz=u_p0;vec3 col=c.rgb;vec2 cell;for(int lv=0;lv<7;lv++){cell=floor(p/sz);vec3 m=vec3(0.);float v=0.;for(int j=0;j<4;j++)for(int i=0;i<4;i++){vec3 s=T(fromPX((cell+(vec2(float(i),float(j))+.5)/4.)*sz)).rgb;m+=s;v+=dot(s,s);}m/=16.;v=v/16.-dot(m,m);col=m;if(v<u_p1||sz<4.)break;sz*=.5;}vec2 fq=fract(p/sz);float e=min(min(fq.x,1.-fq.x),min(fq.y,1.-fq.y))*sz;return vec4(mix(col,col*.3,u_p2*(1.-smoothstep(0.,1.2,e))),1.);

filters.name: Van Gogh (LIC)
filters.note: line integral convolution
passes: vec2 pos=uv;vec3 acc=vec3(0.);float w=0.;for(int dir=0;dir<2;dir++){pos=uv;float sg=dir==0?1.:-1.;for(int i=0;i<14;i++){vec2 v;if(u_p1<.5){vec2 g=sobel(pos);v=length(g)>1e-4?normalize(vec2(-g.y,g.x)):vec2(1.,0.);}else{float a=fbm(PX(pos)*.01)*12.;v=vec2(cos(a),sin(a));}pos+=sg*v*R(u_p0)/14.*u_px;float n=hash(floor(PX(pos)));acc+=T(pos).rgb*(.7+.6*n);w+=1.;}}return vec4(acc/w,1.);

filters.name: Brushify
filters.note: strokes follow edges
passes: vec2 g=sobel(uv);vec2 t=length(g)>1e-4?normalize(vec2(-g.y,g.x)):vec2(1.,0.);vec2 nrm=vec2(-t.y,t.x);vec3 acc=vec3(0.);for(int i=-6;i<=6;i++)acc+=T(uv+(t*float(i)/6.*R(u_p0)*.5+nrm*(hash(floor(PX(uv)/u_p1))-.5)*R(u_p1))*u_px).rgb;vec3 k=acc/13.;float bump=strokeTex(PX(uv),atan(t.y,t.x),.06,.6);return vec4(k*(.88+.24*bump),1.);

filters.name: Circle Abstraction
filters.note: dots sized by luma
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec2 fq=fract(p)-.5;vec3 col=T(fromPX((ip+.5)*u_p0)).rgb;float r=.18+.32*luma(col);int m=int(u_p1+.5);vec3 bg=m==0?vec3(0.):m==1?vec3(1.):blur5(uv,R(u_p0)*.4)*.6;return vec4(mix(bg,col,smoothstep(r+.03,r-.03,length(fq))),1.);

filters.name: Ellipsionism
filters.note: oriented ellipses
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec3 col=blur5(uv,R(u_p0)*.3)*.4;for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec2 cc=ip+vec2(float(i),float(j));vec2 ct=cc+.2+hash2(cc)*.6;vec2 g=sobelD(fromPX(ct*u_p0),2.);float a=atan(g.y,g.x)+1.5708;vec2 d=rot(p-ct,a);d.x/=u_p1*.5;if(length(d)<.5)col=T(fromPX(ct*u_p0)).rgb;}return vec4(col,1.);

filters.name: Cubism
filters.note: rotated facets
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec3 col=c.rgb*.8;for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec2 cc=ip+vec2(float(i),float(j));vec2 ct=cc+hash2(cc);vec2 d=rot(p-ct,radians(u_p1)*(hash(cc+3.)-.5)*2.);if(max(abs(d.x),abs(d.y))<.55+.3*hash(cc+7.))col=T(fromPX((ct+d*.7)*u_p0)).rgb;}return vec4(col,1.);

filters.name: Felt Pen
filters.note: marker drawing
passes: vec3 k=floor(kuwa(uv,u_p1)*u_p0+.5)/u_p0;float e=smoothstep(.25,.6,length(sobelD(uv,R(1.))));float tex=strokeTex(PX(uv),.4,.12,1.2);return vec4(mix(k*(.92+.12*tex),vec3(.08),e*.85),1.);

filters.name: Doodle
filters.note: scribbled lines
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);float l=luma(blur5(uv,R(1.)));float a=.6+(vnoise(p*.01)-.5)*u_p1*2.;vec2 q=rot(p,a);float w=abs(fract((q.y+vnoise(q*.05)*u_p1*8.)/u_p0)-.5)*2.;float ink=1.-smoothstep((1.-l)*.9,(1.-l)*.9+.15,w);return vec4(vec3(1.-ink*.9),1.);

filters.name: Freaky B&W
filters.note: local-contrast monochrome
passes: vec3 b=blur5(uv,R(6.));float l=luma(c.rgb);float d=l-luma(b);float v=clamp(.5+d*u_p0*4.+(l-.5)*.6,0.,1.);return vec4(vec3(v),1.);

filters.name: Ghost
filters.note: blurred double image
passes: vec2 o=vec2(u_p0,-u_p1)*u_k*u_px;vec3 g=blur5(uv-o,R(u_p2)*.5);return vec4(screen(c.rgb*.85,g*.6),1.);

filters.name: Fractalize
filters.note: self-similar blend
passes: vec3 acc=c.rgb;float w=1.;float s=1.;for(int i=0;i<4;i++){if(float(i)>=u_p0)break;s*=u_p1;vec3 t=T(fract((uv-.5)/s+.5)).rgb;acc+=t*s;w+=s;}return vec4(acc/w,1.);

filters.name: Glass Tile
filters.note: GIMP Artistic
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec2 fq=fract(p)-.5;return T(fromPX((ip+.5-fq)*u_p0));

filters.name: Light Rays
filters.note: god rays
passes: vec2 ctr=vec2(u_p1,1.-u_p2);vec3 acc=vec3(0.);for(int i=0;i<40;i++){vec2 q=mix(uv,ctr,float(i)/39.*u_p0);vec3 s=T(q).rgb;acc+=s*smoothstep(u_p3,u_p3+.2,luma(s));}return vec4(screen(c.rgb,acc/40.*1.6),1.);

filters.name: Hope Poster
filters.note: 4-tone poster

filters.name: Light Patch
filters.note: dappled light
passes: float n=fbm(PX(uv)/u_p0);return vec4(c.rgb*(1.+(n-.5)*u_p1*1.6),1.);

filters.name: Linify
filters.note: wave lines by darkness
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);float row=floor(p.y/u_p0);float y0=(row+.5)*u_p0;float d=1.-luma(T(fromPX(vec2(p.x,y0))).rgb);float wave=sin(p.x*(.05+d*.25))*d*u_p1*u_p0*.45;float dist=abs(p.y-(y0+wave));float th=.3+d*1.5;return vec4(vec3(smoothstep(th-.4,th+.4,dist)),1.);

filters.name: Pop Shadows
filters.note: offset ink shadow
passes: vec3 k=floor(c.rgb*u_p1+.5)/u_p1;float e=smoothstep(.25,.5,length(sobel(uv-vec2(1.,-1.)*R(u_p0)*u_px)));return vec4(mix(sat(k,1.3),vec3(.05),e*.85),1.);

filters.name: Rodilius
filters.note: directional max streaks
passes: vec3 best=vec3(0.);for(int a=0;a<8;a++){if(float(a)>=u_p1)break;float ang=PI*float(a)/u_p1;vec2 d=vec2(cos(ang),sin(ang))*R(u_p0)*u_px;vec3 acc=vec3(0.);for(int i=0;i<12;i++){acc+=T(uv+d*(float(i)/11.-.5)).rgb;}best=max(best,acc/12.);}return vec4(best+(best-c.rgb)*u_p2*.3,1.);

filters.name: Shapeism
filters.note: shapes sized by darkness
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec2 fq=fract(p)-.5;vec3 col=T(fromPX((ip+.5)*u_p0)).rgb;float s=.1+.32*(1.-luma(col));int m=int(u_p1+.5);float d=m==0?max(abs(fq.x),abs(fq.y)):m==1?max(abs(fq.x)*.866+fq.y*.5,-fq.y):abs(fq.x)+abs(fq.y);return vec4(mix(vec3(.95),col,step(d,s)),1.);

filters.name: Slice Luminosity
filters.note: bands shifted by tone
passes: float l=luma(c.rgb);float band=floor(l*u_p0);return T(uv+vec2((band/u_p0-.5)*2.*R(u_p1),0.)*u_px);

filters.name: Sparkle
filters.note: star spikes on highlights
passes: vec3 acc=vec3(0.);for(int a=0;a<8;a++){if(float(a)>=u_p2)break;float ang=PI*float(a)/u_p2+.3;vec2 d=vec2(cos(ang),sin(ang))*u_px;for(int i=1;i<=16;i++){float t=float(i)/16.;vec3 s=T(uv+d*t*R(u_p1)).rgb+T(uv-d*t*R(u_p1)).rgb;acc+=s*smoothstep(u_p0,1.,luma(s*.5))*(1.-t)*.12;}}return vec4(screen(c.rgb,acc),1.);

filters.name: Supernova
filters.note: GIMP Light and Shadow
passes: vec2 p=(uv-vec2(u_p0,1.-u_p1))*vec2(asp(),1.);float r=length(p);float a=atan(p.y,p.x);float spokes=pow(hash(vec2(floor(a*40.),1.)),6.)*.8+.2;float glow=u_p2/(r+.002)*.15;float ray=spokes*u_p2*2./(r+.01)*.08;vec3 col=hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p3/360.,.5,1.));return vec4(c.rgb+col*(ray+glow)+vec3(1.)*smoothstep(u_p2*.5,0.,r),1.);

filters.name: Weave
filters.note: basket weave
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec2 fq=fract(p);bool over=mod(ip.x+ip.y,2.)<.5;float t=over?fq.y:fq.x;float sh=1.-u_p1*(pow(abs(t-.5)*2.,2.)*.6);float gap=step(.92,max(fq.x,fq.y));return vec4(c.rgb*sh*(1.-gap*.5),1.);

filters.name: Vector Painting
filters.note: flat color regions
passes: vec3 k=kuwa(uv,u_p1);vec3 h=rgb2hsv(k);h=floor(h*vec3(u_p0*2.,u_p0,u_p0)+.5)/vec3(u_p0*2.,u_p0,u_p0);return vec4(hsv2rgb(h),1.);

filters.name: Bokeh Lights
filters.note: discs from highlights
passes: vec3 acc=vec3(0.);for(int i=0;i<48;i++){float fi=float(i);float rr=sqrt((fi+.5)/48.)*R(u_p1);float a=fi*2.39996;vec3 s=T(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*rr*u_px).rgb;acc+=s*smoothstep(u_p0,u_p0+.15,luma(s));}return vec4(screen(c.rgb,acc/48.*2.5),1.);

filters.name: Frame
filters.note: 8 border styles

filters.name: Old Photograph
filters.note: deckled print
passes: vec2 a=vec2(asp(),1.);vec2 q=uv*a;vec2 e=min(q,a-q);float dist=min(e.x,e.y);float n=fbm(PX(uv)*.15);if(dist<u_p0*(.8+.4*n))return vec4(vec3(.96,.94,.88)*(.9+.1*n),1.);vec3 s=vec3(dot(c.rgb,vec3(.393,.769,.189)),dot(c.rgb,vec3(.349,.686,.168)),dot(c.rgb,vec3(.272,.534,.131)));vec3 x=mix(c.rgb,s,u_p1)*(1.-u_p1*.25*smoothstep(.2,.7,length((uv-.5)*a)))+(hash(floor(PX(uv)))-.5)*.08*u_p1;return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Film Slide
filters.note: GIMP Decor
passes: vec2 a=vec2(asp(),1.);if(u_p0<.5){float y=uv.y;if(y>.12&&y<.88)return vec4(c.rgb,1.);vec2 p=PX(uv);float hole=step(abs(fract(p.x/40.)-.5),.17)*step(abs(abs(y-.5)-.44),.025);return vec4(mix(vec3(.08,.06,.04),vec3(.9,.85,.7),hole),1.);}vec2 q=uv*a;vec2 e=min(q,a-q);float dist=min(e.x,e.y);if(dist>.09)return c;return vec4(vec3(.93)*(.9+.1*smoothstep(.07,.09,dist)),1.);

filters.name: Coffee Stain
filters.note: GIMP Decor
passes: vec3 x=c.rgb;for(int i=0;i<6;i++){if(float(i)>=u_p0)break;vec2 ct=vec2(hash1(float(i)*3.1),hash1(float(i)*5.7));float r=.08+.12*hash1(float(i)+9.);vec2 d=(uv-ct)*vec2(asp(),1.);float dd=length(d)+(vnoise(d*30.+float(i))-.5)*.02;float ring=smoothstep(.012,0.,abs(dd-r))*.9+smoothstep(r,r*.6,dd)*.25;x*=mix(vec3(1.),vec3(.78,.62,.42),ring*u_p1);}return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Tunnel
filters.note: nested copies
passes: vec2 p=uv-.5;float s=1.;vec2 q=p;for(int i=0;i<12;i++){if(float(i)>=u_p0)break;if(max(abs(q.x),abs(q.y))<.5*u_p1){q/=u_p1;s*=u_p1;}}return vec4(T(q+.5).rgb*(.6+.4*sqrt(s)),1.);

filters.name: Edge Wear Mask
filters.note: convex edges + noise
passes: vec2 p=u_px*R(2.);float lap=L(uv+vec2(p.x,0.))+L(uv-vec2(p.x,0.))+L(uv+vec2(0.,p.y))+L(uv-vec2(0.,p.y))-4.*L(uv);float convex=clamp(-lap*12.,0.,1.);float n=fbm(PX(uv)*.08);return vec4(vec3(smoothstep(1.-u_p0,1.-u_p0+.2,convex+(n-.5)*u_p1)),1.);

filters.name: Metallic Mask
filters.note: low saturation + bright
passes: vec3 h=rgb2hsv(c.rgb);float m=(1.-smoothstep(.1,.35,h.y))*smoothstep(u_p0-.2,u_p0+.2,h.z);return vec4(vec3(m),1.);

filters.name: Emissive Mask
filters.note: bright saturated areas
passes: float m=smoothstep(u_p0,u_p0+.1,luma(c.rgb))*smoothstep(.1,.3,rgb2hsv(c.rgb).y+.2);return vec4(u_p1<.5?vec3(m):c.rgb*m,1.);

filters.name: Opacity Mask
filters.note: luma key
passes: float m=smoothstep(u_p0-u_p1,u_p0+u_p1+.001,luma(c.rgb));return vec4(vec3(u_p2>.5?1.-m:m),1.);

filters.name: Thickness
filters.note: inverted occlusion
passes: float h=L(uv);float acc=0.;for(int i=0;i<24;i++){float fi=float(i);float a=fi*2.39996;float rr=R(u_p0)*sqrt((fi+.5)/24.);acc+=L(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*rr*u_px);}return vec4(vec3(clamp(1.-(h-acc/24.)*2.-(1.-h)*.5,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Bent Normals
filters.note: normal bent to open sky
passes: float h=L(uv);vec2 g=sobel(uv)*u_p1;vec3 n=normalize(vec3(-g,1.));vec2 open=vec2(0.);for(int i=0;i<16;i++){float a=float(i)*.3927;vec2 d=vec2(cos(a),sin(a));float s=L(uv+d*R(u_p0)*u_px);open+=d*clamp(h-s+.5,0.,1.);}vec3 b=normalize(n+vec3(open*.08,0.));return vec4(b*.5+.5,1.);

filters.name: Histogram Overlay
filters.note: 64 bins, sampled
passes: if(uv.y>u_p1)return c;float bin=floor(uv.x*64.);vec3 cnt=vec3(0.);for(int j=0;j<24;j++)for(int i=0;i<24;i++){vec3 s=O(vec2(float(i)+.5,float(j)+.5)/24.).rgb;if(u_p0<.5){cnt+=vec3(step(abs(floor(luma(s)*63.99)-bin),.1));}else{cnt+=step(abs(floor(s*63.99)-bin),vec3(.1));}}vec3 hgt=cnt/576.*16.;float y=uv.y/u_p1;vec3 bar=step(vec3(y),hgt);vec3 bg=c.rgb*.35;return vec4(u_p0<.5?mix(bg,vec3(.95),bar.x):bg+bar*.85,1.);

filters.name: Intarsia Knit
filters.note: knitting chart
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/vec2(u_p0,u_p0*.8);vec2 ip=floor(p);vec2 fq=fract(p);vec3 col=floor(T(fromPX((ip+.5)*vec2(u_p0,u_p0*.8))).rgb*u_p1+.5)/u_p1;float v=abs(fq.x-.5)*2.;float stitch=smoothstep(.0,.15,abs(fq.y-(.25+v*.6)))*smoothstep(1.,.85,fq.y);float sh=.75+.35*(1.-abs(fq.x-.5)*2.);return vec4(col*sh*mix(.6,1.,stitch),1.);

filters.name: Fractal
filters.note: escape-time

filters.name: Exact Fractals
filters.note: bit tricks + Hilbert index

filters.name: Gradient
filters.note: 6 gradient types

filters.name: Pattern
filters.note: 16 tiling patterns

filters.name: Procedural Texture
filters.note: 19 generators

filters.name: Parametric Curves
filters.note: analytic + sampled SDF

filters.name: Lightning
filters.note: fbm-displaced bolts
passes: vec2 p=uv*vec2(asp(),1.);float x0=u_p2*asp();float glow=0.;for(int b=0;b<7;b++){if(float(b)>u_p1)break;float fb=float(b);float y0=b==0?1.:hash1(fb)*.7+.2;float sx=b==0?x0:x0+(fbm(vec2(y0*4.,0.))-.5)*1.2*.5;if(p.y>y0)continue;float off=(fbm(vec2(p.y*6.+fb*13.,fb))-.5)*.45*(b==0?1.:.6)+(b==0?0.:(y0-p.y)*(hash1(fb+3.)-.5)*1.2);float d=abs(p.x-sx-off);glow+=(b==0?1.:.5)*(.0015/(d+.001)+.02/(d+.03));}vec3 col=u_p0<.5?mix(vec3(.7,.75,1.),vec3(1.),.5):hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p3/360.,.8,1.));return vec4(c.rgb*.75+col*glow*.6,1.);

filters.name: 2D Shapes
filters.note: silhouettes over image

filters.name: Shape Packing
filters.note: random packing
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p1;vec2 ip=floor(p);vec3 col=vec3(.06);int t=int(u_p0+.5);for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){vec2 cc=ip+vec2(float(i),float(j));vec2 ct=cc+.5+(hash2(cc)-.5)*.3;vec2 sz=vec2(.25+.45*hash(cc+3.),.25+.45*hash(cc+5.));if(t==2)sz=vec2(sz.x);vec2 d=p-ct;float inside=t==0?step(max(abs(d.x)/sz.x,abs(d.y)/sz.y),1.):step(length(d/sz),1.);if(inside>.5)col=u_p2<.5?T(fromPX(ct*u_p1)).rgb:hsv2rgb(vec3(hash(cc+9.),.65,.95));}return vec4(col,1.);

filters.name: Bayer Filter Mosaic
filters.note: RGGB sensor mosaic
passes: vec2 px=floor(uv*u_res);bool ex=mod(px.x,2.)<.5,ey=mod(px.y,2.)<.5;return vec4(ex&&ey?vec3(0.,c.g,0.):(!ex&&!ey)?vec3(0.,c.g,0.):ex?vec3(c.r,0.,0.):vec3(0.,0.,c.b),1.);

filters.name: Depth Map
filters.note: Depth Anything V2 / sample map
passes: float d=clamp((D(uv)-.5)*u_p1+.5,0.,1.);int m=int(u_p0+.5);if(m==0)return vec4(vec3(d),1.);if(m==1)return vec4(vec3(1.-d),1.);if(m==2)return vec4(ramp(1,d),1.);float l=fract(d*16.);return vec4(mix(c.rgb,vec3(1.,.8,.2),1.-smoothstep(0.,.08,min(l,1.-l))),1.);

filters.name: Depth of Field
filters.note: Photoshop Depth Blur style
passes: float coc=clamp((abs(D(uv)-u_p0)-u_p2)*3.,0.,1.)*R(u_p1);vec3 acc=c.rgb;float ws=1.;for(int i=0;i<72;i++){float fi=float(i);float rr=sqrt((fi+.5)/72.)*R(u_p1);vec2 q=uv+vec2(cos(fi*2.39996),sin(fi*2.39996))*rr*u_px;float cs=clamp((abs(D(q)-u_p0)-u_p2)*3.,0.,1.)*R(u_p1);float w=step(rr,max(coc,cs)+.5)*(1.+pow(luma(T(q).rgb),4.)*6.);acc+=T(q).rgb*w;ws+=w;}return vec4(acc/ws,1.);

filters.name: Depth Fog
filters.note: aerial perspective
passes: float far=1.-D(uv);float fg=smoothstep(u_p1,1.,far)*u_p0;vec3 col=hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p2/360.,.25,u_p3));return vec4(mix(c.rgb,col,fg),1.);

filters.name: Normals from Depth
filters.note: surface normals
passes: vec3 n=depthNormal(uv,u_p0);if(u_p1>.5)n.y=-n.y;return vec4(n*.5+.5,1.);

filters.name: Depth Relight
filters.note: virtual light on 3D shape
passes: vec3 n=depthNormal(uv,u_p2);float az=radians(u_p0),el=radians(u_p1);vec3 ld=normalize(vec3(cos(az)*cos(el),sin(az)*cos(el),sin(el)));float df=max(dot(n,ld),0.);return vec4(c.rgb*(u_p3+(1.-u_p3)*1.6*df),1.);

filters.name: Anaglyph 3D
filters.note: wear red/cyan glasses
passes: float sh=R(u_p0)*u_px.x;vec2 ql=uv,qr=uv;for(int i=0;i<3;i++){ql.x=uv.x+(D(ql)-u_p1)*sh;qr.x=uv.x-(D(qr)-u_p1)*sh;}vec3 l=T(ql).rgb,r=T(qr).rgb;int m=int(u_p2+.5);if(m==1){l=vec3(luma(l));r=vec3(luma(r));}if(m==2)return vec4(clamp(dot(l,vec3(.437,.449,.164))+dot(r,vec3(-.011,-.032,-.007)),0.,1.),clamp(dot(l,vec3(-.062,-.062,-.024))+dot(r,vec3(.377,.761,.009)),0.,1.),clamp(dot(l,vec3(-.048,-.050,-.017))+dot(r,vec3(-.026,-.093,1.234)),0.,1.),1.);return vec4(l.r,r.g,r.b,1.);

filters.name: Stereo Pair
filters.note: for VR viewers or free-viewing
passes: int m=int(u_p0+.5);vec2 q;bool left;if(m<2){left=uv.x<.5;q=vec2(fract(uv.x*2.),uv.y);if(m==1)left=!left;}else{left=uv.y>.5;q=vec2(uv.x,fract(uv.y*2.));}float sh=R(u_p1)*u_px.x*(m<2?2.:1.)*(left?1.:-1.);vec2 s=q;for(int i=0;i<3;i++)s.x=q.x+(D(s)-u_p2)*sh;return T(s);

filters.name: 3D Photo (Parallax)
filters.note: animated motions loop live
passes: int m=int(u_p0+.5);float t=u_time;vec2 dir=m==0?vec2(u_p2,u_p3):m==1?vec2(sin(t*5.),0.)*sign(u_p2+.001):m==2?vec2(cos(t*1.5),sin(t*1.5)):vec2(0.);vec2 o=dir*R(u_p1)*u_px;vec2 q=uv;if(m==3){float z=sin(t*1.2)*.5+.5;for(int i=0;i<4;i++)q=(uv-.5)/(1.+(D(q)-.3)*z*u_p1/60.)+.5;return T(q);}for(int i=0;i<5;i++)q=uv-o*(D(q)-.5);return T(clamp(q,0.,1.));

filters.name: Autostereogram (Magic Eye)
filters.note: wall-eyed viewing
passes: vec2 p=PX(uv);float E=u_p0;float x=p.x;for(int i=0;i<60;i++){if(x<E)break;float d=D(fromPX(vec2(x-E*.5,p.y)));float sep=E*(1.-u_p1*d)/(2.-u_p1*d)*2.;x-=sep;}x=mod(x,E);int m=int(u_p2+.5);vec2 cell=floor(vec2(x,p.y));if(m==0)return vec4(vec3(step(.5,hash(cell))),1.);if(m==1)return vec4(hash(cell),hash(cell+3.1),hash(cell+7.7),1.);return T(fromPX(vec2(x+u_res.x/u_k*.4,p.y)));

filters.name: Depth Cutout
filters.note: separate near from far
passes: float m=smoothstep(u_p0-u_p1,u_p0+u_p1+.001,D(uv));int b=int(u_p2+.5);vec3 bg=b==0?vec3(luma(c.rgb))*.85:b==1?blur5(uv,R(8.)):b==2?vec3(1.):b==3?vec3(0.):mix(vec3(.75),vec3(.95),mod(floor(PX(uv).x/16.)+floor(PX(uv).y/16.),2.));return vec4(mix(bg,c.rgb,m),1.);

filters.name: Depth Color Grade
filters.note: warm near, cool far
passes: float d=D(uv);vec3 t=mix(hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p1/360.,.7,1.)),hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p0/360.,.7,1.)),d);return vec4(mix(c.rgb,overlay(c.rgb,t),u_p2),1.);

filters.name: NVIDIA Normal Map Filter
filters.note: NVIDIA Texture Tools plugin

filters.name: Generate Bump Map
filters.note: Photoshop Filter › 3D (pre-2024)
passes:
int s=int(u_p0+.5);int hs=s==1?2:s==2?0:s==3?1:2;float h=Hsrc(uv,hs);float b=0.;for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++)b+=Hsrc(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*max(R(u_p1)*.5,.0)*u_px,hs);b/=25.;float big=0.;for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++)big+=Hsrc(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*R(u_p1+6.)*u_px,hs);big/=25.;
  float v=big+(b-big)*u_p2;v=(v-.5)*u_p3+.5;if(s==1)v=1.-v;return vec4(vec3(clamp(v,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: GIMP Normalmap Plugin
filters.note: 9 kernels, as in the plugin

filters.name: Detail Normal Map
filters.note: CrazyBump / nDo frequency mix

filters.name: Normal → Height
filters.note: integrates the slopes (image = normal map)
passes: float acc=0.;for(int k=0;k<8;k++){vec2 d=vec2(cos(float(k)*.785),sin(float(k)*.785));float hsum=0.;for(int s=1;s<=24;s++){vec2 q=uv-d*float(s)/24.*R(u_p0)*u_px;vec3 n=T(q).rgb*2.-1.;if(u_p2>.5)n.y=-n.y;hsum+=dot(-n.xy/max(n.z,.2),d)*R(u_p0)/24./u_k;}acc+=hsum;}return vec4(vec3(clamp(.5+acc/8.*u_p1*.01,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Normal → Curvature
filters.note: divergence of normals
passes: vec2 e=u_px*max(u_k,1.);float fy=u_p1>.5?-1.:1.;float dx=(T(uv+vec2(e.x,0.)).r-T(uv-vec2(e.x,0.)).r)*2.;float dy=(T(uv+vec2(0.,e.y)).g-T(uv-vec2(0.,e.y)).g)*2.*fy;return vec4(vec3(clamp(.5+(dx+dy)*u_p0*.5,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Normal → AO
filters.note: neighbors facing inward
passes: vec3 n0=normalize(T(uv).rgb*2.-1.);float occ=0.;for(int i=0;i<16;i++){float a=float(i)*.3927;vec2 d=vec2(cos(a),sin(a));vec3 n=normalize(T(uv+d*R(u_p0)*u_px).rgb*2.-1.);occ+=max(0.,dot(n.xy,-d));}occ/=16.;return vec4(vec3(clamp(1.-occ*u_p1*1.5-(1.-n0.z)*.3,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Normal Map Utilities
filters.note: image = normal map
passes: vec3 n=T(uv).rgb*2.-1.;int m=int(u_p0+.5);if(m==0)n.y=-n.y;else if(m==1)n.x=-n.x;else if(m==3)n.xy*=2.;else if(m==4)n.xy*=.5;return vec4(normalize(n)*.5+.5,1.);

filters.name: Normal Map Preview
filters.note: lit clay preview
passes: vec3 n=normalize(T(uv).rgb*2.-1.);if(u_p2>.5)n.y=-n.y;float az=radians(u_p0),el=radians(u_p1);vec3 ld=normalize(vec3(cos(az)*cos(el),sin(az)*cos(el),sin(el)));float df=max(dot(n,ld),0.);float sp=pow(max(dot(n,normalize(ld+vec3(0.,0.,1.))),0.),48.)*u_p3;return vec4(vec3(.72,.7,.68)*(.18+.9*df)+sp,1.);

filters.name: Parallax Occlusion Preview
filters.note: steep parallax, brightness = height
passes:
vec2 vd=vec2(cos(radians(u_p1)),sin(radians(u_p1)))*u_p2;vec2 q=uv;float layer=1.;for(int i=0;i<48;i++){float h=L(q);if(h>=layer)break;layer-=1./48.;q-=vd*u_p0/48.*vec2(1./asp(),1.);}
  vec2 e=u_px*2.;vec3 n=normalize(vec3(-(L(q+vec2(e.x,0.))-L(q-vec2(e.x,0.)))*8.,-(L(q+vec2(0.,e.y))-L(q-vec2(0.,e.y)))*8.,1.));vec3 ld=normalize(vec3(cos(radians(u_p3)),sin(radians(u_p3)),.9));return vec4(T(q).rgb*(.35+.8*max(dot(n,ld),0.)),1.);

filters.name: Packed Channel Map
filters.note: game-engine channel packing

filters.name: Smoothness / Gloss
filters.note: Unity smoothness = 1 − roughness
passes: float m=0.,s2=0.;for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){float l=L(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*u_px);m+=l;s2+=l*l;}m/=9.;float v=u_p1<.5?luma(c.rgb):1.-sqrt(max(s2/9.-m*m,0.))*6.;return vec4(vec3(clamp((v-.5)*u_p0+.5,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Flow Map
filters.note: RG = direction (Unity / Houdini)
passes: vec2 g=vec2(0.);for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++)g+=sobelD(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*R(u_p1)*.5*u_px,1.);g/=25.;int m=int(u_p0+.5);vec2 d=m==0?-g:m==1?vec2(-g.y,g.x):g;d=clamp(d*u_p2,-1.,1.);return vec4(d*.5+.5,0.,1.);

filters.name: Signed Distance Field
filters.note: Valve-style, 0.5 = edge
passes: bool inside=(L(uv)>u_p0)!=(u_p2>.5);float d=u_p1;for(int i=0;i<128;i++){float fi=float(i);float rr=sqrt((fi+.5)/128.)*R(u_p1);float a=fi*2.39996;bool s=(L(uv+vec2(cos(a),sin(a))*rr*u_px)>u_p0)!=(u_p2>.5);if(s!=inside)d=min(d,rr/u_k);}return vec4(vec3(.5+(inside?1.:-1.)*d/u_p1*.5),1.);

filters.name: Color ID Map
filters.note: flat masks for Substance
passes: vec3 h=rgb2hsv(kuwa(uv,u_p1));float hb=floor(h.x*u_p0+.5)/u_p0;float vb=floor(h.z*3.)/3.;float id=hash(vec2(hb*97.,vb*13.+floor(h.y*2.)));return vec4(h.y<.12?vec3(floor(h.z*4.)/4.):hsv2rgb(vec3(fract(hb+id*.37),.9,.95)),1.);

filters.name: Roughness from Normal Variance
filters.note: Toksvig 2004
passes: vec3 acc=vec3(0.);for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++){vec2 q=uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*R(u_p1)*.5*u_px;vec3 n=u_p0<.5?normalize(vec3(-sobelD(q,1.)*u_p3,1.)):normalize(T(q).rgb*2.-1.);acc+=n;}float na=length(acc/25.);float s=mix(1.,64.,1.-u_p2);float ft=na/(na+s*(1.-na));return vec4(vec3(clamp(1.-pow(ft,.25)*(1.-u_p2),0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Gradient (Slope) Map
filters.note: raw dX / dY
passes: vec2 g=sobel(uv)*u_p0*.25;return u_p1<.5?vec4(clamp(g*.5+.5,0.,1.),.5,1.):vec4(vec3(clamp(length(g),0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Matcap Render
filters.note: sculpt-style shading
passes:
vec3 n=u_p1<.5?normalize(vec3(-sobel(uv)*u_p2,1.)):normalize(T(uv).rgb*2.-1.);vec2 m=n.xy*.5+.5;int k=int(u_p0+.5);float l=max(dot(n,normalize(vec3(-.4,.5,.8))),0.);float sp=pow(max(dot(n,normalize(vec3(-.3,.4,1.))),0.),40.);
  if(k==0)return vec4(vec3(.78,.74,.7)*(.25+.8*l)+sp*.15,1.);if(k==1)return vec4(vec3(.75,.12,.1)*(.2+.9*l)+sp*.7,1.);if(k==2)return vec4(vec3(.5+.5*sin(m.y*9.+m.x*3.))*(.4+.6*l)+sp,1.);if(k==3)return vec4(vec3(.25,.6,.4)*(.35+.7*l)+vec3(.1,.25,.15)*(1.-n.z)+sp*.5,1.);return vec4(n*.5+.5,1.);

filters.name: Toon Ramp Lighting
filters.note: cel lighting from height
passes: vec3 n=normalize(vec3(-sobel(uv)*u_p2,1.));vec3 ld=normalize(vec3(cos(radians(u_p1)),sin(radians(u_p1)),.7));float d=max(dot(n,ld),0.);d=floor(d*u_p0+.5)/u_p0;float rim=smoothstep(.6,.9,1.-n.z)*u_p3;return vec4(c.rgb*(.35+.75*d)+rim*.4,1.);

filters.note: GIS shaded relief

filters.name: Slope
filters.note: steepness, 0–90°
passes: vec2 g=sobelD(uv,max(u_k,1.))*u_p0*.125;float s=atan(length(g))/1.5708;return vec4(u_p1<.5?vec3(s):ramp(0,s),1.);

filters.name: Aspect
filters.note: which way slopes face
passes: vec2 g=sobel(uv);if(length(g)<u_p0)return vec4(vec3(.5),1.);return vec4(hsv2rgb(vec3(atan(g.y,g.x)/6.2832+.5,.85,.95)),1.);

filters.name: Terraces
filters.note: stepped height
passes: float h=luma(c.rgb)*u_p0;float t=floor(h)+smoothstep(0.,1.,pow(fract(h),1.+u_p1*8.));float v=t/u_p0;if(u_p2<.5)return vec4(vec3(v),1.);float e=(t/u_p0-v)*0.;vec2 g=sobel(uv);return vec4(vec3(v)*(.75+.25*clamp(1.-length(g)*4.,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Coherent Line Drawing
filters.note: Kang 2007 flow-based DoG
passes: float a=0.,b=0.,cc=0.;for(int j=-2;j<=2;j++)for(int i=-2;i<=2;i++){vec2 g=sobel(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*u_px*max(u_k,1.));a+=g.x*g.x;b+=g.x*g.y;cc+=g.y*g.y;}float l2=.5*(a+cc+sqrt(max((a-cc)*(a-cc)+4.*b*b,0.)));vec2 t=vec2(b,l2-a);t=length(t)>1e-6?normalize(t):vec2(1.,0.);t=vec2(-t.y,t.x);return vec4(t*.5+.5,luma(c.rgb),1.);

vec2 t=T(uv).xy*2.-1.;vec2 n=vec2(-t.y,t.x);float sc=u_p0,ss=u_p0*1.6;float hc=0.,hs=0.,wc=0.,ws=0.;for(int i=-8;i<=8;i++){float x=float(i)*.6;float lv=luma(O(uv+n*x*R(1.)*u_px).rgb);float gc=exp(-x*x/(2.*sc*sc)),gs=exp(-x*x/(2.*ss*ss));hc+=lv*gc;wc+=gc;hs+=lv*gs;ws+=gs;}float H=hc/wc-u_p3*hs/ws;return vec4(H*4.+.5,t*.5+.5,1.);

vec2 p=uv;float acc=0.,w=0.;for(int dir=0;dir<2;dir++){p=uv;float sg=dir==0?1.:-1.;for(int i=0;i<10;i++){float x=float(i);float g=exp(-x*x/(2.*u_p1*u_p1));vec4 s=T(p);acc+=(s.r-.5)/4.*g;w+=g;vec2 t=s.gb*2.-1.;p+=sg*t*R(1.)*u_px;}}float H=acc/w;float v=(H<0.&&1.+tanh(H*40.)<u_p2)?0.:1.;return vec4(vec3(v),1.);

filters.name: Ridge / Valley Detector
filters.note: Hessian eigenvalues
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));

vec2 e=u_px*max(u_k,1.);float h=L(uv);float hxx=L(uv+vec2(e.x,0.))+L(uv-vec2(e.x,0.))-2.*h;float hyy=L(uv+vec2(0.,e.y))+L(uv-vec2(0.,e.y))-2.*h;float hxy=(L(uv+e)+L(uv-e)-L(uv+vec2(e.x,-e.y))-L(uv+vec2(-e.x,e.y)))*.25;
  float tr=hxx+hyy,df=sqrt(max((hxx-hyy)*(hxx-hyy)+4.*hxy*hxy,0.));float a1=.5*(tr+df),a2=.5*(tr-df);float l1=abs(a1)<abs(a2)?a1:a2,l2=abs(a1)<abs(a2)?a2:a1;float sc=u_p0*u_p0;int m=int(u_p2+.5);float v=m==0?max(l2,0.):m==1?max(-l2,0.):abs(l2);return vec4(vec3(clamp(v*sc*u_p1,0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Frangi Vesselness
filters.note: Frangi 1998, single scale
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0));

vec2 e=u_px*max(u_k,1.);float h=L(uv);float hxx=L(uv+vec2(e.x,0.))+L(uv-vec2(e.x,0.))-2.*h;float hyy=L(uv+vec2(0.,e.y))+L(uv-vec2(0.,e.y))-2.*h;float hxy=(L(uv+e)+L(uv-e)-L(uv+vec2(e.x,-e.y))-L(uv+vec2(-e.x,e.y)))*.25;
  float tr=hxx+hyy,df=sqrt(max((hxx-hyy)*(hxx-hyy)+4.*hxy*hxy,0.));float a1=.5*(tr+df),a2=.5*(tr-df);float l1=abs(a1)<abs(a2)?a1:a2,l2=abs(a1)<abs(a2)?a2:a1;float sc=u_p0*u_p0;bool dark=u_p2<.5;if(dark?l2<=0.:l2>=0.)return vec4(vec3(0.),1.);float rb=l1/(l2+1e-6);float s2=(l1*l1+l2*l2)*sc*sc*u_p1*u_p1;float v=exp(-rb*rb/.5)*(1.-exp(-s2/(2.*.25)));return vec4(vec3(clamp(v,0.,1.)),1.);

passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
