filters.name: Overlay Emoji (AugLy overlay_emoji)
filters.note: AugLy overlay_emoji -> overlay_image: default emoji twemoji smiling_face_with_heart_eyes, height = int(H*emoji_size) keeping aspect, top-left corner at (int(W*x_pos), int(H*y_pos)), alpha mask scaled by opacity; approx.: the twemoji PNG is redrawn procedurally (yellow face, red heart eyes, open smile with teeth)

filters.name: Clickbait Text Box (AugLy overlay_random_text_with_background)
filters.note: AugLy overlay_random_text_with_background (defaults: font_size 40, scale_factor .5 -> int(40*(.7+1.3*sf)), box_opacity .9, padding 15, solid box, placement bottom, one overlay): phrase from utils.CLICKBAIT_PHRASES, text/box colour schemes as in AugLy (gold, white, yellow, amber on black; black on white), max width .75 W, max height .5 H, line spacing .15 line height, box = text + horizontal padding pad+randint(10,20), reaching the bottom edge for a single bottom overlay; approx.: fixed 2-line wrap, horizontal padding 30, square corners, no rotation, 5x7 bitmap capitals instead of the random social-media font

params.label: Phrase
opts: YOU WON'T BELIEVE WHAT HAPPENED NEXT

filters.name: Ranking Numbers (AugLy ranking_numbers)
filters.note: AugLy ranking_numbers with the docstring example ranking_dict {1: First place, 2: Second place, 3: Third place} (extendable to 5): font size = int(min(W,H)*font_size), entry i at (left_dist, (H//(n+1))*(i+1)), "k." in number_color white then " text" in ranking_color yellow, both with a black stroke of stroke_width px; approx.: 5x7 bitmap capitals (Raleway ExtraBold metrics) replace the TrueType font, so the text is upper-case

filters.name: Cathode Boot CRT Collapse (OBS Retro Effects)
filters.note: port of obs-retro-effects cathode-boot.effect (FiniteSingularity): vertical collapse over progress 0-70 %, horizontal 50-90 %, fade to background 90-100 % (plug-in default ranges, linear clamps); per-axis scale = pn*(thickness-1)+1 snapped to whole pixels, image squeezed into the snapped rectangle and tinted toward the glow colour (white) by max(pn); outside, glow = lerp(background black, white, 1 - sdf/glow_size) on the doubled-pixel rectangle SDF; default progress 60 % here (plug-in default 0 % = untouched frame)

filters.name: Retro Codec RPZA (OBS Retro Effects)
filters.note: port of obs-retro-effects codec.effect RPZA mode (FiniteSingularity, Apple Video 1995): 4x4 Bayer-dithered quantisation floor(c*N + bayer/16)/N, then per 4x4 block: solid mean colour if the summed squared error < (0.2(1-quality))^2, else 4-colour gradient (per-channel least-squares line against the widest-range channel between its min and max, colours at 0, 1/3, 2/3, 1) if its error < (1-quality)^2, else the 16 dithered colours; single frame = keyframe, so the previous-frame skip mode never fires; the plug-in shader also rotates the cross-product sums by channel (probably unintended) - the clean regression is used here

filters.name: Triakis Pixelate (OBS Composite Blur)
filters.note: port of obs-composite-blur pixelate_triakis.effect (FiniteSingularity): rows 1.5w, columns w*cos30, cell split by the tan30 diagonal (direction by row/column parity) into outer and inner triangles (inner split by the 1.13 slope test), each triangle filled with the colour sampled at the centre the shader assigns it; rotation and tessellation origin as in the plug-in; the optional Kawase pre-smoothing is left out

filters.name: Filter Forge Fractal Tilings & Windows (Gosper / Hexaflake / N-Uniform / Persian Rug / Lace / Rose Window / Cloisonne)
filters.note: Filter Forge library filters re-created from their descriptions and control lists (approx. looks, not the filter graphs): Gosper Island (Rachel Duim) = hexagonal seed (triangle of the image mirrored 6x) on every cell of a level-Depth Gosper island (exact 7-hex Eisenstein base-(2-w) digit test); Hexaflake (Rachel Duim) = 7-way hexaflake recursion with the hex seed; N-Uniform Tiles = image-seeded 3.4.6.4 semi-regular tiling (one of the N-uniform family; Depth sets the tile count); Persian Rug 2 (Kraellin) = 4-fold kaleidoscope of the image posterised into a rug palette with motif borders; Lace Table Cloth (Persidio) = doily rings, spokes and scallops plus hex net over the darkened image, with drop shadow; Rose Window (ScaryKitty) = radially symmetric stained glass (rosette, roundels, lancets) with leading, in a stone wall; Cloisonne d Art Nouveau (ScaryKitty) = kaleidoscopic warped Voronoi enamel cells in gold wire inside a round frame; Seed zoom/rotation place the image seed, Seed zoom = leading/thread width for the window and lace

filters.name: Filter Forge Photo Stylizers (Bilevel Screening / Chuck Close / Decoupage / Navajo / Barcode / SX-70 / Etch-A-Sketch / Tattoo)
filters.note: Filter Forge library filters re-created from their descriptions and controls (approx. looks): Bilevel Screening (Kutianski, "two level screening" with High/Low Pass) = low-passed luma + Amount x high-pass, thresholded against a 45-degree dot screen (Detail = screen mix); Chuck Close V2 (Indigo Ray) = square grid, each cell a contrasting background with circle or diamond blobs whose hues scatter around the cell colour (Amount = crazy colours, Detail = circle variance); Decoupage (Persidio) = image glued as shifted torn paper pieces with white edges, glue crack network, varnish yellowing, age vignette; Navajo Weaver (tornadotwins) = image blocks snapped to a Navajo dye palette with weft/warp yarn relief (Detail > .5 = symmetric); Barcode Color Art (jffe) = tiles of image-coloured barcode bars, black-white mix, row shift, rounded tile edges with rivets; SX-70 (pixel8ted) = emulsion pushed by a noise flow with smear and scrape lines, SX-70 colour and Polaroid border; Pocket Etch-A-Sketch (ThreeDee) = red toy frame with knobs, image edges and shading hatch drawn as grey lines on aluminium; Tattoo Me (RPspeeder) = posterised image inked onto textured skin inside a soft elliptical mask with dark outline (Detail = ink age)

filters.name: Filter Forge Image Objects (Bubble Wrap / Coin / Cameo / Snowglobe / Neumorphism)
filters.note: Filter Forge library filters re-created from their descriptions and controls (approx. looks): Bubble Wrap (Bubblewrap 1 by Stefan Beckmann / Super Bubble Wrap by Indigo Ray) = hex-packed hemispherical bubbles refracting the image with specular highlights, foil folds between (Amount = refraction, Variation = folds); Coin Generator (Austy51) = image embossed into a round coin, gold/silver/bronze by Variation, raised reeded rim, patina patches, Amount = shine; Cameo Creator (Foxxee) = bright image areas carved as relief ivory over a shell-coral (or porcelain blue, Variation > .5) ground in a beaded gold oval; JLE Snowglobe = image refracted inside a glass sphere with snow flakes (Amount = density), highlight and a wooden or metallic base; Neumorphism (Martin Naumann) = image thresholded (Amount = percentage) into a soft extruded shape on a light grey UI ground with paired light/dark shadows (Variation = light angle)

filters.name: Filter Forge Overlays (Scorched Parchment / Shoji Screen / Speedliner / Plexus)
filters.note: Filter Forge library filters re-created from their descriptions and controls (approx. looks): Scorched Parchment (Redcap) = image inked onto mottled parchment with noisy burnt edges, char band and singe gradient (Size = burn amount, Amount = singe, Variation = edge roughness); Shoji Screen Lv2 (Zephos) = wooden kumiko lattice and frame over rice paper lit from behind by the blurred image, with shredded holes showing the image (Size = grid, Amount = translucency, Variation = shred); Speedliner Lv2 (Zephos) = manga burst of tapered black speed lines around a clear focus (Size = focus radius, Amount = opacity, Variation = density; > .66 = horizontal streak mode); Plexus (ThreeDee) = jittered points joined by lines when closer than 1.6 cells, glowing nodes, over the darkened blurred image (Size = spacing, Amount = brightness, Variation = colour)

filters.name: Coloured Paper (Augraphy ColorPaper)
filters.note: Augraphy ColorPaper: HSV hue and saturation replaced by one paper hue/saturation (source draws hue 28-45 and saturation 10-40 in OpenCV units, i.e. 56-90 deg and 0.04-0.16) with per-pixel jitter of -J..J-1 OpenCV units; V (lightness) kept
passes:
vec3 v=O(uv).rgb;float V=max(v.r,max(v.g,v.b));vec2 ip=floor(PX(uv));float J=floor(u_p2+.5);
  float h=u_p0/360.+(floor(hash(ip)*2.*J)-J)/180.;float s=clamp(u_p1+(floor(hash(ip+7.1)*2.*J)-J)/255.,0.,1.);return vec4(hsv2rgb(vec3(fract(h),s,V)),1.);

filters.name: Dirty Drum Streaks (Augraphy DirtyDrum)
filters.note: Augraphy DirtyDrum: stripes walked across the page as in create_dirty_mask (width = rand(1..W) x rand(1..5), drawn with probability = concentration, 2x width, step x rand(1..3)); inside each stripe Gaussian clusters of dark points (count ~ area x intensity/150, points ~ area x intensity/70, value 0-30), 3x3 Gaussian blur, darken (min) blend; Both = min of vertical and horizontal masks

filters.name: Dirty Rollers (Augraphy DirtyRollers)
filters.note: Augraphy DirtyRollers: tiled gradient bars (high 86-99 %, low 70-85 %, six variants with 1-6 px dark/light plateaus or a 5-8 % lower floor) for the line mask and a 10-25x wider meta mask; white background (scanline_type 0): a = min(99, s + s(1 - m/100)), out = c a/100; dark background: out = c + c(1 - s m/10^4)

filters.name: Dirty Screen (Augraphy DirtyScreen)
filters.note: Augraphy DirtyScreen: ~750 Gaussian point clusters (10 passes x 50-100 clusters, 2-20 points, std 1-5 px) scattered over the page, each point a random gray in [Value min, +100] (source 150-250), overlapping passes multiplied, composited with OverlayBuilder ink_to_paper (gray foreground, white transparent: out = base g + g(1-g)); clusters on a jittered grid (Density scales the count) - approx. of make_blobs placement

filters.name: Ink Mottling (Augraphy InkMottling)
filters.note: Augraphy InkMottling: ink = pixels below the per-channel threshold in all three channels (source: Otsu per channel; here 3 ISODATA iterations on a 12x12 sample grid, approx.), uniform 0-255 noise on a 1/scale grid, Gaussian-blurred (odd kernel, OpenCV sigma rule), bilinearly upscaled, blended into ink only: c(1-a) + noise a

filters.name: Low-Ink Lines (Augraphy LowInkRandomLines / LowInkPeriodicLines)
filters.note: Augraphy LowInkLine.add_transparency_line: a 1-px row raised to max(pixel, alpha) (consistent: one alpha 16-224 per line; variable: random 0-255 per pixel), rows above/below hit with the noise probability; Random = Count rows uniform over the page (source 5-10); Periodic = Count runs (source 2-5, max 6), spacing = height/Period, each run one strong set (offset 0-5, alpha 96-255) + Count faint sets (random offset, alpha 16-96); rows in working pixels

filters.name: Noisy Lines (Augraphy NoisyLines)
filters.note: Augraphy NoisyLines: Lines full-length black lines at random rows (thickness 1..T px), dashed when thickness > 1 (gap I = rand 0..interval, erased segments [start + 2kI + I, start + 2kI + 2I)), 1-10 % white specks, 5x5 Gaussian blur (sigma 4: the source passes BORDER_DEFAULT as sigmaX), ink_to_paper overlay; Both = horizontal and vertical lines on one mask

filters.name: Page Border Stack (Augraphy PageBorder)
filters.note: Augraphy PageBorder (same_page_border): the page cropped by the border and a stack of copies offset linearly out to the border (np.linspace(border, 0, pages)), each rotated in order (0 for the top page, up to Max rotation for the bottom one), 1-px edge lines in border colour (black) on a black background; random curls and the final 3x3 blur left out (approx.)

filters.name: Section Shift (Augraphy SectionShift)
filters.note: Augraphy SectionShift: N rectangles (sides 5 %..Max size of the page, placed so the shifted copy fits) copied and pasted at an offset of up to +-Max shift px, in order (later sections read the already-shifted page; resolved backwards per pixel); the vacated area keeps its pixels (source default fill -1) or takes a fill colour

filters.name: Reflected Light Glare (Augraphy ReflectedLight)
filters.note: Augraphy ReflectedLight: elliptical glare (random centre, angle, minor/major 0.9-1): core of radius Core x short side at internal brightness 0.9-1, rings of 10 px (smoothness 0.8) whose speckle-keep probability rises linearly from Brightness-1 at the rim to Brightness at the centre, Gaussian blur (OpenCV kernel->sigma rule; here the blurred expectation plus residual speckle, approx.), added to the image (cv2.addWeighted 1,1)

filters.name: LCD Screen Pattern (Augraphy LCDScreenPattern)
filters.note: Augraphy LCDScreenPattern: white canvas with every k-th column / row / (x+y) / (x-y) diagonal (k >= 3) or a 2-px checker cross set to Value (0-16 by default), darken overlay; OverlayBuilder applies its 0.3 alpha only for 4-channel inputs, so 3-channel images get the plain min (Opacity 1)

filters.name: Ink Shifter (Augraphy InkShifter)
filters.note: Augraphy InkShifter: two smooth noise maps of resolution = Scale (source: Perlin, Gaussian-blurred; here value noise with a 3x3 blur, approx.), displacement x = -amp x factor x nx, y = factor x ny (the source draws amp in [0,1) and applies it to x only), remap with white border

filters.name: Shadow Cast (Augraphy ShadowCast)
filters.note: Augraphy ShadowCast: 1-2 shadows hanging from one page side, each a polygon over a random 30-80 % span whose depth (30-80 %) follows Vertices random points (zero at both ends, smoothed), blurred with a large Gaussian at 1/2-1/3 scale (here a soft edge of that width, approx.), blended toward white by opacity (source 0.2-0.9, scaled by Opacity/0.55) and multiplied onto the image

filters.name: Bindings and Fasteners (Augraphy BindingsAndFasteners)
filters.note: Augraphy BindingsAndFasteners (procedural create_foreground, approx. shapes): Count templates evenly spaced along one edge (gap = (L - n size)/(n+1)) at Edge offset px, template size scaled with page area (punch 60, binding 40, clip 120, triangle clip 80 base): noisy dark punch holes with a gray rim, rectangular binding holes, paper clips (two joined loops, rotated +-30 deg), binder-style triangle clips; min overlay

filters.name: High-Pass Bilateral Filter (WhiteboxTools)
filters.note: WhiteboxTools HighPassBilateralFilter: input (mean of R,G,B, 0-1) minus its bilateral filter (Gaussian spatial weight sigma_dist, window out to where the 1-D weight falls to 0.001; Gaussian intensity weight sigma_int); shown as 0.5 + Gain x residual

filters.name: Diversity Filter (WhiteboxTools)
filters.note: WhiteboxTools DiversityFilter: number of distinct values in the n x n window (luma quantised to Levels integer classes, 256 = 8-bit grey values; counted with a 256-bit set), shown as count / min(Levels, n^2)

filters.name: Maximal / Minimal / Tangential Curvature (WhiteboxTools)
filters.note: WhiteboxTools MaximalCurvature / MinimalCurvature / TangentialCurvature: Florinsky (2016) 5x5 partials p,q,r,s,t; k_max,min = H +- sqrt(H^2 - K) with mean H = -((1+q^2)r - 2pqs + (1+p^2)t) / (2(1+p^2+q^2)^1.5), Gaussian K = (rt - s^2)/(1+p^2+q^2)^2; k_tan = -(q^2 r - 2pqs + p^2 t)/((p^2+q^2) sqrt(1+p^2+q^2)); optional Shary log transform sign(k) ln(1 + 10^e |k|); 0.5 + Gain x value

filters.name: Normal / Aspect Dispersion (WhiteboxTools)
filters.note: WhiteboxTools SphericalStdDevOfNormals (sqrt(-2 ln R) in degrees, R = mean resultant length of the unit normals of the Gaussian-smoothed DEM in the window), AverageNormalVectorAngularDeviation (mean angle between normals of the DEM and of the smoothed DEM), CircularVarianceOfAspect (1 - R of the 2-D aspect unit vectors, shown x 90); smoothing sigma = (window/2 + 0.5)/3 (exact Gaussian instead of the 4-box approximation), Horn 3x3 gradients, box window means; output / Range
passes: float n=floor(u_p1);if(mod(n,2.)==0.)n+=1.;float sg=n>3.?(floor(n*.5)+.5)/3.:0.;if(int(u_p0+.5)==1)sg=max(sg,1.);return vec4(L(uv),luma(blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(2.*sg)).rgb),0.,1.);
float n=floor(u_p1);if(mod(n,2.)==0.)n+=1.;float sg=n>3.?(floor(n*.5)+.5)/3.:0.;if(int(u_p0+.5)==1)sg=max(sg,1.);return vec4(T(uv).r,blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(2.*sg)).g,0.,1.);
float n=floor(u_p1);if(mod(n,2.)==0.)n+=1.;return box1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(floor(n*.5)));

filters.name: Relative Aspect (WhiteboxTools)
filters.note: WhiteboxTools RelativeAspect: |180 - atan(q/p) + 90 sign(p) - azimuth| folded into 0 (windward) .. 180 deg (leeward), Florinsky 5x5 partials p,q; flat cells (p = 0, source -1) black

filters.name: Surface Area Ratio (WhiteboxTools)
filters.note: WhiteboxTools SurfaceAreaRatio (Jenness 2004): 3D surface area of the eight centre triangles from halved 3D edge lengths (Heron) over the planar cell area; shown as (ratio - 1) x Gain

filters.name: Lain Shadow Style (DH_Lain)
filters.note: AlucardDH dh_Lain 1.1: pixels darker than the brightness limit get additive overlays scaled by intensity x (1 - brightness/limit)^power (2.5 / 3): a red-forced primary texture and a purple (133,0,174) secondary texture at scale 1.5 (the shipped blood/cloud PNGs replaced by procedural fbm stains/clouds, approx.; no depth scaling), plus an optional red glow from the nearest brighter pixel within 32 px (ring search step 3, source default off), combined by per-channel max

filters.name: Virtual Nose VR Overlay (Depth3D VirtualNose)
filters.note: Depth3D VirtualNose (BlueSkyDefender): procedural nose from two distance fields (bridge 6|x| + |0.75 - 2y| < 1, nostril (5.395x)^2 + (2 - 4.165y)^2 < 1, second set with x x 0.9625 as the alpha mask), width/height/size mapping of the shader (W 0.625, H 0.375, Size adjustable), skin colour table, smoothstep(500 x^2 y^2 + 0.5) shading, 8-tap horizontal edge blur (BlurAdjust 0.5), left/right halves offset by Separation for side-by-side VR, Ambiance = average luma / colour of the left half; dither and the 10-s logo omitted

filters.name: HDR Black Floor Fix (Lilium)
filters.note: Lilium (EndlesslyFlowering) HDR black floor fix, lowering: black point adaption C2 = (C - old)/(rolloff - old), C2 = MinLum (1 - C2)^4 + C2, back to absolute, MinLum = (new - old)/(rolloff - old); applied to luminance in PQ (colour scaled by Y2/Y1), to PQ-encoded RGB, or to linear RGB, only below the roll-off stop; the SDR image is taken as 80-nit scRGB (sRGB decode x 80 nits) for this demo; gamma 2.2 emulation stage not included

filters.name: SDR TRC Fix sRGB vs Gamma 2.2 (Lilium)
filters.note: Lilium SDR TRC fix: decode with the input transfer curve (power gamma or the piecewise sRGB EOTF), re-encode with the target curve (sRGB inverse EOTF or 1/gamma); default power 2.2 -> sRGB; optional BT.1886 black-point step not included

filters.name: Gradient Patch (Notch)
filters.note: Notch Gradient Patch: a Points X x Points Y array of colours (seeded random) with smooth gradients blending between them, applied over the image with an apply mode and alpha (approx. from the manual; colours are set by hand in Notch)

filters.name: Line Distortion (Notch)
filters.note: Notch Line Distortion (manual description, approx.): every pixel brighter than Threshold emits a line in the Rotation direction whose length grows with its luminance (up to Amount px); lines lie on 1-px lanes Sparseness px apart; the brightest emitter reaching a lane pixel wins; Line Wave and Line Width controls not included

filters.name: Feedback Blur Line Trail (Notch)
filters.note: Notch Feedback Blur (manual description, approx.): a line across the image (Rotation, Stretch position) from which the picture is smeared outward, blur length = Blur scale x distance from the line, effect fading with Stretch falloff; previous-frame feedback (multi-frame) not included

filters.name: Fuzz Stroke (Acorn)
filters.note: Acorn Fuzz Stroke ("adds a fuzzy stroke to the edges of your layer"; the layer is the whole image here): a stroke inward from the image edges whose width wanders with fbm and whose inner edge breaks into random fibres (approx.)

filters.name: Volumetric Explosion (Matchbox crok_explosion_CFX)
filters.note: crok_explosion_CFX (Ivar Beer after Duke's "Volumetric explosion"): ray-marched density = sphere + 4-octave value fbm + otaviogood spiral noise (Detail iterations), additive bloom, front-to-back accumulation with the Matchbox carry-over of the front colour; explosion centred, camera at z=-6 (Action camera / Z-depth input replaced by a fixed screen-space camera, approx.)

filters.name: Sky Timelapse Generator (Matchbox JB_skyLapse)
filters.note: JB_skyLapse: perspective cloud plane (x/(y), 1/(y+0.2)) with domain-warped 5-octave value fbm (linear interpolation, alternating signs), sky colour + cloud density, aperture exposure mix toward warm white; Time scrolls the clouds

filters.name: Phone Camera Mockup Matte (Matchbox MM_PhoneMatte)
filters.note: MM_PhoneMatte: rounded-rectangle phone body SDF (frame-height units, aspect-corrected) minus a camera cut-out (lozenge, waterdrop = circle + segment-SDF triangle, or traced notch = rect with two subtracted fillet ellipses + capsule), Edge Softness 0.0015, hole at (0, 0.42) size 0.035; the matte multiplies the image (source outputs it as alpha)

filters.name: Amiga Parallax Texture Scroller (Matchbox crok_parallax)
filters.note: crok_parallax: layers i = 1..Layers sample the texture input (here the image, repeat-wrapped) at zoom Spacing/i with per-layer offsets, threshold smoothstep(0.9,1,s*Intensity) paints white, the matte keeps 1/i of the last layer hit (depth); rotation -15 (x0.01 rad), time 0; layer 0 (1/0 zoom) skipped

filters.name: Hypnotic Spiral (Matchbox crok_client)
filters.note: crok_client (after FabriceNeyret2 ldBGDc): v = clamp(sin(200*(sqrt(r) - 0.02*angle - 0.5*t)),0,1)
passes: vec2 q=uv-.5;q.x*=asp();float r=length(q),a=atan(q.y,q.x);return vec4(vec3(clamp(sin(u_p0*(sqrt(r)-u_p1*a-.5*u_p2*.05)),0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Beer Foam Structure (Matchbox crok_beer)
filters.note: crok_beer (Redexe glslsandbox 15616): 6 ray samples of the "wind" kaliset field abs(p)/dot(p,p)-0.7 around a perturbed sphere, glow 1.5, brightness 0.8, tint (1,.65,.35), radial falloff and length(col)*50 contrast; noise-texture dither input = white

filters.name: Ice Structures (Matchbox crok_ice)
filters.note: crok_ice (after simesgreen Msf3Dj "sphere tracing transparent stuff"): sphere-trace through d = fbm*0.8 + 0.2*Offset (4 fbm variants exactly as the Matchbox, Detail = smoothstep exponent), sum the distance travelled inside, colour = exp(-dist^2*(2.4,0.6,0.3)), saturation 0.3; Lightbox camera replaced by a screen-space perspective ray from a seeded origin (approx.)

filters.name: Ocean Noise Pattern (Matchbox crok_ocean_noise)
filters.note: crok_ocean_noise (pixelshaders.com noise): per channel nested moving noise n(p+(n(p),n(p+10))), 8-octave smooth value noise, channel zooms 0.5/2.5/15 x Zoom and offsets 1/8/3, then saturation, contrast about 0.5 and brightness offset as in the Matchbox (time 0, tint off)

filters.name: Folding Reflection-Map Texture (Matchbox crok_folding)
filters.note: crok_folding: iterated sine folding of the zoomed coordinate (Noise, Detail, Iterations), output abs(colour) x (0.9,0.95,1.0); Offset = the time phase

filters.name: Colour-Proximity Dilate / Erode (Matchbox Ls_Dilate)
filters.note: Ls_Dilate (lewis saunders): separable H then V morphological dilate (Size>0) / erode (Size<0) with non-flat structuring element (box, AA box, triangle, ball, gaussian weights added before max/min, support 3x size); Weight by colour = pick the neighbour closest to (dilate) or farthest from (erode) the screen colour within the box; Stretch splits size between axes; strength map = 1; vertical pass uses its own size sign

filters.name: fr-025 the.popular.demo Tribute (Matchbox the_popular_demo)
filters.note: the_popular_demo (fizzer, after Farbrausch fr-025): ray-cast disco corridor (pillar circles + unit-square slab walls with 8x8 square-pattern texture, one reflection bounce) and a 15-step sphere-traced walking robot (2-bone IK legs/arms from capsules, soft-min joins, box torso, sphere head); Time = demo time (scene fades in from white during the first ~2 s of each 30 s loop)

filters.name: Broken LCD (ISF)
filters.note: ISF Broken LCD (VIDVOX): 4-octave iq value-noise blotches (blocky where a random blockness > smoothness 0.5) beyond a radius pick dead-pixel patterns (RGB 4/5/7-px lines, vertical, horizontal, stripes, checkerboard, colour noise; Random1-3 choose by a second noise), a red/blue tint stain field and random row glitches; seeds from u_seed, flicker off (TIME 0); pow of negative noise treated as 0

filters.name: Edge Blowout (ISF)
filters.note: ISF Edge Blowout (VIDVOX): inside the box and in each of the 8 outside regions, every pixel is the distance-weighted blend of the 4 region-edge pixels on its row and column (edges stretched into the region); Horizontal/Vertical/Inside/Outside bleed at their default on

filters.name: Smudged Lens (ISF)
filters.note: ISF Smudged Lens (iq noise, @colin_movecraft / VIDVOX): 4-octave value-noise dirt mask (Dirt Shape 4 -> linear, thickness, radial spread) mixes a 3x3 average with a 2%-resolution then 25%-resolution pass ((avg + 3.75*low)/4.75, blur level 0.5); the downsampled ISF render targets are emulated by Gaussian blurs one target-texel wide; seeded dirt
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),u_res.x/max(floor(u_res.x*.02),1.));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),u_res.y/max(floor(u_res.y*.02),1.));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),u_res.x/max(floor(u_res.x*.25),1.));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),u_res.y/max(floor(u_res.y*.25),1.));

filters.name: Smoke Screen Overlay (ISF)
filters.note: ISF Smoke Screen (jackdavenport 4t2SRz): 5-octave smooth value noise x = fractalNoise(6uv), out = mix(x*smokeColour, image, uv.y^((alpha*intensity*x)^2)) so smoke thickens toward the bottom; Drift = TIME along the default direction (0,0.25)

filters.name: Triangle Warp (ISF)
filters.note: ISF Triangle Warp (VIDVOX): each column is squeezed to the height of a triangle with apex Peak (height fit), Distort X also remaps x linearly per side; outside the triangle is black
passes:
vec2 pt=uv;float v;if(pt.x<u_p0){pt.x=pt.x*.5/u_p0;v=2.*pt.x*u_p1;}else{pt.x=.5+.5*(pt.x-u_p0)/(1.-u_p0);v=(2.-2.*pt.x)*u_p1;}
 if(pt.y>v||v<=0.)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);pt.x=mix(uv.x,pt.x,u_p2);pt.y/=v;return vec4(O(pt).rgb,1.);

filters.name: Video Bricks (ISF)
filters.note: ISF Video Bricks (patriciogv bricks / VIDVOX): running-bond brick tiling (odd rows shifted half a brick), every brick shows the whole frame (zoomed past the mortar unless Crop), black border

filters.name: Power Warp (ISF)
filters.note: ISF Power Warp (VIDVOX): x and y raised to a power (Style 1) or mirrored about the centre (Style 2: 0.5 +- (2|p-0.5|)^power/2), then shifted and wrapped; Shift Y fixed 0; defaults 2 (ISF default 1 = identity)
passes:
vec2 pw=vec2(u_p0,u_p1),q=uv;if(u_p3<.5)q=pow(q,pw);else{q=mix(.5-pow(max(1.-2.*q,0.),pw)*.5,.5+pow(max(2.*(q-.5),0.),pw)*.5,step(.5,q));}
 q=mod(q+vec2(u_p2,0.),1.);return vec4(O(q).rgb,1.);

filters.name: Contrast by Detail Levels (RawTherapee)
filters.note: RawTherapee dirpyr_equalizer on Lab L: 6-level edge-aware pyramid (5x5 taps at spacing 1..32 px, range weight 1/(|dL|*32768+1000), 2:1 inner/outer domain weights from level 2), each band = level - next level re-added with gain irangefn: 1 below noise_lo, multiplier above noise_hi (0.66/1.33 x 2000 x threshold / 3^level), linear between; levels 4-5 multipliers softened 0.65/0.45 as in RT; sliders pair levels 0-1 / 2-3 / 4-5; skin protection off

filters.name: L*a*b* Colour Correction Grid (RawTherapee Color Toning)
filters.note: RawTherapee colorToningLabGrid: a += L*(aHigh-aLow)/(3*12000)/3 + aLow/3 and the same for b (internal L 0..32768, Lab x 327.68), grid nodes in -1..1 = +-LABGRID_CORR_MAX 12000; a linear a/b shift ramp from the shadow node to the highlight node

filters.name: Colour Correction Region with H/C/L Mask (RawTherapee Color Toning)
filters.note: RawTherapee labColorCorrectionRegions, one region: hue mask (Lab hue, smooth window of Mask width) blends the region result back in Lab; region ops = ASC-CDL slope (offset 0, power 1) then saturation rs = 1 + sat/50 (or /100 if negative) about luminance Y in linear RGB (sRGB primaries instead of the working profile); a/b shift 0, chroma/lightness masks flat, guided-filter mask smoothing omitted (approx.)

filters.name: Saturation 2 Colours Toning (RawTherapee Color Toning)
filters.note: RawTherapee toning2col ("Saturation 2 colours"): the shadow colour (full-saturation hue, normalised weights) is pushed in by subtracting factor*k from the other channels, the highlight colour added, factor = 20000/65535 x saturation(80 / 60) x luminance-shaped weight x protection, Balance shifts shadows vs highlights, luminance preserved; weight curves and the protection scale (Strength) are approx. (secondeg_* coefficients and ctColorCurve low/high not taken from source)

filters.name: Arabesque Pattern (Filter Forge)
filters.note: approx. of the Filter Forge "Arabesque" texture family: interlaced curvilinear ribbons on a square lattice (centre circles, corner quarter-circles and overlapping unit circles forming petals), outlined bands with alternating over/under order per half-cell, drop shadow

filters.name: Celtic Knots (Filter Forge)
filters.note: approx. of the Filter Forge Celtic Knots texture: plaitwork (the base Celtic knot grid) - two families of diagonal ribbons crossing with strictly alternating over/under (checkerboard parity of the crossing), outlined bands with rounded shading and a shadow cast by the upper strand; no knot breaks

filters.name: Islamic Geometric Tiling 8/12-fold (Filter Forge)
filters.note: approx. of the Filter Forge Islamic tiling generator: Hankin polygons-in-contact method - from every edge midpoint of a square (8-fold) or hexagonal (12-fold) cell two rays at the contact angle meet on the symmetry axes, giving the classic star-and-cross / 12-point star networks; lapis star fills, cream background, gold strapwork with dark outline

filters.name: Quasicrystal Pattern (Filter Forge)
filters.note: Quasicrystal: superposition of N plane waves at angles k*pi/N (N-fold quasi-periodic symmetry); grey = mean, stripes / ramp = sum wrapped with a triangle fold (the classic quasicrystal rendering)
passes:
vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.)*u_p1;float n=floor(u_p0+.5),v=0.;for(int k=0;k<15;k++){float fk=float(k);if(fk>=n)break;float a=3.14159265*fk/n;v+=.5+.5*cos(dot(p,vec2(cos(a),sin(a)))+u_p2);}
 int m=int(u_p3+.5);float g=v/n;float wv=abs(mod(v,2.)-1.);vec3 col=m==0?vec3(g):m==1?vec3(1.-wv):m==2?ramp(1,wv):c.rgb*(.35+.9*(1.-wv));return vec4(col,1.);

filters.name: Spiral Galaxy Generator (Filter Forge)
filters.note: approx. of the Filter Forge spiral galaxy generator: logarithmic-spiral arm density (Arms, Twist) with fbm turbulence, exponential disk, bright bulge, dust lanes trailing the arms, pink HII knots, tilt = disk inclination squash, seeded star field

filters.name: Escher Cube Tumbling Blocks (Filter Forge)
filters.note: approx. of the Filter Forge Escher Cube / tumbling-blocks texture: hexagonal lattice, each hexagon split from its centre into three rhombi (top / left / right faces) shaded light, mid, dark to read as stacked cubes, dark edge lines; From image samples one colour per cube

filters.name: Inca and Aztec Designs (Filter Forge)
filters.note: approx. of the Filter Forge Inca/Aztec design textures: 12x12 pixel-grid motifs tiled - concentric stepped diamonds, step-fret (xicalcoliuhqui-like square spiral with stair background), chakana (Inca stepped cross with central hole), stepped zigzag bands; terracotta / turquoise-gold / black-cream palettes, faint woven cell texture

filters.name: Tribal Tattoo Patterns (Filter Forge)
filters.note: approx. of the Filter Forge tribal tattoo pattern: two domain-warped flowing stroke fields (log-spiral swirl + diagonal waves), ridge thresholded with a noise-modulated width so strokes taper into sharp points, optional mirror symmetry, black ink on paper / skin / image

filters.name: Barber Pole / Candy-Cane Coil (Filter Forge)
filters.note: approx. of the Filter Forge barber-pole / candy-cane texture: helical stripes on a cylinder (stripe phase = asin(x)/2pi + height x twist, so stripes curve over the round surface), Lambert shading and a specular streak; barber red/white/blue, candy cane red/white with a green pinstripe, or a full-frame coil; outside the pole the image is darkened

filters.name: Blur Curve Custom Falloff (Nukepedia BlurCurve)
filters.note: BlurCurve (Harvey Goodall): blur whose radial falloff is a profile curve, four preset shapes, independent width/height scaling; the hand-drawn profile curve is replaced by the preset shape raised to Profile power (approx.); convolution = 400-tap equal-area golden-angle spiral over a lightly prefiltered image
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0*.07));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0*.07));

filters.name: Fractal Blur Gradient Breakup (Nukepedia Fractal Blur)
filters.note: Fractal Blur (Rich Frazer): fractal noise (size, contrast) is multiplied into the image/matte before the blur, so the soft gradient of the blurred edge is broken up organically; mean-preserving fbm (approx., no texture input / no animation)
passes: float n=fbm(PX(uv)/u_p1+u_seed*17.3);float m=clamp(1.+u_p2*2.2*(n-.5),0.,2.);return vec4(c.rgb*m,1.);
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0));

filters.name: Zip Blur Directional Detail Removal (Nukepedia ZipBlur)
filters.note: ZipBlur (Mads Hagbarth Damsbo) idea: removes detail oriented along the chosen angle - the high-pass detail layer is blurred along that direction (so only structure coherent along it survives) and subtracted, isotropic texture is kept (approx.; built from the tool description)
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p2));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p2));
return vec4((O(uv).rgb-c.rgb)*.5+.5,1.);
float a=radians(u_p0);return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(cos(a),sin(a)),R(u_p1));
vec3 s=c.rgb*2.-1.;return vec4(clamp(O(uv).rgb-s*u_p3,0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Anamorphic Astigmatism (Nukepedia mt Anamorphic Astigmatism)
filters.note: mt Anamorphic Astigmatism (Miguel Torija) idea: off-axis blur that grows with field radius (Falloff power), split into sagittal (radial) and tangential sizes by Astigmatism (rays of different orientation focus at different planes), the blur ellipse stretched vertically by the anamorphic Squeeze; 96-tap Gaussian ellipse (approx., built from the description)

filters.name: Edge Scatter Along Matte Edge (Nukepedia EdgeScatter)
filters.note: EdgeScatter (J Bills): the comp is blurred and mixed back only in a band around the matte edge, with separate inner/outer amounts, to integrate layers photographically (light-wrap family); no matte input here, so the control matte is a soft luma key at Key threshold (approx.; no regrain / crop)
passes: float m=smoothstep(u_p0-.03,u_p0+.03,blurL(uv,u_k));return vec4(c.rgb,m);
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p3));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p3));

vec3 o=O(uv).rgb;float m=smoothstep(u_p0-.03,u_p0+.03,blurL(uv,u_k));vec4 b=T(uv);float band=pow(clamp(4.*b.a*(1.-b.a),0.,1.),2.);
 float w=clamp(band*mix(u_p2,u_p1,m),0.,1.);return vec4(mix(o,b.rgb,w),1.);

filters.name: Fibonacci Glow Stack (Nukepedia eFibonacciGlow)
filters.note: eFibonacciGlow (Ermes Vincenti): exponential-looking glow = equal-energy sum of Gaussian glows whose sizes follow the Fibonacci sequence 1,2,3,5..55 x Glow size (v4 options: quadratic 1,4,9..81 / Tribonacci 1,2,4,7..149), luminance tolerance key, screen over the image or glow only; summed as one radial kernel (dense near taps on the keyed image, far taps on a prefiltered copy)
passes: return vec4(c.rgb*smoothstep(u_p1,u_p1+.15,L(uv)),1.);
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0*6.));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0*6.));

filters.name: Inverse-Square Physical Glow (Nukepedia PhysX Glow)
filters.note: PhysX Glow (Pierre Levin): a single convolution whose kernel follows the inverse-square law of the distance to the kernel centre, 1/(1+(d/core)^2), instead of stacked Gaussians; thresholded highlights convolved in linear light and added (kernel normalised to unit energy, Intensity scales it; approx. of the falloff, the exact gizmo kernel is not published)
passes: vec3 x=mix(c.rgb/12.92,pow((c.rgb+.055)/1.055,vec3(2.4)),step(vec3(.04045),c.rgb));return vec4(mix(x*smoothstep(u_p3,u_p3+.15,L(uv))*12.92,1.055*pow(max(x*smoothstep(u_p3,u_p3+.15,L(uv)),vec3(0.)),vec3(1./2.4))-.055,step(vec3(.0031308),x*smoothstep(u_p3,u_p3+.15,L(uv)))),1.);
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p1*.025+1.));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p1*.025+1.));

filters.name: Paper Cut-Out Outlines (Nukepedia BAB_PaperOutlines)
filters.note: BAB_PaperOutlines idea: automatic stylised outlines drawn as textured paper (fibre fbm) around detected contours - the contour band is everywhere the luma changes within Outline width (8 directions, 2 radii), Sharpness hardens the paper edge, paper-only output for compositing (approx., built from the tool description)

filters.name: Twitch Random Jolts (Nukepedia VC Twitch)
filters.note: Video Copilot Twitch (as ported to Nuke by INEED MONEY): per frame (Time) a seeded random jolt fires with Probability - position slide, colour (RGB split + random tint), directional blur, light flash - All or one type at a time; Amount scales the jolts (approx., one frame per Time step, no slide/scale sub-modes)

filters.name: Log Space Sharpen (Nukepedia Log_Sharpen)
filters.note: Log_Sharpen (Tejas Kantharia, after Adrian Sutherland VES article on sharpening in log): linear -> Cineon (685/300 log10, 0.0108 black offset) or ACEScct, unsharp mask (Gaussian radius) applied in log, back to linear, so halos are proportional (multiplicative) instead of additive
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p1));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p1));

filters.name: ARRI Alexa Sensor Grain (Nukepedia Grain_ARRI_Alexa)
filters.note: Grain_ARRI_Alexa (Huseyin Cay) idea: fine sensor noise with an ISO/EI control - amplitude ~ sqrt(EI/800), strongest in the blue and red channels, partly luma-correlated, peaking in shadows/mids (photon shot-noise profile); fine 1-px grain, Grain size scales it (approx.; the gizmo values are not published)

filters.name: Distant Bloom by Depth (Nukepedia Distant Bloom)
filters.note: Distant Bloom (Horea Pop): Laplacian edge detect (Filter size, Threshold) plus highlights, graded (Gain), blurred and masked by a depth pass so only far CG edges/highlights bloom, screened over the image (far mask = (1-depth)^1.5; no convolve/defocus split, approx.)
passes:
float d=R(u_p0);vec3 lp=4.*c.rgb-T(uv+vec2(d,0.)*u_px).rgb-T(uv-vec2(d,0.)*u_px).rgb-T(uv+vec2(0.,d)*u_px).rgb-T(uv-vec2(0.,d)*u_px).rgb;
 float e=max(abs(luma(lp))-u_p1,0.);float hi=smoothstep(.7,1.,L(uv));float fm=pow(clamp(1.-D(uv),0.,1.),1.5);return vec4(c.rgb*min(e*12.+hi,2.)*u_p2*fm*.6,1.);
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p3));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p3));
vec3 o=O(uv).rgb;vec3 g=clamp(T(uv).rgb,0.,1.);return vec4(1.-(1.-o)*(1.-g),1.);

filters.name: Biased Saturation Toward a Colour (Nukepedia biasedSaturation)
filters.note: biasedSaturation (Paul Raeburn): saturation whose neutral axis is a picked colour instead of grey - desaturating heads toward luma x picked colour (normalised to unit luma), oversaturating pushes away from it (approx., built from the one-line description)
passes: vec3 pc=hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p1/360.,u_p2,1.));pc/=max(luma(pc),1e-3);vec3 g=luma(c.rgb)*pc;return vec4(clamp(g+(c.rgb-g)*u_p0,0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: CrankIt Colour Boost for Keying (Nukepedia CrankIt)
filters.note: CrankIt (Cameron Carson, after Ben Pierre CrankItUp): pumps plate colours for keying by dividing RGB by a per-pixel normaliser chosen by the filter (Magnitude, Power = geometric mean, Max, Inverse Min, Max Range, Inverse Max Range, Min Range; range modes also subtract the min) - the gizmo expressions are not published, approx.

filters.name: CIE Yxy Grade (Nukepedia SR_YxyGrade)
filters.note: SR_YxyGrade: grade in CIE Yxy - linear sRGB -> XYZ -> luminance Y + chromaticity xy; Exposure/Contrast (pivot 0.18) act on Y only, Saturation scales and Hue rotate turns the chromaticity around the D65 white point, then back to RGB (no BG edge-blend input; approx. of the knob set)

filters.name: Day to Night (Nukepedia Day2Night)
filters.note: Day2Night (INEED MONEY) - "very simple" day-for-night: desaturate, blue cast, exposure drop with a gamma crush, keep the brightest areas as lights and add a warm glow (glow colour) around them, clamped (approx.; the gizmo presets are not published)
passes: return vec4(c.rgb*smoothstep(.78,1.,L(uv)),1.);
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p3));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p3));

filters.name: 4:2:2 Chroma Jaggy Fix (Nukepedia HS_422Chromafix)
filters.note: HS_422Chromafix (Hiroshi Saito) idea: 4:2:2 chroma is horizontally half-res, giving stair-step colour edges on keys; Rec.709 Cb/Cr are re-interpolated horizontally with a tent filter whose taps are weighted by luma similarity (joint-bilateral, luma kept at full res), so chroma edges snap to the luma edges (approx.)

filters.name: Pingle Clipped Highlight Detail (Nukepedia pingle)
filters.note: pingle: clipped highlights get a gradient by erosion - the depth of each clipped pixel inside its clipped region (distance to the region edge, up to Ping size) ramps a gain so blown lights peak in the centre ("pings") before a defocus, instead of flat multiplied whites; superwhite output, a soft-clip preview, or the ping map (approx.)

filters.name: Bokeh Builder Grungy Kernel (Nukepedia Bokeh Builder)
filters.note: Bokeh Builder (Kyran Bishop) idea: builds an artistic bokeh kernel image from scratch - aperture polygon with curved blades (0 = round), compressed bright ring edge, grungy noise and onion-ring texture, glass artifacts (dust specks, scratches) and slight chromatic edge; output on black for use as a convolve/defocus filter (approx.)

filters.name: Gradient Analyzer Isolines (Nukepedia jm_gradientAnalyzer)
filters.note: jm_gradientAnalyzer (Johannes Mogelvang): draws lines perpendicular to the gradient - i.e. iso-luminance contours at Line count levels - so bumps from cleanup/cloning in soft gradients show as kinks; Roll shifts the levels (the "Pre CC" roll) so every part of the image can be inspected; lines tinted by gradient direction (approx., built from the description)
passes:
float l=blurL(uv,u_k);float v=l*u_p0+u_p1;float fw=max(fwidth(v),1e-5);float fd=abs(fract(v+.5)-.5)/fw;float ln=1.-smoothstep(u_p2*u_k*.5,u_p2*u_k*.5+1.,fd);
 vec2 g=sobel(uv);vec3 hc=hsv2rgb(vec3(atan(g.y,g.x)/6.2831853+.5,.55,1.));vec3 bg=u_p3>.5?vec3(0.):c.rgb*.35;return vec4(mix(bg,hc,ln),1.);

filters.name: Steel Wool Burning Sparks (Nukepedia T_SteelWool)
filters.note: T_SteelWool (Petar Tsonev) idea: the image luma above Map threshold stands in for the roto/paint map; seeded sparks (cell-scattered emitters on the map) fly out as hot, bending, fading streaks (white core cooling to orange), plus an orange burning-edge line on the map border; Time steps the flicker (approx., no leading-edge mask output)

filters.name: Tree Gobo Dappled Light (Nukepedia Tree_Gobo)
filters.note: Tree_Gobo (Moises Moreno) idea: a tree-shaped gobo of leaf clusters (domain-warped two-scale fbm, Foliage density) and branch silhouettes casts dappled light over the image - lit holes warm, shadowed areas cool and darker (Shadow strength); Softness = the bokeh blur of the gobo; static, no wind animation (approx.)

filters.name: Alpha-Driven Prism Light (Nukepedia C_Prisming)
filters.note: C_Prisming (Chris Charlton) idea: a height from the alpha (here luma, smoothed; uses a Normalish-style gradient) refracts the image like a convex or concave surface, and the displacement is spread over 9 spectral samples so light splits into a rainbow (Dispersion) (approx., no alpha input)

filters.name: Digital Still Camera Exposure (Nukepedia / colour-hdri)
filters.note: Digital Still Camera Exposure (colour-hdri dsc.py, ISO 12232:2006): pixel value 1.0 = scene luminance "Scene white"; focal-plane exposure H = q L t / N^2 with q = pi/4 T f_v cos^4(theta) (T 0.9, f_v 0.98, theta 10 deg), saturation-based-speed exposure H_SBS = H S / 78, so 1.0 = sensor saturation (clipped)

filters.name: HDRI Bloom Extract (Nukepedia HDRIBloomExtract)
filters.note: HDRIBloomExtract idea: the bloom / light spill around bright areas = pixels above Range (soft Range rolloff) blurred by Blur size; output the bloom alone, screened back, or with the bright core (sun) removed and filled from its blurred surroundings (normalised convolution) - no exposure check / crop-box UI (approx.)
passes: float m=smoothstep(u_p0-u_p1,u_p0+.001,L(uv));if(u_p3>1.5)return vec4(c.rgb*(1.-m),1.-m);return vec4(c.rgb*m,1.);
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p2));

filters.name: Light Off Highlight Flatten (Nukepedia MM_LightOff)
filters.note: MM_LightOff idea (after the grade-stacking technique of Kenn Hedin Kalvik): three stacked highlight-compressing grades pivoting at mid grey kill the highlights, a large-scale local mean divides out the light direction (Flatten) to turn sun into overcast, slight desaturation, optional Darken for day-for-night (approx.)
passes: return vec4(vec3(L(uv)),1.);
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(40.));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(40.));

filters.name: Perlin Gain Contrast (Nukepedia Perlin Gain)
filters.note: Ken Perlin gain function: gain(x,g) = bias(2x,1-g)/2 below 0.5, 1 - bias(2-2x,1-g)/2 above, bias(t,b) = t^(ln b / ln 0.5); g = 0.5 is identity, above boosts and below mutes contrast; on luminance only (RGB scaled, hue/saturation kept) or per channel; superwhites untouched

filters.name: Voronoi Texture Extractor (Nukepedia VoronoiTextureExtractor)
filters.note: VoronoiTextureExtractor (MassieVFX) idea: crops a square patch (centre Patch X/Y, size in frame heights) and scatters it over the frame in Voronoi cells (Cell scale), each cell with a seeded random rotation and mirrored tiling of the patch, soft-blended at cell borders (approx.)

filters.name: Edge Mirror Padding (Nukepedia EdgeMirror)
filters.note: EdgeMirror (Andriy Koval): the image edges are mirrored in all directions, so area uncovered by a shift (camera shake / stabilisation) or a zoom-out is filled with reflected picture instead of black; Shift and Zoom out show the padding
passes: vec2 q=(uv-.5)*u_p2+.5-vec2(u_p0,u_p1);q=1.-abs(mod(q,2.)-1.);return vec4(O(q).rgb,1.);

filters.name: Beer-Lambert Underwater Attenuation (Nukepedia)
filters.note: Beer-Lambert underwater attenuation: I = I0 exp(-alpha l) per channel with water absorption coefficients (red absorbed fastest); path l = (1 - depth) x Distance max, downwelling light attenuated by Water depth, optional haze = backscatter toward the water colour (1 - transmission); depth pass input (approx. coefficients, no deep version)

filters.name: Directional Wrinkle Removal (Nukepedia Directional_wrinkle_remove)
filters.note: Directional_wrinkle_remove (Ashish Kumar) idea: wrinkles running along Angle are blurred across (directional blur perpendicular to them, WrinkleBlur), then fine skin texture (3x3 high-pass of the original) is added back (texture_ctrl); use under a mask for de-aging (approx.)
