 return vec4(clamp(T(uv).rgb+(o-sb)*u_p1,0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Directional Displace by HSV Map (Nukepedia Directional Displace)
filters.note: Directional Displace (dninosores, github directional-displace-gizmo): map hue = displacement direction (angle on the colour wheel), saturation = distance, value = phase of the Position knob (value 1: none at 0, max at 1; value 0.5: max at 0, none at 1); there is no second input here, so the map is the blurred image itself (approx.)
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p2));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p2));

vec3 h=rgb2hsv(clamp(c.rgb,0.,1.));float an=h.x*6.2831853;float amt=abs(sin(1.5707963*(u_p0+2.*(1.-h.z))));vec2 off=vec2(cos(an),sin(an))*h.y*R(u_p1)*amt;
 return vec4(O(uv+off*u_px).rgb,1.);

filters.name: Hue Contrast (Jed Smith HueContrast)
filters.note: open-display-transform look-transforms/tools/resolve/HueContrast.dctl v0.0.3 (Jed Smith): RGB ratios minus achromatic, wide/narrow hue-angle mix (width 0.5), strength power, hyperbolic lerp factor x/(x+0.66) on max(RGB) (bias 0) mixing focus low -> high, 3-way lerp toward (focus<0) or away from the primary vectors; one focus pair applied to all or one primary; runs on linearised sRGB

filters.name: Midtone Contrast (Jed Smith MidtoneContrast)
filters.note: open-display-transform MidtoneContrast.dctl v0.0.1 (Jed Smith): power contrast 2^contrast pivoted at 0.18*2^pivot with a linear toe below toe*pivot and a linear shoulder above pivot*2^shoulder, rescaled to pass through the pivot; per channel (preserve-ratios 0), on linearised sRGB

filters.name: Helmholtz-Kohlrausch Compensation (Jed Smith Nayatani_HK)
filters.note: open-display-transform Nayatani_HK.dctl (Jed Smith) after Nayatani 1997 (Color Res. Appl. 22:385): CIE u'v' hue angle h and S_uv = 13*|uv - uv_white| (D65), q(h) 4-harmonic Fourier series, K_Br from adapting luminance La, RGB scaled by 1/(1 + (m*q + 0.0872*K_Br)*S_uv) with m = -0.134 (VCC) or -0.866 (VAC); Rec.709 linear input

filters.name: Purity (Jed Smith Purity)
filters.note: open-display-transform Purity.dctl v0.0.1 (Jed Smith): RGB ratios to max, complement ratios, weighted-sum "luminance" (red/blue weights, green = 1 - r - b), chroma = max complement; pivoted power cubic on chroma sets a lerp factor (luminance weights for purity > 0, chrominance weights for < 0) between the ratios and the weighted achromatic; linearised sRGB

filters.name: JzDT Display Transform (Jed Smith)
filters.note: open-display-transform display-transforms/jzdrt/JzDT.dctl (Jed Smith): Michaelis-Menten tonescale on max(JzLMS) (Lw-derived contrast, flare 1/Lw, dim surround 0.95), chroma-compression lerp toward achromatic by (sx/(n+sx))^dechroma * saturation, then perceptual dechroma in JzAzBz (hue restored from the untoned input, parabolic chroma compression 0.015/0.05/0.03); Rec.709 linear in (linearised sRGB, exposure added), Rec.709 out, 2.4 power (Rec.1886) encoding

filters.name: Tesseract View Transform (Jed Smith)
filters.note: open-display-transform display-transforms/tesseract/Tesseract.dctl (Jed Smith): offset 0.005, RGB ratios with quadratic-lift purity compression, purity-weighted achromatic norm, spliced power / Michaelis-Menten tonescale (Lp 100, grey nits, contrast), purity boost, achromatic lerp toward peak, hue contrast (0.3/0.2/0.2) and hue shift (R +0.5, B -0.5) weighted by the toned norm, low-end compress; Rec.709 linear in (linearised sRGB) and out, 2.4 power encoding

filters.name: Chromagnon View Transform (Jed Smith)
filters.note: open-display-transform display-transforms/chromagnon/ChromagnonView.dctl v0.0.7 (Jed Smith): offset, per-channel power-p-toe purity compression of RGB ratios (pc_t0 0.1, pc_x0 0.1), default rendering matrix (scrot 0.01/0.03/0.025, rot 0.01/0/0.015), look matrix in an xlog space (0.03/0.12/0.02), pivoted power contrast then Michaelis-Menten tonescale (Lp 100, high clip 128) per channel; Rec.709 linear in (linearised sRGB) and out, 2.4 power

filters.name: Hill-Langmuir Tonemap (nuke-colortools)
filters.note: nuke-colortools toolsets/transfer_function/Tonemap_HillLangmuir.nk (Jed Smith): Hill-Langmuir y = s1*x^n/(x^n + s0) with s0, s1 solved so grey in 0.2 -> grey out and white in -> 1, applied to max(RGB) as a ratio-preserving scale; linearised sRGB in, display-linear out sRGB-encoded

filters.name: PowerP Sigmoid Tonemap (nuke-colortools)
filters.note: nuke-colortools toolsets/transfer_function/Tonemap_PowerP_Sigmoid.nk (Jed Smith, desmos ls8q01jcnb): linear section of slope m through the pivot, power-p shoulder (limit 1.1, linear length 0.09) and power-p toe (limit 0.02) compressions solved to reach 1 and 0; applied per channel to the encoded image values (the .nk names no input domain; source pivot x 0.6795, here 0.5 for display-referred input, slope default 1.5 vs 2.36)

filters.name: Colour Spaces: darktable UCS / IgPgTg / IHLS / RLAB / T-Lab (nuke-colortools)
filters.note: nuke-colortools toolsets/color_model (Jed Smith): darktable UCS 22 (Aurelien Pierre 2022: xy -> UV -> U*V* -> Ar Ag, L*/L_white^(0.59*(1+sqrt 0.2)), chroma; shown as C cos h / C sin h), IgPgTg (Hellwig & Fairchild: XYZ->LMS, /(18.36, 21.46, 19435)^0.427, Ig Pg Tg), Improved HLS (Hanbury & Serra; on the encoded RGB, Rec.709 luma, saturation 2c sin(120 - h mod 60)/sqrt 3), RLAB (Fairchild 1996: HPE LMS, D = 0.5, Yn = 100, average surround exponent 1/2.3 as published - the .nk applies pow(x, 2.3) - L/100, a/100, b/100), FilmLight T-Lab (tLMS -> Yrg with D65 white offset -> L a b); channel viewer, opponent channels mapped 0.5 +/- gain*value/space range; Rec.709 linear (linearised sRGB) input

filters.name: ACES RRT Sweeteners (nuke-colortools Blink)
filters.note: nuke-colortools blink/rrt_sweetener_glow_module, _red_modifier, _global_desat (ACES 1.x RRT sweeteners): glow gain 0.05 / mid 0.08 by yc and a sigmoid of saturation, red modifier (hue 0, width 135 cubic B-spline window, pivot 0.03, scale 0.82), global desaturation with AP1 luminance weights (0.96); applied in ACES2065-1 (linear sRGB -> AP0, Bradford) and back

filters.name: ARRI Film Matrix Add / Remove (baldavenger Film_Matrix_Add)
filters.note: baldavenger DCTLs Technical Transforms/Film_Matrix_Add.dctl (Paul Dore): the ARRI film matrix (rows 1.271103 -0.284279 0.013176 / -0.127165 1.436429 -0.309264 / -0.129927 -0.510286 1.640214) applied to LogC AWG values; Remove = its inverse (Film_Matrix_Remove); here linear sRGB -> ARRI Wide Gamut -> LogC3 EI800, matrix, and back

filters.name: Hue Median (baldavenger HueMedian)
filters.note: baldavenger DCTLs DCTL_OFX/HueMedian_OFX.dctl (Paul Dore): HSV hue median over a (2r+1)^2 window (r 0..3; linear, not circular, hue order so red wraps are not handled, as in the source), saturation and value from the centre pixel, optional hue display

filters.name: Median on Lab a/b (baldavenger Median_LAB)
filters.note: baldavenger DCTLs Convolution/Median_LAB.dctl (Paul Dore): L passed through, a and b each replaced by the median of a square window (source length 5); the DCTL expects Lab input, here sRGB -> CIE L*a*b* (D65) and back is done around it

filters.name: Movie 300 Look (GIMP registry elsamuko)
filters.note: elsamuko-movie-300.scm (GIMP registry, 2010): layer stack re-done in one shader - HSL saturation -60 layer, its multiply at 50 %, two legacy-overlay layers of luminosity levels 70..150 gamma 2 (overlay opacity), yellow (241,229,31) multiply 10 %, sepia (160,141,105) grain merge 50 %, red-tint layer = inverted grain-extract of a colour-balanced copy (cyan-red +20 midtones and highlights, preserve luminosity) grain-merged at 80 %, Sobel edge layer (stretched, desaturated, inverted) multiply 50 %; extra-darkening and grain layers off (grain is hue scatter on grey); approx.: auto-stretch from a 16x16 grid
passes:
vec2 p=u_px*max(u_k,1.);vec3 tl=T(uv+vec2(-p.x,p.y)).rgb,tc=T(uv+vec2(0.,p.y)).rgb,tr=T(uv+p).rgb,ml=T(uv-vec2(p.x,0.)).rgb,mr=T(uv+vec2(p.x,0.)).rgb,bl=T(uv-p).rgb,bc=T(uv-vec2(0.,p.y)).rgb,br=T(uv+vec2(p.x,-p.y)).rgb;
 vec3 gx=(tr+2.*mr+br)-(tl+2.*ml+bl),gy=(tl+2.*tc+tr)-(bl+2.*bc+br);return vec4(sqrt(gx*gx+gy*gy)/5.66,1.);

filters.name: Rainy Landscape (GIMP registry elsamuko)
filters.note: elsamuko-rainy-landscape.scm (GIMP registry): hue-saturation yellow hues +20 deg and red hues +30 deg (GIMP 2.6 60-degree sectors, no overlap), blue (0,0,255) multiply at 40 % masked by the inverted channel-mixer monochrome (-0.466 R + 0.133 G + 1.333 B), and the "Preserve Y" layer (yellow colour-to-alpha copy grain-extracted, legacy brightness -90 / contrast 90, self-masked) on top; approx.: GIMP 2.6 legacy hue sectors and brightness-contrast LUT re-derived

filters.name: FlipCells (GIMP registry flipcells)
filters.note: flipcells_0806241812.py (Nitrofurano 2008, GIMP registry): every 8x8 cell from the top-left is rotated 180 degrees (pixel (x,y) swapped with (7-x,7-y)); cell size exposed (source fixed 8)
passes: float cs=u_p0;vec2 W=u_res/u_k;vec2 p=PX(uv);p.y=W.y-p.y;vec2 cl=floor(p/cs)*cs;vec2 q2=cl+cs-(p-cl);q2.y=W.y-q2.y;return T(fromPX(q2));

filters.name: Offset Alternate Rows / Columns (GIMP registry Offset by froGgy)
filters.note: 00-Offset-by-froGgy_v1.0.scm (froGgy factory, GIMP registry node 25090): every other band of tile height (rows) or tile width (columns) is shifted with wrap-around by the offset (0 = half a tile); Even starts at the second band, Odd at the first

filters.name: Shadow Glow (GIMP registry sf-will-glow)
filters.note: sf-will-glow_0.scm (Will Morrison 2010, GIMP registry): duplicate layer, two-point inverting curve (threshold moves the black or white end), hue-saturation hue +100 (exposed), layer mode 10 = lighten only over the original
passes:
float b=u_p0;vec2 p0=vec2(max(b,0.),255.),p1=vec2(b<0.?255.+b:255.,0.);vec3 t=clamp((c.rgb*255.-p0.x)/max(p1.x-p0.x,1.),0.,1.);
 vec3 g=mix(vec3(p0.y),vec3(p1.y),t)/255.;vec3 hs=rgb2hsl(g);hs.x=fract(hs.x+u_p1/360.);g=hsl2rgb(hs);return vec4(max(c.rgb,g),1.);

filters.name: Manny Librodo Sharpening (GIMP registry)
filters.note: sharpen-librodo.scm (GIMP registry "Sharp (Manny Librodo)"): unsharp mask radius 40 with Amount2 1.5 (the script passes amount2 to the first pass too), then two unsharp masks radius 0.3 amount 1.5 (the darken-only / lighten-only merges of identical duplicates are no-ops), layer at 50 % opacity over the original; GIMP 2.6 USM std dev (r+1)/sqrt(2 ln 255), threshold on |2*diff| in 0..255
passes: vec3 o=O(uv).rgb;vec3 df=o-T(uv).rgb;df*=step(vec3(u_p2),abs(2.*df*255.));return vec4(clamp(o+u_p1*df,0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Split Sharpening (GIMP registry)
filters.note: split-sharpening.scm (Andreas Schoenfelder 2009, GIMP registry): two copies at 50 %, a darken-only one and a lighten-only one above it, each unsharp-masked radius 5 with amount 1 / threshold 5 (mode 1) or amount 4 / threshold 15 (mode 2; unreachable from the script menu, which only yields 0 or 1); GIMP 2.6 USM std dev (r+1)/sqrt(2 ln 255)

filters.name: Reveal Yellow Tracking Dots (GIMP registry)
filters.note: showyellowtrackingdots.scm (Hatto von Hatzfeld 2008, GIMP registry): decompose RGB, blue at the bottom, inverted red and inverted green as addition layers at 50 %, merged, auto contrast stretch (here min/max from a 16x16 sample grid, approx.)
passes: vec3 o=c.rgb;float v=o.b;v=mix(v,min(v+1.-o.r,1.),.5);v=mix(v,min(v+1.-o.g,1.),.5);return vec4(vec3(v),1.);

float v=T(uv).r;if(u_p0<.5){float mn=1.,mx=0.;for(int j=0;j<16+int(u_p0*0.);j++)for(int i=0;i<16+int(u_p0*0.);i++){float e=T((vec2(float(i),float(j))+.5)/16.).r;mn=min(mn,e);mx=max(mx,e);}v=clamp((v-mn)/max(mx-mn,1e-3),0.,1.);}return vec4(vec3(v),1.);

filters.name: UV Dilate (vvvv UVDilate)
filters.note: VL.Stride.TextureFX Filters/Morphology/UVDilate_TextureFX.sdsl (vvvv): only black texels are filled; 8 directions x MaxSteps rings, the nearest non-black hit wins and is extrapolated 4x against a sample a quarter step further out (for position / normal maps)

filters.name: Liquish (vvvv TextureFX)
filters.note: VL.Stride.TextureFX Sources/Liquish_TextureFX.sdsl (vvvv, from mrvux dx11 girlpower): domain-warped fbm f = fbm(p + r), r = fbm(p + q + offsets + time), q = fbm(p) (4-octave squared value noise, sin hash), colours black / white / (0.5,0,0.15) mixed by 4f^2, |q| and |r.x|, output (0.2f^3+0.6f^2+0.5f)*atan(col); TexCoord scaled by Scale

filters.name: BlurPerfector (vvvv TextureFX)
filters.note: VL.Stride.TextureFX Filters/Blur/BlurPerfector_TextureFX.sdsl (vvvv): 16-tap sqrt spiral (3.5 turns) at Radius/28 of the frame, each tap weighted sqrt(smoothstep(Threshold, 0, |rgb - centre|)), centre weight 1, falls back to the centre when the neighbour weights sum below 1

filters.name: Aspect-Slope Map (ArcGIS Aspect-Slope)
filters.note: ArcGIS Pro Aspect-Slope raster function: Esri 3x3 (Horn) slope and compass aspect on luma x Z factor (1 px cells), 8 aspect classes (N 337.5-22.5 ...) x slope classes 5-20 / 20-40 / >40 percent, < 5 % flat grey 161; Brewer & Marlow 1993 (Auto-Carto 11) colours, RGB table as in the landserf Brewer script (codes 11..83, 0 = grey)

filters.name: Expand / Shrink Zones (ArcGIS Expand, Shrink)
filters.note: ArcGIS Pro Expand / Shrink (Spatial Analyst): luma quantised into integer zones; Expand grows the selected zone into all other zones within N cells (8-connected, chessboard distance, = N morphological 3x3 steps); Shrink replaces selected-zone cells within N cells of another zone by the majority of the surrounding non-selected values (approx.: one window majority instead of iterated per-cell majority)

filters.name: Spectral Conversion: CIR to Natural Colour (ArcGIS)
filters.note: ArcGIS Pro Spectral Conversion raster function with the documented example matrix (rows 0.1 0.9 0 / 0.3 0 0.7 / 0.1 0.1 0.8): a colour-infrared composite (R = NIR, G = red, B = green) to pseudo natural colour; each row sums to 1
passes: vec3 o=vec3(dot(vec3(.1,.9,0.),c.rgb),dot(vec3(.3,0.,.7),c.rgb),dot(vec3(.1,.1,.8),c.rgb));return vec4(mix(c.rgb,o,u_p0),1.);

filters.name: HubbleMatic Faux Hubble Palette (Siril DSA script)
filters.note: DSA-HubbleMatic.ssf (Siril scripts): rmgreen (average-neutral SCNR), split, rgbcomp -lum=R with R R G as red green blue, rmgreen again, satu 1; background extraction and autostretch (whole-image steps) left out - input assumed already stretched; approx.: LRGB luminance replacement as linear-luminance scaling and satu as an HSL saturation gain

filters.name: Aster Star Glow (Siril script)
filters.note: Aster.py (Siril scripts) non-linear glow: detection (luma - 0.2)/(0.9 - 0.2) > 0.05, star mask (luma - median)/(1 - median) x smoothstep diameter weight (min diameter +/- feather 20/2), blurred mask peak-normalised, ^gamma x strength, star-colour chromaticity from the blurred mask-weighted RGB, screen blend; approx.: Gaussian blur instead of the default Moffat, median from an 8x8 grid, peak from a 16x16 grid, star diameter from radial extents in 8 directions instead of connected components
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(2.*u_p1));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(2.*u_p1));

filters.name: Daniele Curve (utility-dctls)
filters.note: thatcherfreeman utility-dctls Daniele Curve.dctl (Siragusano ACES-central tonescale): m = peak/white, s = exposure*m^(1/contrast), f = m*(x/(x+s))^contrast, y = f^2/(f+flare); on the linearised image, re-encoded sRGB
passes: vec3 a=max(c.rgb,0.);vec3 x=mix(a/12.92,pow((a+.055)/1.055,vec3(2.4)),step(vec3(.04045),a));float m=u_p0;float s_=u_p2*pow(m,1./u_p1);vec3 fx=m*pow(x/(x+s_),vec3(u_p1));vec3 y=clamp(fx*fx/(fx+u_p3+1e-6),0.,1.);return vec4(mix(y*12.92,1.055*pow(max(y,vec3(0.)),vec3(1./2.4))-.055,step(vec3(.0031308),y)),1.);

filters.name: Protected Tone Mapping (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Protected Tone Mapping.dctl: per channel identity up to Threshold, above it T + s*(x-T)/(x-T+s) with s = Limit-T (slope 1 at the knee, asymptote Limit); Exposure is an added pre-gain
passes: vec3 a=max(c.rgb,0.);vec3 x=u_p3<.5?mix(a/12.92,pow((a+.055)/1.055,vec3(2.4)),step(vec3(.04045),a)):a;x*=exp2(u_p2);float T0=u_p0,sp=max(u_p1-u_p0,1e-4);vec3 e=max(x-T0,0.);vec3 y=mix(x,T0+sp*e/(e+sp),step(T0,x));y=clamp(y,0.,1.);return vec4(u_p3<.5?mix(y*12.92,1.055*pow(max(y,vec3(0.)),vec3(1./2.4))-.055,step(vec3(.0031308),y)):y,1.);

filters.name: Linear Contrast (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Linear Contrast.dctl: out = sign(x)*m*(|x|/m)^(gamma*channel gamma), pivot m = 0.18 grey; on the linearised image

filters.name: Corona Highlight Compression (Reactor TonemappingTools)
filters.note: RacoonArtworks TonemappingTools CoronaHighlightCompression.setting: Custom tool r*(1+r/(n*n))/(1+r) per channel (n = 1 identity, large n = Reinhard); linear light, Exposure is an added pre-gain

filters.name: Primal Exposure + Flare (Demystify Color DMC_Primal)
filters.note: Demystify-Color DCTLs Exposure_Tools/DMC_Primal_v2.dctl: decode to linear, gain 2^exposure, then additive per-channel flare offsets (black lift), re-encode; here the decode/encode is sRGB (the DCTL offers camera log curves); temp/tint and the master flare slider are left out

filters.name: Ratio Shaper Key / Fill (Moaz Elgabry)
filters.note: MoazElgabry DCTLs ME_Ratio Shaper v1.2.dctl gain curves: in DaVinci Intermediate, fill gain n^p(a n+b)+c below pivot t0 (-> 2^E at black), key gain (a n^p+b)/n above t0 with a linear 2^E slope beyond t0*2^f, n = max(RGB), each blended 50/50 with the luma (0.274,0.874,-0.148) version (Preserve Color 0.5) and summed; approx.: pivots at 0, the highlight/shadow protection masks and overall exposure left out

filters.name: Dye Density Simulator (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Dye Simulator.dctl: R,G,B (x gain) are cyan/magenta/yellow dye concentrations (+ silver = sum x ratio), each dye a two-sided Gaussian density spectrum (defaults 676/533/419 nm, left/right sigma 75-55 / 53-37 / 150-52, max 1.96/1/1.44), transmittance 10^-D integrated 360-780 nm under the observer; approx.: Status M sensitivities modelled as Gaussians (645/535/440 nm), density view shown /2

filters.name: Film Characteristic Curve (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Film Curve.dctl: log10(linear*gain/0.18) -> density D = dD*sigmoid(gamma/(0.25 dD)*(x+offset)) + Dmin (or quadratic sigmoid built from smoothrelu w=0.1), -> transmittance 10^-D (a negative); Dmin 0.01, one curve for all channels, density view shown /Dmax

filters.name: Timing Shift Streaks (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Timing Shift Streaks.dctl (Arri timing-shift artefact): one-sided weighted blur over Length*min(W,H) px toward the chosen direction (Cosine/Linear/Box/Gaussian falloff), blended in with opacity min(2^StreakExposure,1); per-frame jitter left out

filters.name: Field Curvature Edge Defocus (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Field Curvature.dctl: blur radius = smoothstep2((f-.5)(1+falloff)+.5)*strength*W/2048 with f ramping from the protected circle to the max ellipse, disc kernel with anti-aliased edge; Cats Eye intersects two circles offset +/- R*C along the centre direction (second one 1.2R); approx.: 160 Vogel-spiral taps instead of the full pixel window, Couple XY on, Sigmoid curve

filters.name: Linear Edge Blur (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Linear Edge Blur.dctl: 1-D (horizontal or vertical) anti-aliased box blur whose radius = curve(f)*strength*W/2048 grows from the protected circle to the max ellipse (Sigmoid 4t^3 / Ellipse 1-sqrt(1-f^2) / Linear); Couple XY on, falloff 0

filters.name: Elliptical / Zoom Vector Blur (Reactor EllipticalBlur)
filters.note: Gregory Chalenko EllipticalBlur.setting (Reactor): a Custom tool builds a vector field red=(cy-y-tan(angle)(0.5-x))*W/H*speed*w/15, green=(x-cx+tan(angle)(0.5-y))*speed*w/15 fed to VectorMotionBlur (Elliptical: X=red,Y=green, i.e. along ellipses; Zoom: X=-green,Y=red), in degamma 2.2 space; approx.: centred field, gradient modulation and motion correction left out

filters.name: Seam-free Panoramic Wrap Blur (KartaVR)
filters.note: Andrew Hazelden KartaVR BlurPanoramicWrap / UnSharpenMaskPanoramicWrap / GlowPanoramicWrap (.setting): the equirectangular frame is surrounded by copies shifted one width left/right and 180-degree-rotated copies above/below the poles, filtered, then cropped back; here the Gaussian samples wrap in x and reflect across the poles with a half-turn longitude shift
passes: float r=R(u_p0);if(r<.5)return T(uv);float sg=r*.5,st=max(1.,r/24.);vec4 a=vec4(0.);float w=0.;for(int i=-24;i<=24+int(u_p0*0.);i++){float x=float(i)*st;if(abs(x)>r)continue;float g=exp(-x*x/(2.*sg*sg));a+=g*T(vec2(fract(uv.x+x*u_px.x),uv.y));w+=g;}return a/w;

float r=R(u_p0);if(r<.5)return T(uv);float sg=r*.5,st=max(1.,r/24.);vec4 a=vec4(0.);float w=0.;for(int i=-24;i<=24+int(u_p0*0.);i++){float x=float(i)*st;if(abs(x)>r)continue;float g=exp(-x*x/(2.*sg*sg));vec2 q=vec2(uv.x,uv.y+x*u_px.y);
    if(u_p3>.5){if(q.y>1.){q.y=2.-q.y;q.x+=.5;}else if(q.y<0.){q.y=-q.y;q.x+=.5;}}q=vec2(fract(q.x),clamp(q.y,0.,1.));a+=g*T(q);w+=g;}return a/w;
vec3 o=O(uv).rgb,b=T(uv).rgb;int m=int(u_p1+.5);vec3 y=m==0?mix(o,b,min(u_p2,1.)):m==1?o+u_p2*(o-b):1.-(1.-o)*(1.-b*b*u_p2);return vec4(clamp(y,0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Fixed SNR Noise (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Fixed SNR Noise.dctl: n = |v|/SNR * Z(u) per channel (mono: one uniform for all channels), Z = Soranzo inverse-normal approximation capped at 2.5758, added to the code values; clamp options as in the DCTL

filters.name: Fractal Blocks Noise (Reactor MT_FractalBlocks)
filters.note: MuseVFX MT_FractalBlocks.setting: FastNoise rendered at W/Size x H/Size and nearest-resized to the frame, plus octaves at 2,4,8,16x the cell count with gains 0.5,0.25,... times Sub Influence summed (Complexity = octave count), then Contrast; approx.: value noise per block instead of Fusion FastNoise, no sub-rotation/offset

filters.name: Spherical / Cylindrical RGB Model (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Spherical.dctl (achromatic axis rotated onto x: hue = atan2, saturation = polar angle in radians, value = |RGB|) and Cylindrical.dctl (a = R-(G+B)/2, b = sqrt3/2(G-B), hue, S = |ab|/(3|mean|), L = mean) and their inverses on code values; Round trip scales saturation and shifts hue between the two

filters.name: Softmax Colour (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Softmax.dctl: out_i = exp(T x_i) / sum_j exp(T x_j) (channels sum to 1; computed max-shifted for stability); Output Gain is an added display scale
passes: vec3 e=exp(u_p0*(c.rgb-max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b))));vec3 o=e/(e.r+e.g+e.b);return vec4(clamp(o*u_p1,0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Root-Polynomial Colour Mix (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Root Polynomial Degree 2.dctl: 3x6 matrix on (R,G,B, sqrt|RG|, sqrt|RB|, sqrt|GB|) (signed roots, exposure-invariant); here a 3-slider sub-matrix: each channel gets k * the root term of the other two (Preserve Neutral subtracts k from its own diagonal), linear light
passes:
vec3 a=c.rgb;vec3 x=mix(a/12.92,pow((a+.055)/1.055,vec3(2.4)),step(vec3(.04045),a));vec3 rt=vec3(sign(x.g*x.b)*sqrt(abs(x.g*x.b)),sign(x.r*x.b)*sqrt(abs(x.r*x.b)),sign(x.r*x.g)*sqrt(abs(x.r*x.g)));
  vec3 k=vec3(u_p0,u_p1,u_p2);vec3 y=clamp(x*(1.-k*step(.5,u_p3))+k*rt,0.,1.);return vec4(mix(y*12.92,1.055*pow(max(y,vec3(0.)),vec3(1./2.4))-.055,step(vec3(.0031308),y)),1.);

filters.name: Polynomial / Sigmoid Kernel Mix (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Polynomial Kernel.dctl / Sigmoid Kernel.dctl: 3x9 matrix on (R,G,B, products RR GG BB RG RB GB) with product kernel sign(ab)|ab|^p (normalised, identity point 1) or the sigmoid q/(q+W), Preserve Gray rescales so mid gray maps to itself; here one slider weights each channel by the product of the other two (R += a*P(G,B) ...)

filters.name: Channel Saturation with Thresholds (xtremestuff)
filters.note: xtremestuff resolve-dctl Channel-Saturation.dctl (Scene mode): each selected channel whose value lies in [lower, upper] is multiplied by its Saturation (a channel gain, not a blend toward luma); one slider set shared by the selected channels
passes:
vec3 x=c.rgb;int ch=int(u_p0+.5);vec3 sel=ch==0?vec3(1.):ch==1?vec3(1.,0.,0.):ch==2?vec3(0.,1.,0.):vec3(0.,0.,1.);
  vec3 g=step(vec3(u_p3),x)*step(x,vec3(u_p2))*sel;return vec4(mix(x,x*u_p1,g),1.);

filters.name: Film Saturation Emulation in Log (Tims DCTL)
filters.note: mitkunz resolve_DCTLs Tims-Film-Saturation-Emulation.dctl: HSL saturation x Log Saturation with a log roll-off above 0.9 and below 0.1, x Log Offset, back to RGB (lightness kept); the channel option replaces only that channel. As in the DCTL, S = 0 maps to about 0.097 so neutrals pick up a slight warm cast

filters.name: Chroma Compress Soft Knee (Reactor ChromaCompress)
filters.note: Jacob Danell Chroma Compress.Fuse: spread d = max-min; above Color Distance a linear soft knee w = min(1,(d-T)/Fade) pulls each channel toward the pivot mix(min,max,0.5) by Compression*w (gains 1, strengths 1); Matte view outputs w. Defaults lowered from 0.8/0.8 for display-referred images
passes:
vec3 x=c.rgb;float M=max(x.r,max(x.g,x.b)),mn=min(x.r,min(x.g,x.b));float d=M-mn;float pv=mix(mn,M,.5);
  float w=d<=u_p1?0.:min(1.,(d-u_p1)/(u_p2+.001));if(u_p3>.5)return vec4(vec3(w),1.);return vec4(x+u_p0*w*(pv-x),1.);

filters.name: Conical Coordinates Saturation (Juan Pablo Zambrano)
filters.note: JuanPabloZambrano DCTL OldDctls/JP-ConicalCoordinate.dctl (after Yedlin / Stoopman cone coordinates): orthonormal rotation to the neutral axis, spherical hue and polar angle, radius scaled by sin(huemag + 0.6155) with a hue-dependent triangle-wave term; inverse divides it out. Round trip scales the polar angle (saturation) and shifts hue in cone space

filters.name: Exposure Strips (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Exposure Strip.dctl: the frame is cut into N vertical strips one stop apart (zero-stop strip centred, leftmost or rightmost); each strip shows the same window of width W/N around X Position (or the frame itself in Overlay mode) times 2^(strip-mid); gain applied in linear light here; the stop labels are left out

filters.name: Screen Size Simulator (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls Screen Size Simulator.dctl: the picture (optionally inside a blanking aspect) is shrunk by target/current diagonal about the centre with bilinear sampling on a black background, to judge how it reads on a smaller screen
passes:
vec2 p=uv-.5;float dw=1.,dh=1.;if(u_p2>.5){float A=u_p3,ar=asp();if(ar>A)dw=A/ar;else dh=ar/A;}p/=vec2(dw,dh);
  float s_=min(u_p0,u_p1)/u_p1;if(abs(p.x)>s_*.5||abs(p.y)>s_*.5)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);vec2 q=(p/s_+.5)*vec2(dw,dh)+.5*vec2(1.-dw,1.-dh);return vec4(T(q).rgb,1.);

filters.name: Local SNR Checker (utility-dctls)
filters.note: utility-dctls SNR Checker.dctl: per-channel mean and unbiased std over a size x size window, SNR = (mean - black point)/std; False Color bins the mean SNR at 0.5/1/2/4/8/16 into magenta/blue/cyan/green/yellow/red/white (cylindrical-model colours, shown sRGB-encoded); SNR view shown /16

filters.name: Oklab Saturation Matte (Moaz Elgabry)
filters.note: MoazElgabry DCTLs ME_Sat_Matte.dctl: Oklab-style L,a,b (custom LMS matrix, smooth signed cube root) -> score = C^2/(C^2 + 0.0625(L^2+0.01)), matte = 1 - smootherstep((coverage - 0.6 score)/0.4) (low-saturation pixels leave the matte first); Gray Background composites over 0.5; spatial smoothing left out

filters.name: Plot Scanline Overlay (Reactor PlotScanline)
filters.note: Jacob Danell PlotScanline.setting: the frame is resized to one row (each column averaged), mapped through black/white point, and a Custom tool lights pixels with |y - value| <= Thickness/100 per channel (RGB) or for the channel mean (Luminance), merged over the image; grid and number labels left out
passes:
vec3 av=vec3(0.);for(int i=0;i<64+int(u_p0*0.);i++)av+=O(vec2(uv.x,(float(i)+.5)/64.)).rgb;av/=64.;if(u_p0>.5)av=vec3((av.r+av.g+av.b)/3.);
  vec3 vv=(av-u_p2)/max(u_p3-u_p2,1e-4);float th=u_p1/100.;vec3 fg=step(abs(uv.y-vv),vec3(th));float al=min(1.,fg.r+fg.g+fg.b);return vec4(fg+c.rgb*(1.-al),1.);

filters.name: Hum Bar / Ground Loop (Reactor MT_Glitch)
filters.note: MuseVFX GlitchTools MT_Glitch_HumBar.setting (soft-edged full-width rectangle, Level = pulse wave 0.5-0.6, wrapped vertical scroll, white merged over at Blend 0.315) and MT_Glitch_GroundLoop.setting (FastNoise varying only in y, contrast 3.17, Displace XY with refraction 0.0169 shifting rows sideways); Position replaces time; approx.: value noise for FastNoise
passes:
int md=int(u_p0+.5);vec2 q=uv;if(md>=1){float yy=uv.y*18.3+u_p1*7.;float nz=vnoise(vec2(3.7,yy))*.65+vnoise(vec2(9.1,yy*2.03))*.35;nz=clamp((nz-.5)*3.168675+.5,0.,1.);q.x+=(nz-.5)*.0168675*u_p2/.6;}
  vec3 o=T(clamp(q,0.,1.)).rgb;if(md!=1){float d=abs(fract(uv.y-u_p1+.5)-.5);float se=.008;float mk=1.-smoothstep(u_p3*.5-se,u_p3*.5+se,d);float al=mk*u_p2;o=o+.3154078*al*(1.-o);}return vec4(o,1.);

filters.name: Roll and Slide Sync Loss (Reactor MT_Glitch)
filters.note: MuseVFX GlitchTools MT_Glitch_RollAndSlide.setting: the picture is padded with black blanking (37 x 39 px) and offset by the roll (vertical, up to 0.88 frame) and slide (horizontal) waves with wrap-around, so a black bar runs between repeated frames; Roll/Slide set the offset directly instead of the time waves
passes: vec2 SZ=u_res/u_k;vec2 cv=SZ+vec2(u_p3,u_p2);vec2 p=(uv-.5)*SZ-vec2(u_p1,u_p0)*cv;p=mod(p+.5*cv,cv)-.5*cv;if(abs(p.x)>SZ.x*.5||abs(p.y)>SZ.y*.5)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);return vec4(T(p/SZ+.5).rgb,1.);

filters.name: Edge Detector by AO Map (Filter Forge)
filters.note: Filter Forge snippet "Edge Detector by Ambient Occlusion Map" (description: cleaner edge detector built on a height-to-AO map): luminance as height, occlusion = mean clamped height-rise slope over 12 directions x 4 radii (crevices) or the mirrored fall (ridges); approx. from the description

filters.name: Worley Noise Distortion (Filter Forge)
filters.note: Filter Forge snippet "Worley Distortion" (Noise Distortion driven by Worley noises: type, distortion, scale, roughness, details): x and y offsets from two independent Worley fields (F1 / F2 / F2-F1 / F1*F2, centred), 3 octaves with Roughness gain; approx. from the description

filters.name: Variable Pixelation by Map (Filter Forge)
filters.note: Filter Forge snippet "Variable Pixelation" (pixelate by a grayscale map, with dither): a quadtree of power-of-two blocks from Max Block down, each block keeping the largest size whose map value (+ per-block dither) asks for it; approx.: the map is built in (image luma, fbm noise or radial) instead of a second input

filters.name: Hue-Invariant Map (Leptonica pixMapWithInvariantHue)
filters.note: Leptonica coloring.c pixMapWithInvariantHue: dst = pixelFractionalShift(src, fract) (fract < 0: (1+fract)*src toward black; fract > 0: src + fract*(255-src) toward white, hue kept), then pixLinearMapToTargetColor(src -> dst): per channel [0,s] -> [0,d] and [s,255] -> [d,255] (s clamped to 1..254)

filters.name: Linear Map to Target Colour (Leptonica pixLinearMapToTargetColor)
filters.note: Leptonica coloring.c pixLinearMapToTargetColor: three per-channel piecewise-linear LUTs sending the source colour s to the target d ([0,s] -> [0,d], [s,255] -> [d,255]; s clamped to 1..254); source = a preset or the image mean (12x12 sample grid), target given as HSV

filters.name: Saturation-Boosted Grey (Leptonica pixConvertRGBToGraySatBoost)
filters.note: Leptonica pixconv.c pixConvertRGBToGraySatBoost (after Qumsiyeh): sat = (max-min)/max, fullsat = min(255, 255*max/refval), out = sat*fullsat + (1-sat)*max; grey pixels give max, saturated ones rise with slope 255/refval
passes: float mx=max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b)),mn=min(c.r,min(c.g,c.b));float sv=mx>0.?(mx-mn)/mx:0.;float fs=min(1.,mx*255./u_p0);return vec4(vec3(sv*fs+(1.-sv)*mx),1.);

filters.name: Darken Grey Pixels (Leptonica pixDarkenGray)
filters.note: Leptonica enhance.c pixDarkenGray: sat = max-min; pixels with max >= thresh or sat >= satlimit unchanged, the rest scaled by sat/satlimit (unsaturated grey goes toward black)
passes: float mx=max(c.r,max(c.g,c.b)),mn=min(c.r,min(c.g,c.b));float sa=(mx-mn)*255.;vec3 o=c.rgb;if(mx*255.<u_p0&&sa<u_p1)o=c.rgb*sa/u_p1;return vec4(o,1.);

filters.name: Colour Grey (Leptonica pixColorGray)
filters.note: Leptonica coloring.c pixColorGray (RGB path): gray = (r+g+b)/3; LIGHT: pixels with gray >= thresh become target*gray/255 (non-black colourised, antialiasing kept); DARK: pixels with gray <= thresh become target + (255-target)*gray/255. As in the RGB code there is no saturation test (only the colormap path restricts to strictly grey pixels); target = HSV(hue, sat, 1)
passes:
int m=int(u_p0+.5);float av=floor((c.r+c.g+c.b)*255./3.)/255.;vec3 t=hsv2rgb(vec3(u_p2/360.,u_p3,1.));float th=u_p1/255.;vec3 o=c.rgb;
 if(m==0){if(av>=th)o=t*av;}else{if(av<=th)o=t+(1.-t)*av;}return vec4(o,1.);

filters.name: Two-Sided Edge Filter (Leptonica pixTwoSidedEdgeFilter)
filters.note: Leptonica edge.c pixTwoSidedEdgeFilter on luma: left and right (or top and bottom) gradients; where both have the same sign (a transition, not one-pixel noise) the smaller magnitude is kept, else 0; x Gain for display

filters.name: Quadratic Vertical Shear (Leptonica pixQuadraticVShear)
filters.note: Leptonica warper.c pixQuadraticVShear (interpolated, bring in white): column displacement delt = vmaxt*(wm-j)^2/wm^2 (to left; to right uses j^2), same for the bottom, row displacement = (delt*(h-1-i) + delb*i)/h; shifts given as % of the height
passes:
float W=u_res.x,H=u_res.y;vec2 wp=uv*u_res;float j=wp.x-.5,id=H-wp.y-.5,wm=W-1.,hm=H-1.;float q=u_p0<.5?(wm-j)/wm:j/wm;q*=q;
 float dt=u_p1*.01*H*q,db=u_p2*.01*H*q;float si=id-(dt*(hm-id)+db*id)/H;if(si<0.||si>hm)return vec4(1.);return vec4(T(vec2(uv.x,1.-(si+.5)/H)).rgb,1.);

filters.name: Horizontal Stretch (Leptonica pixStretchHorizontal)
filters.note: Leptonica warper.c pixStretchHorizontal (L_INTERPOLATED, bring in white): source column j = jd - hmax*(wm-jd)/wm (to left, linear), (wm-jd)^2/wm^2 (quadratic), jd/wm or jd^2/wm^2 (to right); hmax as % of the width
passes:
float W=u_res.x;float jd=uv.x*W-.5,wm=W-1.;float tl=u_p0<.5?(wm-jd)/wm:jd/wm;if(u_p1>.5)tl*=tl;float js=jd-u_p2*.01*W*tl;
 if(js<0.||js>wm)return vec4(1.);return vec4(T(vec2((js+.5)/W,uv.y)).rgb,1.);

filters.name: Stereoscopic Red Warp (Leptonica pixWarpStereoscopic)
filters.note: Leptonica warper.c pixWarpStereoscopic (redleft = 1, so zbend/zshift are negated; ybendb = 0): quadratic vertical shear of each half (left warp-to-left, right warp-to-right, centre line fixed); red only: quadratic horizontal stretch of each half by zbend, then translate by (zshiftt+zshiftb)/2 and horizontal shear about the middle row so the top moves zshiftt and the bottom zshiftb (sign of the shear inferred from the documented intent); white brought in; px at reference scale

filters.name: Random Harmonic Warp (Leptonica pixRandomHarmonicWarp)
filters.note: Leptonica warper.c pixRandomHarmonicWarp with the pixSimpleCaptcha per-order tables (xmag 7/5/4/3, ymag 10/8/6/5, xfreq .12/.10/.10/.11, yfreq .15/.13/.13/.11, nx = ny = terms): x += xmag*r0*sin(xfreq*r1*x + 2pi r2)*sin(yfreq*r3*y + 2pi r4) and likewise for y, random r in [0.5,1] (indexed with stride 3 as in the source), bilinear, white outside; px at reference scale; the seed re-draws the r values

filters.name: Cascaded 2x Rank Reduction (Leptonica pixScaleGrayRankCascade)
filters.note: Leptonica scale2.c pixScaleGrayRankCascade: up to four cascaded pixScaleGrayRank2 reductions of the grey image (rank 1 = min, 2 = second smallest, 3 = second largest, 4 = max of each 2x2 block), a level of 0 ends the cascade; shown pixel-replicated at the input size (working pixels)

filters.name: Environment Blur (Nukepedia EnvironmentBlur)
filters.note: Nukepedia EnvironmentBlur (Haarm-Pieter Duiker, BlinkScript source on the tool page): lat-long panorama, every output direction = sum of max(dot(c,d),0)^exponent * solid angle * src / sum of weights (1 = Lambertian diffuse); here integrated over a 48x24 grid of area-prefiltered cells (approx. of the per-pixel sum; exponent capped at 60 to stay above the grid resolution)
passes: vec3 a=vec3(0.);for(int j=0;j<6;j++)for(int i=0;i<6;i++)a+=O(uv+(vec2(float(i),float(j))-2.5)/6.*vec2(1./48.,1./24.)).rgb;return vec4(a/36.,1.);

filters.name: Gyroid Noise (Nukepedia WorleyNoise gyroid mode)
filters.note: approx.: the WorleyNoise tool page only lists a gyroid mode (worm / brain-coral patterns, domain warping); this uses the standard gyroid sin x cos y + sin y cos z + sin z cos x on a z slice, fbm domain distortion plus an fbm-varied z slice, and an |g| < width band
passes:
vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0*6.2831853;p+=u_p3*6.*(vec2(fbm(p*.07),fbm(p*.07+7.3))-.5);float z=u_p1+u_p3*9.*fbm(p*.05+3.1);
 float g=sin(p.x)*cos(p.y)+sin(p.y)*cos(z)+sin(z)*cos(p.x);return vec4(vec3(clamp(1.-abs(g)/max(u_p2,.001),0.,1.)),1.);

filters.name: Cube Key (Nukepedia cubeKey)
filters.note: approx. of Nukepedia cubeKey (Derek Rein; page: select colours in a 3D cube in a chosen colour space, with softness): axis-aligned cube of side Size around a preset key colour in RGB, HSV (circular hue) or YCbCr, soft edge per axis; selected colours shown, the rest dimmed grey (matte = selection)

filters.name: Cloud Shadows (SC Post Effects)
filters.note: approx. of SC Post Effects Cloud Shadows (docs: projects a scrolling cloud texture over the world): an fbm cloud texture in screen space (no world projection) thresholded by Density darkens the image by Opacity with a slightly cool shadow tint; Scroll moves it
passes:
vec2 p=PX(uv)/u_p0+vec2(u_p3*4.,u_p3*1.5);float n=fbm(p);float t=mix(.72,.3,u_p1);float cl=smoothstep(t-.07,t+.07,n);
 float k=cl*u_p2;return vec4(c.rgb*(1.-k)*mix(vec3(1.),vec3(.88,.93,1.),k),1.);

filters.name: Double Vision (SC Post Effects)
filters.note: approx. of SC Post Effects Double Vision (docs: makes the camera look cross-eyed, optionally limited to the screen edges): average of two horizontally offset copies mixed by Intensity; Edges mode scales the offset with the distance from the centre
passes:
float a=u_p1*.01;if(int(u_p0+.5)==1){vec2 d=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);a*=smoothstep(.2,.75,length(d));}
 vec3 dv=.5*(T(uv+vec2(a,0.)).rgb+T(uv-vec2(a,0.)).rgb);return vec4(mix(c.rgb,dv,u_p2),1.);

filters.name: Star Stretch (Seti Astro Suite Pro)
filters.note: Seti Astro Suite Pro star_stretch.py + legacy/numba_utils.py: per channel f = 3^amount, out = f x / ((f-1) x + 1) (meant for linear star images; SASpro default amount 5), colour boost = mean + (rgb-mean)*boost, optional SCNR green = min(G, (R+B)/2)
passes: float fa=pow(3.,u_p0);vec3 x=clamp(fa*c.rgb/((fa-1.)*c.rgb+1.),0.,1.);vec3 m=vec3((x.r+x.g+x.b)/3.);x=clamp(m+(x-m)*u_p1,0.,1.);if(u_p2>.5)x.g=min(x.g,.5*(x.r+x.b));return vec4(x,1.);

filters.name: Luma Ring (purzOS)
filters.note: purzOS OFX lumaring.cpp: per scanline YIQ, luma box blur r = round(2*scale), S = Y + (blur - Y)*softness, ring L = S + (S - box(S, 2r+1))*ring, ghost G = L + ghost*0.5*(L[x - distance] - 0.5), back to RGB with the original I/Q

filters.name: Rainbow Phase (purzOS)
filters.note: purzOS OFX rainbowphase.cpp: per-line hue error hue*(sin(.71 y + 1.13 t) + .5 sin(2.31 y - .67 t)) rotates I/Q; cross colour adds 2.2*cross*highpass(Y) on a 3-px subcarrier (phase flips per line); dot crawl adds .8*crawl*highpass(|I|+|Q|) to luma; Time = time*speed

filters.name: Tape Wow (purzOS)
filters.note: purzOS OFX tapewow.cpp: per-row horizontal offset = wow (sin .71t + .5 sin(.233t+1.7)) + flutter (sin(.013y+2.9t) + .4 sin(.037y+5.3t)), bottom head-switch band (8 px, bounce 2 px fixed) skewed by skew*k^2 + hashed tear, horizontal wrap; Time = time*speed, seed = hash seed

filters.name: Sync Drift (purzOS)
filters.note: purzOS OFX syncdrift.cpp: h-hold shear dx = shear*row, top-of-frame flagging flag*k^2*(.75 + .25 sin 1.7t) over flagH rows (t = 0 here), vertical roll by Roll*height with wrap and a blanking bar (height/24, RGB/6) when rolling, horizontal wrap
passes:
float W=u_res.x,H=u_res.y;float tx=floor(uv.x*W),ty=floor((1.-uv.y)*H);int sd=int(u_seed*10.);float ro=floor(u_p3*H+.5);float sy=mod(ty+ro,H);bool bar=ro!=0.&&sy>=H-max(2.,floor(H/24.));float dx=u_p0*ty;float fh=max(1.,floor(u_p2*u_k+.5));
 if(ty<fh){float k=1.-ty/fh;dx+=R(u_p1)*k*k*.75;}float ix=sign(dx)*floor(abs(dx)+.5);float sc=mod(tx-ix,W);vec3 o=O(vec2((sc+.5)/W,1.-(sy+.5)/H)).rgb;if(bar)o/=6.;return vec4(o,1.);

filters.name: Phosphor Melt (purzOS)
filters.note: purzOS OFX phosphormelt.cpp: seed = pixel colour where luma >= threshold, directional recurrence trail = max(seed, trail*decay) along each line (evaluated here as max over upstream pixels of seed*decay^k, decay rescaled 1-(1-decay)/scale, up to 400 taps), out = max(src, trail*strength)

filters.name: Line Stutter (purzOS)
filters.note: purzOS OFX linestutter.cpp with the purzfx.hpp hashes: band = row*bands/H, frozen bands (hash2(band,seed) < freeze) keep state 0, shift = round((hash2(band, state+seed) - .5)*amount*width), horizontal wrap; State = frame/hold

filters.name: Head Switch (purzOS)
filters.note: purzOS OFX headswitch.cpp with the purzfx.hpp hashes: bottom band height*(1 + .3 sin(.3 frame)) (drift .3), tear = skew*t*(.6 + .4 vnoise1(.7 row + 3 frame)), wrapped sample blended toward hash3 static by noise*t

filters.name: Tracking Bar (purzOS)
filters.note: purzOS OFX trackingbar.cpp with the purzfx.hpp hashes (frame 0, so the band sits at Position): triangular band weight t, per-line tear tear*sh2(row,seed)*(.5+.5t), desaturate by .7t, blend toward hash3 static by noise*t

filters.name: Color Under (purzOS)
filters.note: purzOS OFX colorunder.cpp with the purzfx.hpp value noise: I/Q += (vnoise(x/scale, y/scale, seed / seed+55) - .5)*amount*sat*(1-luma)^shadowBias, luma kept (frame 0)

filters.name: Dropout / Bad Signal (purzOS)
filters.note: purzOS OFX dropout.cpp (24-px dash cells, hash3 < density -> black head 12% then bright grey) and badsignal.cpp (rows with hash2 < burst become snow, 8-px dash cells black/white at 90%, additive static (hash3-.5)*noise); Static and snow sets noise and burst = half of it; state/frame folded into the seed

filters.name: 4xSoft / 2xSaL Scalers (guest.r slang)
filters.note: slang edge-smoothing/xsoft 4xsoft.slang and xsal 2xsal.slang (guest.r 2007): 4xSoft = edge-weighted blend of axial (weights by hl/vl) and diagonal (d1/d2) 3x3 neighbourhoods / CONTRAST plus a half-texel diagonal term, x0.25; 2xSaL = quarter-texel diagonal pairs weighted by the opposite diagonal difference; source = box-downsampled pixel grid, bilinear source fetches
passes:
float Bw=max(R(u_p1),1.);vec2 SS=ceil(u_res/Bw);vec2 w=floor(uv*u_res);if(w.x>=SS.x||w.y>=SS.y)return vec4(0.,0.,0.,1.);
 vec3 a=vec3(0.);float a2=0.;for(int j=0;j<4;j++)for(int i=0;i<4;i++){vec2 q=floor(w*Bw+(vec2(float(i),float(j))+.5)*Bw*.25)+.5;vec3 v=O(min(q,u_res-.5)/u_res).rgb;a+=v;a2+=luma(v)*luma(v);}return vec4(a/16.,a2/16.);

vec2 e=vec2(u_px.x,0.);vec3 oc=c.rgb,cp=vec3(.04,.02,.04);return vec4(oc+clamp(T(uv-e).rgb-oc,-cp,cp)/4.+clamp(T(uv+e).rgb-oc,-cp,cp)/16.,1.);
vec2 e=vec2(u_px.x,0.);vec3 oc=c.rgb,cp=vec3(.04,.02,.04);return vec4(oc+clamp(T(uv-e).rgb-oc,-cp,cp)/4.+clamp(T(uv+e).rgb-oc,-cp,cp)/16.,1.);

filters.name: Astro Display Stretches (sunkit-image / astropy)
filters.note: sunkit-image utils.apply_upsilon: below the image mean (2x)^alpha / 2, above 1 - (2 - 2x)^alpha_high / 2 (alpha = 2A, alpha_high = 2B; default 0.5, 0.5); astropy.visualization PowerDistStretch (a^x - 1)/(a - 1) with a = 10^(6A) (default 1000), SinhStretch sinh(x/a)/sinh(1/a) with a = 2A/3 (default 1/3), ContrastBiasStretch (x - bias) * contrast + 0.5 with contrast = 2A, bias = B; clipped 0..1 (astropy clip=True), input = display values 0..1

filters.name: Brightness-Adaptive Unsharp Mask (ImPPG)
filters.note: ImPPG unsharp masking, adaptive mode (README 4.3): out = amount * image + (1 - amount) * Gaussian(sigma) (amount 1 = none, < 1 blurs, > 1 sharpens), amount = amount min where the unprocessed image is darker than threshold - transition width, amount max above threshold + width, smooth in between; approx.: transition width fixed at 0.1 and the smooth step shape assumed
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0*2.));

filters.name: Boundary Tensor (VIGRA, Koethe)
filters.note: VIGRA boundaryTensor / boundaryTensor1 (Koethe 2003, boundarytensor.hxx): even part from the 2nd-order Riesz transform of the LoG (= scale-normalised Gaussian 2nd derivatives e0 e1 e2): [e0^2 + e1^2, e1(e0 + e2); ., e1^2 + e2^2] (boundaryTensor1: 0.5(e0 - e2)^2 + 2 e1^2 on the diagonal, no blob term), plus the odd part d d^T; edge energy = l1 - l2, junction energy = 2 l2 (shown as square roots x Gain); approx.: the odd 1st-order Riesz pair of the LoG is replaced by the gradient of the LoG (VIGRA fits polynomial-Gaussian kernels), derivatives by finite differences of the Gaussian-smoothed image
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0*2.));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0*2.));

filters.name: Hourglass Tensor Filter (VIGRA, Koethe)
filters.note: VIGRA hourGlassFilter (Koethe 2003, orientedtensorfilters.hxx): every gradient tensor g g^T (Gaussian gradient at the inner scale) is spread with its own hourglass kernel exp(-r^2/2sigma^2 - q^2/(2 rho^2 p^2)) / (2 pi sigma^2), p along its edge direction, q along the gradient (radius 3 sigma, unnormalised as in VIGRA), computed here as the equivalent gather; then the tensor eigen representation: edgeness l1 - l2, cornerness l2 (square roots, fixed gain)
passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0*2.));
return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(0.,1.),R(u_p0*2.));

filters.name: Fast Radial Symmetry Transform (VIGRA, Loy-Zelinsky)

passes: return blur1d(u_tex,uv,vec2(1.,0.),R(u_p0*2.));

filters.name: Warp Dilation (Material Maker)

filters.name: CMY Enlarger Colour Head (Dehancer)
filters.note: approx. of Dehancer CMY Color Head (article: subtractive Y / M / C filters in the enlarger light path; more yellow filtration = bluer print, each filter touches two channels, equal moves still shift colour, Preserve Exposure 100 keeps brightness, 0 lets added filtration lighten the print): filter units = 0.01 density with side absorptions (yellow 0.1 into green, magenta 0.12 into red / 0.15 into blue, cyan 0.06 into green), print gain 10^(1.5 D) per channel in linear light, divided by the luminance gain x preserve; print toning not included

filters.name: Spliced Radials (Warp-FX)
filters.note: Radegast Warp-FX SplicedRadials.fx: dist from centre (aspect-corrected), tension_radius = lerp(R-d, R, tension), splice_width = frac((tension_radius - inner)/n), splice = floor(max(R-d,0)/width), angle = (Angle/n)*splice; rotate about the centre inside Radius (inner radius 0, normal blend, mirror addressing)

filters.name: Drunk (Warp-FX / StreamFX)
filters.note: Warp-FX Drunk.fx (Xaymar StreamFX Drunk port): 5x5 control grid, each point circles by (cos,sin)(t*speed + table phase) * strength/100 * uv * 0.5 with alternating sign, rotated by BendAngle*sin(t*0.0005*BendSpeed); positions blended across each cell with a sine fade; speed 2, edge points fixed

filters.name: Fibonacci Downscaler (Veejay)
filters.note: Veejay fibdownscale.c on the raster as one linear array (planes 4:4:4): Down = for i<len/2 p[i]=p[2i] then the first half copied over the second half; Rectangle = p[i]=p[2i-3] for 2<=i<len/2; repeated Fib times (evaluated as the composed index map)

filters.name: Width Mirror (Veejay)
filters.note: Veejay widthmirror.c: band width = W/freq, u = x + phase*W/1000 (wrapped), even bands read forward, odd bands mirrored; luma += glow*(1 - min(dist to band edge / edge width, 1)), chroma kept; the per-frame drift is folded into Phase

filters.name: Rumbler (Cinelerra-GG)
filters.note: Cinelerra-GG Rumbler: each corner moved by Rumble * random(-0.5..0.5) * Space % of the frame, values interpolated between rumble points (Time = position between points, smooth), then a perspective warp to the moved corners; the per-second rate becomes the Time axis. approx. (random generator and interpolation shape not documented)

filters.name: Streak Image Radially (Vuo)
filters.note: Vuo Streak Image Radially: the circle of Radius (fraction of the height) is kept, every pixel outside takes the colour of the circle edge along its ray, rotated by Twirl growing with distance and faded toward black; approx. (Vuo source not available, twirl/fade profiles linear)
passes:
vec2 p=(uv-.5)*vec2(asp(),1.);float r=length(p),R0=u_p0*.5;if(r<=R0)return c;float rm=.5*length(vec2(asp(),1.));float k=clamp((r-R0)/max(rm-R0,1e-3),0.,1.);

filters.name: Rainbow Shift (Veejay)
filters.note: Veejay rainbowshift.c: wave = amplitude*sin(2pi*frequency*i/len) over the linear pixel index i (frequency cycles per frame), Y += wave, Cb += wave, Cr -= wave, each wrapped modulo 256 (8-bit overflow)

filters.name: Cosmic Hue (Veejay)
filters.note: Veejay cosmichue.c: (U,V)-128 offset by amplitude*(sin,cos)(frequency*Y/255), rotated by Hue Shift, re-centred and clamped, blended with the original chroma by opacity/256; luma untouched (Veejay defaults amplitude 10, frequency 10, opacity 100/255)

filters.name: Complex Invert (Veejay)
filters.note: Veejay complexinvert.c: chroma-plane wedge key around the key colour direction (half-angle Angle, distance x - |y|/tan(angle)), matte = distance*255/Solidity (threshold 0), spill of the key chroma removed in proportion to Spill Kill, then Y -> 255-Y and chroma negated, blended by the matte; key given as a hue (full-saturation colour)

filters.name: Alternative Saturation (Netpbm pamaltsat)
filters.note: Netpbm pamaltsat (colour-integrity method): intensity I = (.3333,.6061,.0606) on Rec.709-linearised values; Spectrum: out = x*k - I*(k-1) with k = min(strength, (1-I)/(max-I), I/(I-min)); Logarithmic: x^strength rescaled to the original intensity, strength binary-searched down when the brightest channel would exceed 1 (pixels with a channel at 1 untouched)

filters.name: Luminance-Locked Recolour (Netpbm pamrecolor)
filters.note: Netpbm pamrecolor (Scott Pakin): every pixel replaced by the target colour (or a random colour per pixel) scaled to the original luminance; channels clipped at 1 and the remaining deficit spread over the unclipped channels (divided by their weights) until the luminance matches; NTSC weights by default, on code values as the program does; default target = hotpink

filters.name: Oklab Gamut Clipping (Ottosson / vkdt okgmtclp)
filters.note: Ottosson Oklab gamut clipping as in vkdt okgmtclp: out-of-gamut colours moved along the straight Oklab line toward (L0, 0) until inside sRGB; L0 = L (preserve chroma), 0.5, or adaptive 0.5 with alpha; the gamut boundary is found by bisection instead of the cusp polynomials; Chroma Boost / Exposure push the sRGB image out of gamut first (an sRGB image is already inside)

filters.name: Mechanical Pixels (Veejay)
filters.note: Veejay mechanicalpixels.c steady state for one frame (no motion, motor waves or impacts): per cell mean Y/U/V and detail (max-min Y), height = quantise_21(18 + Y*44/256 + detail/16 + detail impulse), lift = 1 + height*maxLift/256; face luma 34 + h*190/256 with tilt gradient, pillow, rims and bevel, right/bottom sides darker by 47+7d / 68+8d, cast shadow, palette chroma tables; approx.: side/shadow outlines simplified

filters.name: Conway's Life Generation (Netpbm pbmlife)
filters.note: Netpbm pbmlife: image thresholded to 1 bit, white = alive (pbmlife convention), one generation of B3/S23 Life over the 8-neighbourhood, outside the image dead

filters.name: Soul Out (Harbeth C7SoulOut)
filters.note: Harbeth C7SoulOut.metal: alpha = maxAlpha*(1-soul), scale = 1+(maxScale-1)*soul, copy zoomed about the centre by scale and mixed over the frame with alpha (Douyin soul-out: maxScale 1.8, maxAlpha 0.4, soul = cycle progress)
passes: float al=u_p2*(1.-u_p0),sc=1.+(u_p1-1.)*u_p0;vec2 q=clamp(.5+(uv-.5)/sc,0.,1.);return vec4(mix(c.rgb,T(q).rgb,al),1.);

filters.name: Douyin Shake
filters.note: Douyin shake (juejin OpenGL ES case 13): progress = mod(t,0.7)/0.7, zoom 1 -> maxScale about the centre, R sampled at +offset*progress and G at -offset*progress along the diagonal, B centred
passes: vec2 oc=vec2(u_p2,-u_p2)*u_p0;float sc=1.+(u_p1-1.)*u_p0;vec2 q=.5+(uv-.5)/sc;return vec4(T(q+oc).r,T(q-oc).g,T(q).b,1.);

filters.name: Douyin Hallucination
filters.note: Douyin hallucination (juejin case 13): frame zoomed 1.2, sampled on a circle of radius 0.5*(1-1/scale) at the current time plus 10 ghosts spawned every 0.2 s whose per-channel alpha falls linearly to 0 over 0.9 s (max alpha R 0.5, G/B 0.05), remaining alpha on the current sample - red trails

filters.name: Jarvis Edge Enhancement (Netpbm pgmenhance)
filters.note: Netpbm pgmenhance (xim, Knuth 1987 sec. 6 / Jarvis et al. 1976): new = (p - phi*mean3x3)/(1-phi), phi = N/10, i.e. p + N/(10-N)*(p - mean); per channel here (program is greyscale, default level 9)
passes:
float ph=floor(u_p0+.5)/10.;vec3 s=vec3(0.);for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++)s+=T(uv+vec2(float(i),float(j))*u_px*u_k).rgb;
  return vec4(clamp((c.rgb-ph*s/9.)/(1.-ph),0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Sharpness Falloff Correction (Harbeth)
filters.note: Harbeth C7SharpnessFalloffCorrection.metal: radial weight = smoothstep over [start,end] of the aspect-corrected radius times amount; 4-neighbour Laplacian, edge strength = luma(|L|)/4 gated by the threshold and renormalised; out = c - L*0.25*weight*strength (Harbeth defaults amount 0, end 1, threshold 0.2)

filters.name: Hexagon NL Filter (Netpbm pnmnlfilt)
filters.note: Netpbm pnmnlfilt (Graeme Gill): 7 hexagons of size Radius (centre + 6 at hex spacing) area-sampled from the 3x3 pixels (13 points per hexagon here); Alpha-trimmed mean (alpha = Amount/2: (0.5-alpha)*12+1 values averaged, fractional end pair, 0.5 = median), Optimal estimation (alpha = 1+Amount: mean + var/(var+noise)*(centre-mean), noise = (alpha-1)^2/8, var = sum d^2/4), Edge enhancement (alpha = -(0.1+0.8*Amount): (centre - p*mean)/(1-p))

filters.name: Wipeout (Netpbm pamwipeout)
filters.note: Netpbm pamwipeout: -tb every column becomes ((h-y)/h)*top + (y/h)*bottom of its first and last row; -lr every row the same between its first and last pixel
passes:
vec2 h=.5/u_res;float t;vec3 a,b;if(u_p0<.5){a=T(vec2(uv.x,1.-h.y)).rgb;b=T(vec2(uv.x,h.y)).rgb;t=floor((1.-uv.y)*u_res.y)/u_res.y;}
  else{a=T(vec2(h.x,uv.y)).rgb;b=T(vec2(1.-h.x,uv.y)).rgb;t=floor(uv.x*u_res.x)/u_res.x;}return vec4(mix(a,b,t),1.);

filters.name: Two-Colour Antialias (Netpbm pnmalias)
filters.note: Netpbm pnmalias: a pixel is smoothed (centre weight w, each neighbour (1-w)/8, default w = 1/3) only where two side-adjacent neighbours (N/E, E/S, S/W, W/N) are both background and another pair both foreground; -balias / -falias also smooth background- / foreground-only boundaries; colour match with a tolerance

filters.name: Globe Gores (Netpbm ppmglobe)
filters.note: Netpbm ppmglobe: strip width = W/stripcount (right remainder dropped), each row squeezed by sin(pi*row/H) inside its strip with background margins round(width*(1-factor)/2), source column = strip left + round((p - border)/factor)

filters.name: Weibull Film Curve (vkdt filmcurv)
filters.note: vkdt filmcurv: scene-linear (bias added) through the Weibull CDF 1 - exp(-(x*light)^contrast) (light = 1/lambda, contrast = k per the module readme); colour per channel, DNG hue hack (curve on max/min, middle channel re-interpolated, vkdt adjust_colour_dng, default) or luminance scaling; on the linearised sRGB image

filters.name: Douyin Burr Glitch
filters.note: Douyin burr / glitch (juejin case 13): amplitude = max(sin(t*pi/0.3),0) over a 0.6 s cycle, per-row jitter = rand(y) in -1..1; rows with |jitter| < maxJitter*amplitude torn sideways by the full jitter, others by jitter*amplitude*0.006; red / blue sampled at x + offset*amplitude
passes:
float tm=mod(u_p0,.6);float am=max(sin(tm*PI/.3),0.);float ty=1.-uv.y;float j=fract(sin(ty)*43758.5453123)*2.-1.;bool no=abs(j)<u_p1*am;
  vec2 q=vec2(uv.x+(no?j:j*am*.006),uv.y);return vec4(T(q+vec2(u_p2*am,0.)).r,T(q).g,T(q+vec2(u_p3*am,0.)).b,1.);

filters.name: Semiline (StreamFX example)
filters.note: StreamFX semiline.effect: above the edge line the distance is cut into steps of Step Size px; at each step centre a transparent bar of half-height step*BarSize px (widening step by step away from the edge)
passes:
float E=u_p0*.01,yt=1.-uv.y,H=u_res.y;float S0=R(u_p1),B=R(u_p2);
  if(yt<=E){float st=floor((E-yt)*H/S0);float yi=E-(st+.5)*S0/H;if(abs(yt-yi)<st*B/H){vec2 ck=floor(uv*u_res/R(8.));return vec4(vec3(u_p3<.5?0.:u_p3<1.5?1.:(mod(ck.x+ck.y,2.)<.5?.75:.45)),1.);}}return c;

filters.name: Edge2x / Edge3x (ScummVM, approx.)
filters.note: ScummVM Edge2x/Edge3x (Eric Welsh) approx.: of three greyscale projections the one with the largest 3x3 variance is used, neighbour differences normalised by the maximum (diagonals x 1/sqrt2) give the inertia tensor whose principal axis is classed - / | \; the two corner sub-pixels on the far side of a diagonal edge take the two matching edge neighbours (only when the opposite two neighbours match the centre (no thinning of 1-px lines); candidate (a+b+E)/3 snapped to the nearest of N/E/S/W/centre with 2:4:1 RGB weights, or blended 1:1 with the centre when interpolated); refineDirection, knight, arrow and zig-zag passes not ported

filters.name: 2xPM (Pablo Medina, ScummVM)
filters.note: ScummVM pm.cpp (2xPM by Pablo Medina): 3x3 neighbourhood A..I, diagonal slope rules (E2/E3 from H), then the 3:1 B/H blends, then the 1:1 corner blends and the cross case, in source order with the doNotReblit short-circuit; equality relaxed to a colour tolerance; each art pixel split into 2x2

filters.name: Aspect Correction 200 to 240 lines (ScummVM)
filters.note: ScummVM aspect.cpp (kVeryFastAndGoodAspectMode): output line y reads source line s = (5y+4)/6; in each group of 6 output lines rows 0 and 5 are copies, rows 1-4 blend L[s] with L[s-1] at 7:1, 5:3, 3:5, 1:7; the frame is treated as the 5/6-height source (Line height = one art line) and pillarboxed to keep proportions

filters.name: Goat CRT (Mednafen goat shader)
filters.note: Mednafen goat shader (drivers/shader.cpp UpdateGoatMask): masks Goatron 3x1 RGB stripes, Goatron prime 4x1 with a black column, Borg 8x4 with black column and staggered black rows, Slenderman 20x10 with diagonal black bars; unlit mask cells = Transparency; R/B sampled -/+ Divergence output px (G at -half vertically); scanline gain min(|frac|*2,1)*0.4+0.6 per source texel; all in gamma 2.2 linear

filters.name: Stealth Cloak (Acid Cam game_codex)
filters.note: lostjared game_codex_stealth_cloak.glsl: w = sin(70y+5t)*sin(43x-3t), sample offset (0.012w, 0.006cos(55x+4t)), veil = smoothstep(0.65,0.05,r^2), mix toward luma*(0.65,0.9,1) by 0.55*veil, + (0.15,0.5,0.8)*|w|*veil; Ripple / Veil / Shimmer scale the original constants

filters.name: Portal Rift (Acid Cam game_codex)
filters.note: lostjared game_codex_portal_rift.glsl: swirl = (0.6-r)*4*smoothstep(0.55,0,r), rotate by swirl+0.8t, perspective remap q/(0.35+r)+0.5, thin ring smoothstep(0.035,0,|r-0.28|) adding cyan-magenta energy 0.55+0.45cos(offsets + 3*angle + 4t) * 1.2

filters.name: Freeze Crystal (Acid Cam game shader)
filters.note: lostjared game_freeze_crystal.glsl: 18x18 facet grid, per-cell hash jitter*0.3, sample offset (f-0.5+jitter)*0.012, ice = mix((0.55,0.75,1),(0.95,1,1.05),luma) mixed in by 0.55, rare white cell sparkles step(0.985, hash + t)

filters.name: Shield Hit (Acid Cam game_codex)
filters.note: lostjared game_codex_shield_hit.glsl: hex shimmer |sin(18x+10y+4t)|*|sin(-18x+10y-3.2t)|, expanding ring exp(-((r - mod(0.45t,0.9))*18)^2) that refracts the frame outward by 0.025, adds (0.2,0.75,1)*(hex^10*0.45 + ring*0.9)
passes:
vec2 tc=vec2(uv.x,1.-uv.y);vec2 p=tc-.5;p.x*=asp();float r=length(p),t=u_p0;float hx=abs(sin(p.x*18.+p.y*10.+t*4.))*abs(sin(p.x*-18.+p.y*10.-t*3.2));
  float rg=exp(-pow((r-mod(t*.45,.9))*18.,2.));vec2 q=tc+normalize(p+1e-5)*rg*.025;vec3 s=T(vec2(q.x,1.-q.y)).rgb;return vec4(clamp(s+vec3(.2,.75,1.)*(pow(hx,10.)*u_p1+rg*u_p2),0.,1.),1.);

filters.name: Colour Classify (Gem pix_colorclassify)
filters.note: Gem pix_colorclassify (Ricardo Fabbri): HSV interval tree - dark (V<0.3) black / dark green, bright low-saturation white, mid-dark greys, then hue bands red <30 or >330 (orange-yellow split), green 80-170, blue 185-270, the rest by sub-bands - each with a certainty; Gem shows only certain results, the rest as the brown "not sure" colour (154,115,86); the other modes also show good / unreliable guesses
